title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
summary: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.
tldr: DexRoam introduces a tracker-free system using a VR headset and stereo camera to collect whole-body human demonstrations for mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation, with three alignment stages that map human motion to robot action space and improve VLA policy learning on real robots. Experiments show significant success rate improvements with GR00T N1.7 and pi0.5 based policies, demonstrating a scalable approach to whole-body mobile manipulation without simplifying human motion.
tldr_zh: DexRoam 提出了一种仅使用消费级 VR 头显和头戴式立体相机、无需外部跟踪器的全身人体示教采集系统，通过三个对齐阶段将连续、耦合的人体运动映射到机器人动作空间，并与标准 VLA 策略联合训练。在真实机器人上的实验显示，该方法在 GR00T N1.7 和 pi0.5 等基础模型上显著提升了移动双臂灵巧操作任务的成功率，验证了保留精细运动结构的人体示教数据对策略学习的可扩展价值。
summary_zh: 移动双手灵巧操作要求在单一轨迹中连续协调运动、全身动作和手指级别的灵巧性，这造成了严重的机器人示教瓶颈。以自我为中心的人类示教提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但以往方法往往通过简化人类动作来降低迁移难度，恰恰丢弃了此类任务所依赖的细粒度耦合结构。我们提出DexRoam，一个完整的学习系统，用于从人类示教中学习移动双手灵巧操作，在整个人到机器人的迁移过程中，全身动作保持连续且耦合。为了实现全身人类操作示教的可扩展采集，我们开发了一套无需追踪器的采集系统，仅使用消费级VR头显和头戴式立体相机，无需外部相机或运动追踪器。随后，我们执行三个明确的对齐阶段——具身对齐、动作语义对齐和时间对齐——将采集到的动作映射到机器人动作空间，保留细粒度的全身动作，并允许人类示教与机器人示教由标准VLA策略联合学习。使用不同VLA骨干网络的实际实验表明，人类示教在各种训练范式下均持续提升策略学习效果，在GR00T N1.7上将平均成功率从29%提升至56%，在pi0.5上从32%提升至57%，同时使用一半的机器人示教即可达到与纯机器人训练相当的性能。消融实验证实每个对齐阶段都是必要的。这些结果突显了人类示教在保留细粒度动作结构的前提下，实现可扩展全身移动操作的潜力。

title: X-Reset: Scaling Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Embodiment Resets
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can train dexterous manipulation policies without robot demonstrations, but training a single generalist policy with task-agnostic rewards faces a severe exploration problem: approaching, grasping, and reorienting diverse objects with many degrees of freedom is difficult to discover from scratch. Prior works make exploration tractable with high-quality robot demonstrations, per-task reward shaping, or by restricting policies to narrow modes of behavior. We propose X-Reset, a framework that instead resolves exploration with human hand-object demonstrations. Rather than imitating or tracking retargeted human motion, X-Reset kinematically retargets hand-object states to noisy robot states, filters out states that are unstable in simulation, and samples the remainder as resets during RL training with general-purpose object-centric rewards. The resulting policy depends only on object state and goal, with demonstrations entering training through the reset distribution. We show that X-Reset trains generalist policies on 20 objects across three embodiments---a 22-DoF hand on two different arms and a parallel-jaw gripper---and resolves the exploration challenges of RL from scratch. X-Reset scales with the number of training objects, generalizes to unseen objects, can learn from imperfect hand-pose estimates, and transfers behaviors zero-shot from sim-to-real.
tldr: X-Reset addresses exploration in object-centric RL by using human hand-object demonstrations, kinematically retargeted to robot states and used as resets during training, enabling generalist dexterous manipulation policies across multiple embodiments and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: X-Reset 通过将人类手-物演示运动学重定向为机器人状态并作为训练中的重置，解决了面向物体的强化学习中的探索难题，从而在多种机器人形态上训练通用灵巧操作策略并实现仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 在仿真环境中通过强化学习能够训练出无需机器人示范的灵巧操作策略，但使用与任务无关的奖励训练单一通用策略面临严峻的探索问题：从零开始接近、抓取并重新定向具有多个自由度的多样物体难以实现。以往的研究通过高质量机器人示范、逐任务奖励塑形或限制策略仅适用于狭窄行为模式来使探索变得可行。我们提出X-Reset框架，该框架转而利用人类手部-物体示范来解决探索问题。X-Reset并非模仿或跟踪重定向后的人体运动，而是将手部-物体状态通过运动学重定向为带噪声的机器人状态，过滤掉仿真中不稳定的状态，并在使用通用物体中心奖励进行强化学习训练时，将剩余状态作为重置样本。最终得到的策略仅依赖于物体状态和目标，示范通过重置分布进入训练过程。我们展示X-Reset在三种实施例——22自由度的机械手分别安装于两条不同的机械臂以及平行夹爪——上对20种物体训练通用策略，解决了从零开始强化学习的探索难题。X-Reset随训练物体数量的增加而扩展，能够泛化至未见过的物体，可从不够精确的手部姿态估计中学习，并实现从仿真到真实世界的零样本行为迁移。

title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.
tldr: Holo-M proposes a discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation, with a unified body-part-specific action tokenizer and grouped discrete diffusion decoding to enable real-time control, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SIMPLE benchmark.
tldr_zh: Holo-M 提出了一种用于人形机器人移动操作任务的离散 VLA 模型，通过统一的肢体特定动作分词器和分组离散扩散解码实现实时控制，在 SIMPLE 基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型采用离散动作标记已被证明在机械臂操作任务中卓有成效。然而，对于人形机器人而言，全身动作空间——包括腿部、躯干、手臂和手部——维度更高且异构性更强，这对标记化、训练及实时推理提出了此前VLA模型未曾解决的挑战。我们提出Holo-M，据我们所知，这是首个针对人形机器人移动操作任务的离散VLA模型，它通过扩展语言模型的词汇表加入动作标记，从根本上利用了语言模型的能力。在该模型中，我们设计了一种统一动作标记器，将人形机器人动作空间分解为四个身体部位专属标记器——末端执行器、身体、手部和运动学——从而能够跨多种截然不同的具身形态和数据源进行训练，包括人形机器人遥操作、以自我为中心的人类视频以及仿真环境。通过将这些动作标记扩展至语言模型词汇表，我们避免了采用独立连续动作专家模块的模型所固有的知识隔离问题。为满足实时控制需求，我们通过分组离散扩散解码来解码每个身体部位的动作标记，而非对动作标记进行自回归生成。我们在SIMPLE人形机器人移动操作基准上进行了大量实验，Holo-M在通用评测与专家评测中均取得最高成功率，领先第二名较大幅度。我们将发布全部代码和模型权重。

title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
summary: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.
tldr: MM-ABC is a foundation model for generalist mobile manipulation that integrates sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception, a future-imagination branch for supervision, and an Arm-Base Collaboration module employing masked joint attention and clean-action prediction to coordinate heterogeneous arm and base action streams.
tldr_zh: MM-ABC是一个面向通用移动操作的基础模型，结合了稀疏多级VLM特征进行空间感知、用于监督的未来想象分支，以及通过掩码联合注意力和干净动作预测来协调异构手臂和底盘动作流的Arm-Base协作模块。
summary_zh: 移动操作通过使可达区域本身可控，将机器人交互扩展到固定运动学工作空间之外。这种灵活性带来了两个核心挑战：持续自我运动下的空间感知，以及异构机械臂与底盘动作的协调控制。现有方法通过显式三维表示或预测性世界模型来增强几何理解，并常将移动性与操作解耦为两个独立的动作流。我们认为，高效的移动操作不仅需要解耦，还需要支持跨流高效协作的表征。我们提出MM-ABC，一个围绕“感知、协调与想象”臂基协作构建的基础模型。MM-ABC结合了用于空间感知的稀疏多层级视觉语言模型特征；一个仅用于训练的未来分支，利用世界想象与几何意图作为额外监督，增强感知与操作意图预测并改善整体学习信号；以及MM-APT，通过掩码联合注意力与干净动作x预测来协调分离的操作流与移动流。在受控消融实验中，将干净动作预测替换为速度预测使RoboCasa365复合可见任务的成功率从32.8%降至29.2%，而移除未来监督或多层级条件则导致更大幅度的性能下降。我们在5000多小时异构机器人数据上预训练MM-ABC，涵盖40万+个片段、12个数据集和17种实体形态。实验覆盖EBench、RoboCasa365、ManiSkill-HAB、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus以及真实世界移动操作任务。MM-ABC在EBench上达到44.71%的成功率，在RoboCasa365上达到61.2%，在LIBERO上达到99.1%，在无扰动训练的LIBERO-Plus上达到82.8%，并在五个真实世界任务上达到83%的平均成功率。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verify results, and revise from feedback as executable code. The same working pattern of explicit state, manageable execution, and revisable procedures underlies generalization and long-horizon execution in the physical world, letting physical experience return as reusable programs, memory, or evidence. We propose Physical Coding, representing task state and execution as code. Code as World records objects, relations, constraints, and progress; Code as Policy organizes planning, verification, recovery, and execution. We build HexaAnything, which calls perception, planning, and control tools, including VLA/WAM policies, and makes in-the-loop decisions from external feedback. Verified traces become data and memory, enabling evolution from tools and Harness to model weights, architectures, and ultimately hardware and task design. On RoboCasa365, HexaAnything improves Composite-Unseen and overall success over XR-1 VLA, and its Harness-trained HexaModel beats the base on every split, indicating code traces internalize physical execution. On PhyBench and a dual-arm AgileX robot, the agent autonomously completes physics experiments and most tabletop tasks, often faster than published results. We observe data, model, and tool self-evolution; future work targets weight internalization, autonomous redesign of architectures, languages, representations, and tasks, and deployment in manufacturing and science.
tldr: This paper proposes Physical Coding, a framework that represents robot task state and execution as code, integrating VLA/WAM policies as tools and enabling self-evolution through verified traces. It introduces HexaAnything, which improves success rates on RoboCasa365 and demonstrates autonomous completion of physics experiments and tabletop tasks on a dual-arm robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出物理编码（Physical Coding）框架，将机器人任务状态和执行表示为代码，集成VLA/WAM策略作为工具，并通过验证轨迹实现自我进化。其构建的HexaAnything系统在RoboCasa365上提升了成功率，并在双臂机器人上自主完成物理实验和桌面任务。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作（WAM）模型直接将观测和指令映射为机器人动作。这种直接性使得策略与训练紧密耦合：轻微的场景布局或视角变化即会导致失败，指令的泛化能力也较差。其根本原因在于表示方式：任务需求、条件、进度和失败恢复被隐式地编码在动作序列中，难以检查或修改。数字编码智能体提供了先例：大语言模型调用工具、验证结果并根据反馈以可执行代码的形式进行修正。显式状态、可管理的执行和可修改的流程这一工作模式，是物理世界中泛化能力和长时程执行的基础，使物理经验能够以可复用程序、记忆或证据的形式回归。我们提出“物理编码”（Physical Coding），将任务状态和执行过程表示为代码。“代码即世界”（Code as World）记录对象、关系、约束和进度；“代码即策略”（Code as Policy）组织规划、验证、恢复和执行。我们构建了HexaAnything系统，它调用感知、规划和控制工具（包括VLA/WAM策略），并根据外部反馈进行环路内决策。经过验证的执行轨迹成为数据和记忆，推动从工具和框架（Harness）向模型权重、架构乃至最终硬件和任务设计的演进。在RoboCasa365上，HexaAnything在Composite-Unseen和总体成功率上均优于XR-1 VLA，其经框架训练的HexaModel在各数据子集上均超越基础模型，表明代码轨迹内化了物理执行过程。在PhyBench和双臂AgileX机器人上，该智能体自主完成物理实验及大多数桌面任务，且速度常常优于已发表的结果。我们观察到数据、模型和工具的自进化现象；未来工作将聚焦于权重内化、架构/语言/表示/任务的自主再设计，以及制造业和科学领域的部署应用。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.
tldr: Spatial Grafting is a lightweight module that binds frozen 3D reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry and injects them via cross-attention into flow-matching robot policies (VLAs and WAMs), improving manipulation performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks without modifying the host's perceptual pathway.
tldr_zh: 空间嫁接是一种轻量级模块，将冻结的3D重建特征与度量级、机器人相对的几何绑定，并通过交叉注意力注入到流匹配机器人策略（VLA和WAM）中，在不修改宿主感知通路的情况下，在仿真和真实机器人基准上提升操作性能。
summary_zh: 预训练机器人操作策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）或世界-动作模型（WAMs），隐含了与交互相关的度量几何信息，但未显式表达。近年来空间重建领域的突破性进展能够可靠地提供所需的几何信息，但这些特征描述的是局部形状，并未指明其相对于机器人的位置。如何将这些特征最优地传递给预训练策略仍是一个未解问题。我们提出空间嫁接（Spatial Grafting），一种通用、轻量的空间模块，将冻结的重建特征绑定到度量级、机器人相对几何上。空间嫁接构建度量锚定的空间标记，并通过交叉注意力将其注入流匹配动作专家中，无需修改主模型的感知通路，从而保留主模型预训练的全部收益。我们对该方法进行了比所比较的任何几何感知策略都更广泛的评估：一种嫁接架构，无需针对各主模型重新设计，适用于两个VLA和两个WAM，涵盖四个模拟基准——包括短时程操作、视觉鲁棒性、杂乱环境及长时程移动操作——并在三个真实机器人平台（含单臂和双臂配置）上进行了验证。在双臂操作基准RoboTwin 2.0上，嫁接方案在所有VLA和WAM主模型上均实现了性能提升。嫁接后的π₀.₅在干净场景和随机场景上分别提升了11.3%和15.6%，达到94.0%和92.4%，超过了已发表的最强三维条件策略WAM4D（93.8%和89.9%）。随着时程延长，优势进一步扩大：在以平均任务进度评分的双臂移动操作挑战BEHAVIOR-1K任务中，嫁接方案在六项任务中的五项上超越了2025年挑战赛冠军，最高超出0.47个Q分数，并在两者共同报告的三项任务上平均超过了基于地图条件的空间策略。

title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/
tldr: This paper introduces MAIL-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating VLA models under camera interruptions, and proposes MINT, a method that trains policies to handle missing views and supplements them with optical-flow extrapolation or world model predictions, improving robustness on π0.5, GR00T N1.5, and real-robot AgiBot G2.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MAIL-Bench基准，用于评估VLA模型在相机中断下的表现，并提出了MINT方法，通过训练策略适应缺失视图并使用光流外推或世界模型预测补充观测，在π0.5、GR00T N1.5和真实机器人AgiBot G2上提升了鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出了强大的能力，然而这类模型通常在任务执行过程中所有摄像头流均可用的情况下进行开发和评估。当某个摄像头在任务执行期间停止传输帧时，策略必须在不获取缺失视角后续观测的情况下继续执行动作。尽管这一问题在实际应用中具有重要性，但此类中断对闭环操作的影响仍未得到充分理解。为探究该问题，我们提出了MAIL-Bench，一个用于评估VLA模型遭遇视觉中断的基准测试。通过在每条策略成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同摄像头，MAIL-Bench衡量了当视觉输入不可用时策略保留其能力程度。基于该基准，我们提出了MINT方法，其首先训练VLA策略在缺失视觉输入的情况下仍能保持功能。在推理阶段，MINT利用光流外推或基于动作的条件世界模型选择性地补充缺失的观测，并在预测视图变得不可靠时将其撤回。在$π_{0.5}$和GR00T N1.5上的实验表明，与原始模型相比，MINT在摄像头丢失情况下显著提升了任务成功率。在AgiBot G2上的实验进一步验证了摄像头丢失场景下真实机器人的部署能力。该基准可在https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/获取。

title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.
tldr: ActionUNet introduces a lightweight temporal U-Net and a conditional SIREN decoder with smoothness constraints to efficiently fine-tune pre-trained VLA models, improving robustness and success rates on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: ActionUNet 通过在时序对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量级时间 U-Net 和带平滑约束的条件 SIREN 连续动作解码器，高效微调预训练 VLA 模型，在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 和真实世界任务中提升了鲁棒性和成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将多模态语义映射为物理动作，在机器人操作任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，这种映射本质上难以将粗粒度的语义与细粒度的时间执行对齐，导致VLA模型在杂乱环境中泛化能力有限、鲁棒性不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出ActionUNet，一种高效的多尺度微调框架，以极低的计算成本增强预训练VLA模型。ActionUNet首先在时间对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量级时间U-Net，用于融合层次化结构先验，有效弥合语义与时间执行之间的尺度鸿沟。考虑到多尺度建模可能破坏微观时间连续性并引发机械振荡，ActionUNet进一步采用条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器。该解码器配备显式的二阶平滑约束，可保证时间连续性并减少高频运动抖动。通过平滑多尺度融合带来的时间不连续性，这种连续化公式在保持基础VLA模型泛化能力和操作鲁棒性的同时，降低了机械执行失败率。在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus基准上的大量实验，以及真实世界的困难场景评估表明，ActionUNet将π0.5的成功率分别绝对提升了9.8%、6.1%和11.4%，同时也能泛化到基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT骨干网络上，充分证明了其作为微调策略的有效性和高效性。代码和实现细节见https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet。

title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.
tldr: AGF amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network for flow-based VLA policies, improving task return on LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro while being faster and more parameter-efficient than prior critic guidance methods.
tldr_zh: AGF 将轨迹感知的评论家引导轻量化地转化为引导网络，用于基于流的 VLA 策略，在多个基准上提升任务回报，且比现有方法更快、参数更少。
summary_zh: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常通过行为克隆进行训练，因此并未显式优化长期任务回报。评论家引导将生成过程引向更高价值的动作，但现有方法通过单步采样子代理对评论家进行微分，并在每个流步骤中反向传播评论家集成。相比之下，本文提出伴随引导流（AGF），将轨迹感知的评论家引导摊销到一个轻量级引导网络中，同时保留预训练的VLA策略。具体而言，我们将评论家引导的流生成建模为一个确定性最优控制问题，其最优引导是一个协态量，该协态量将终端评论家梯度沿剩余流反向传播，并在保持VLA和评论家均冻结的同时，将引导网络回归到该协态量上。这种设计在训练期间提供了有利的内存和吞吐量扩展，且推理时每步仅需一次引导网络前向传播，无需评论家集成、反向传播或伴随计算。在LIBERO、RoboCasa和LIBERO-Pro上，AGF一致性地提升了预训练VLA的性能，与评论家引导和策略微调基线相比具有竞争力，并且在跨任务使用单一引导强度时是最稳健的方法。与QGF相比，AGF每个引导步骤的运行速度提高了3.6倍，参数量减少了7.0倍，同时性能相当甚至更优，表明评论家引导可以兼具轨迹感知性和轻量性。

title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
summary: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.
tldr: UMR introduces a unified action representation decomposing manipulation into embodiment-agnostic World Flow and Ego Trajectory, enabling zero-shot transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots via a dual-stream point VLA policy, achieving high success in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: UMR提出了一种统一的操作动作表示，将操作分解为与具体形态无关的世界流和自体轨迹，通过双流点VLA策略实现从人类演示到异构机器人的零样本迁移，在仿真和真实世界实验中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 通用型具身操作依赖于一种统一的动作表征，该表征能够跨具身形态泛化并易于扩展。然而，现有策略依赖于具身特有的动作空间，这使得跨具身的演示数据难以大规模利用，并限制了向新型具身形态和空间变体的迁移能力。为此，我们提出通用操作表征（UMR），一种统一的动作表征，能够实现从人类演示到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移。UMR将操作分解为两个功能上不同但在几何上相互关联的组成部分：与具身无关的世界流（World Flow），描述任务相关物体在世界坐标系中的运动；以及自身轨迹（Ego Trajectory），表示末端执行器相对于当前位姿的运动。我们将UMR实例化为世界-自身点云视觉语言动作模型（WEPVLA），这是一个紧凑的0.5B参数策略，通过双流点云动作适配器和统一点云动作专家在统一的几何动作空间中学习，并利用$SE(3)$共轭操作将两个组成部分耦合。为提高数据效率，我们为UMR补充了数据高效策略（DES），通过阶段感知的点云编辑来多样化物体配置，同时保留演示中的接触几何信息。在仿真中，WEPVLA在LIBERO基准上达到97.5%的平均成功率，在10任务RLBench基准上达到85.7%。在真实世界实验中，一个仅使用DES增强后的人类演示训练的策略，能够零样本迁移到多种部署条件下。每个任务仅需约10分钟的人类演示数据且无需机器人演示，该策略在六种评估设置下达到91.7%的平均成功率，而HumanEgo仅为60.8%。代码和其他材料可在 https://umr-wepvla.github.io/ 获取。

title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/
tldr: GAE is a unified learning framework for real-time, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation, using a two-stage training paradigm (privileged generator and deployable executor) and a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism to enable diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors on real humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: GAE是一个用于实时、低延迟人形全身遥操作统一学习框架，采用两阶段训练范式（特权生成器与可部署执行器）及延迟条件预测机制，在真实人形机器人上实现多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为镜像。
summary_zh: 类人化身将人类的物理存在延伸至身体之外，使人们能够通过远程操控的机器人参与社交、服务及劳动活动。这要求远程操作系统能够实现多样化且动态的全身行为，同时保持响应迅速的人机同步。我们提出了通用动作专家（GAE），一个面向通用、低延迟类人全身远程操作任务的统一学习框架。为覆盖多样化的人类行为，GAE从异构来源（包括视频、动画和动作捕捉）构建大规模人体运动数据集，并对其进行标准化与增强处理。随后，GAE通过两阶段训练范式解决人体运动中的噪声及具身失配问题：首先，一个特权生成策略在仿真环境中跟踪人体运动参考，并生成可行的类人轨迹；接着，一个可部署的执行策略在课程化域随机化条件下学习跟踪这些生成的轨迹。为实现响应迅速的人机同步，GAE引入了一种延迟条件预测机制，在实时远程操作过程中自适应地补偿端到端延迟。在Unitree G1和Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真实世界实验表明，GAE能够使类人机器人平滑地镜像多样化、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为。项目网站：https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.
tldr: mmHRI introduces a privacy-preserving human-robot interaction framework using millimeter-wave radar and a VLA policy for closed-loop manipulation, achieving robust object delivery in occluded environments without camera imagery.
tldr_zh: mmHRI 提出了一种利用毫米波雷达和视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略的隐私保护人机交互框架，在无摄像头遮挡环境下实现了稳健的物体递送任务。
summary_zh: 辅助机器人越来越多地应用于各类以人为中心的环境中，并执行多种人机交互（HRI）任务，例如物体递送。然而，现有的大多数HRI系统依赖RGB摄像头持续观察人类，以响应诸如手势之类的非语言指令。这在隐私敏感的环境中（如医院病房或餐厅）引发了隐私担忧，因为在这些场景中，直接使用摄像头观察人类受到限制。为实现隐私保护的人机交互，我们利用毫米波（mmWave）雷达，该技术能够在无需可识别图像的情况下感知人体运动，同时穿越隐私屏障。我们提出了mmHRI，这是首个实现毫米波雷达引导的隐私保护人机交互的多模态机器人操控框架。mmHRI引入了两项关键设计，以缓解杂乱机器人操控环境中雷达数据的稀疏性和时间不一致性问题。首先，我们提出了一种双流架构，该架构联合学习未滤波的原始雷达张量和雷达点云，以同时估计人类动作和三维姿态。为缓解信号不一致性，mmHRI进一步引入了一种基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM），该模型保留历史雷达特征，以减少姿态/动作的突变。这些估计出的人类状态随后被转换为结构化的文本机器人指令，用于控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环机器人操控和感知人类意图的反应。我们的评估涵盖人体动作识别以及闭环递送与取回任务。在隐私保护的幕帘设置下，mmHRI实现了85.09%的动作识别准确率，优于现有的基于雷达的替代方法。机器人实验进一步证明，在视觉遮挡条件下系统能够成功完成递送与取回任务，并在未见过的受试者、杂乱配置及环境中保持稳定的任务表现。

title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.
tldr: WB-WAM introduces a World Action Model with explicit whole-body action supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, leveraging heterogeneous data pre-training, PICO mid-training, and auxiliary forward kinematics to achieve strong simulation and real-world task performance while reducing robot demonstration needs.
tldr_zh: WB-WAM 提出了一种在生成式视频预训练中引入显式全身动作监督的世界动作模型，通过异构数据预训练、PICO 中期训练和辅助前向运动学，在仿真和真实世界任务中实现高性能，同时减少对机器人演示数据的需求。
summary_zh: 人形机器人全身操控要求身体与手部动作的高度协调，而传统机器人预训练数据对此类全身运动的覆盖十分有限。我们提出了WB-WAM，一种将显式全身动作监督融入生成式视频预训练的世界动作模型。通过一个共享的物理动作空间，我们整合了来自异构数据源的身体、根部和灵巧手部标注，从而实现了对1880.2小时部分标注视频和动作数据的联合视频与动作学习。所得先验知识经过PICO中间训练进一步优化，并借助辅助前向运动学监督适配至机器人任务。我们构建了WB-Datasets，通过重定向的以自我为中心的人类演示和机器人轨迹来支撑上述各阶段，使任务对齐的人类运动能够补充有限的机器人数据。仿真评估表明，WB-WAM在HumanoidArena中的全身任务性能强劲，达到81.9%；真实世界实验进一步验证了其有效性，在五项任务中平均成功率达84.0%。此外，任务对齐的PICO中间训练在提升下游任务性能的同时，减少了对真实机器人演示的需求。这些结果支持异构全身预训练与人类运动迁移作为实现数据高效的人形机器人全身操控的可行路径。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA
tldr: This paper proposes AD-E2E-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for end-to-end autonomous driving that introduces a SIGReg-regularized projector to achieve 100x inference speedup and improved planning performance, validated on NAVSIMv2 and in zero-shot goal-conditioned planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AD-E2E-JEPA，一种用于端到端自动驾驶的联合嵌入预测架构，通过引入SIGReg正则化投影器实现了100倍推理加速和更好的规划性能，并在NAVSIMv2和零样本目标条件规划中得到了验证。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶需要能够理解物理世界、进行推理与规划并安全运行的**世界模型**。本文首先系统性地评估了现有的基于动作条件的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型，包括LeWM、DINO-WM和JEPA-WM，用于端到端自动驾驶（E2EAD）。为了将世界模型的质量与策略学习相分离，我们采用了一种目标条件零样本规划设置，该设置使用真实未来观测作为目标来评估这些模型，而无需训练任何驾驶策略。我们发现，现有的基于JEPA的世界模型要么在驾驶上准确但计算开销大，要么计算高效但不足以支持规划。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了**AD-E2E-JEPA**，其引入了一个由SIGReg正则化的可学习投影器，应用于投影后的补丁嵌入。该投影器将规划补丁数量减少$16\times$，嵌入维度减少$4\times$，在保持规划性能的同时实现了$100\times$的推理加速，对于256条候选轨迹的8帧展开，运行时间为0.8秒。在**未**训练任何驾驶策略的情况下，世界模型本身在256/8,192条候选轨迹的词表上，通过世界模型展开，平均可在4.0/2.8米的位移内到达位于20米外的目标。在NAVSIMv2基准上，在目标条件零样本规划中，含乘性安全指标时其EPDMS为67.3/72.9，不含这些指标时EPDMS$^{\dagger}$为84.1/86.5。实验进一步表明，自监督预训练的投影器将下游模仿学习性能从80.2提升至85.4 EPDMS。源代码可在 https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA 获取。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.
tldr: ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to create a simulation-ready object mesh from a single view, enabling rapid parallel reinforcement learning for real-world robot manipulation tasks without demonstrations or pretraining.
tldr_zh: ZeroBot 利用图像到三维生成模型，从单视图创建可用于仿真的对象网格，从而无需演示或预训练即可快速进行并行强化学习，实现真实世界的机器人操作任务。
summary_zh: 我们提出ZeroBot，一个用于在极具挑战性的条件下从零开始学习机器人操作任务的实景到仿真（real2sim）框架，这些条件包括：零人类示范、零策略预训练以及零已知物体模型。仅需给定物体的单一视角图像及该物体的目标位姿，ZeroBot便利用图像到三维生成模型获取完整的物体网格，并将其用于大规模并行强化学习的仿真中。为了加速训练，我们引入了一种动作空间，该空间利用生成的几何信息及学习到的价值函数，对涉及机器人-物体接触的状态进行采样。在包括抓取、推动、铰接物体交互及多阶段操作在内的真实世界任务评估中，ZeroBot实现了87%的成功率，平均训练时间仅为119秒。这些结果表明，在实景到仿真框架中利用图像到三维模型，对于快速、自主的机器人学习具有重要价值。

title: FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving
summary: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR
tldr: FINGR introduces a policy for dexterous single-hand Rubik's Cube solving that uses finger-relative geometry and future interaction prediction to achieve 99% success on real hardware.
tldr_zh: FINGR 提出了一种用于单只灵巧手解魔方的策略，通过手指相对几何和未来交互预测，在真实硬件上实现了99%的成功率。
summary_zh: 操纵单个灵巧手完成魔方复原，是一项对持续且富含接触的控制能力的挑战性测试：手部必须在保持魔方稳定的同时，依次执行各层的转动。每一次转动都需要部分手指支撑魔方，而其他手指则推动移动层、释放接触，并为下一次转动复位。为学习这种协调能力，我们提出了FINGR（基于几何表示的未来监督交互网络），一种将手指相对几何结构与未来交互预测相结合的策略。一个共享点编码器将魔方表示为相对于每个指尖的坐标，并聚合其点云数据，而无需依赖小块索引。学习得到的未来令牌与观测编码器共享，并在多个时间尺度上接收关于接触力变化、层转动进度和手指关节位移的监督信号。由此产生的表示条件化了一个直接生成手指动作的流策略。在实际灵巧手上，我们的策略在300次转动尝试中实现了99.0%的成功率，而基线流策略为79.7%。与抓取及桌面辅助重抓取功能集成后，该策略能在平均约137秒的完整系统时间内解决全部十个打乱的$2\times2\times2$魔方。项目网站可在 https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR 访问。

title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.
tldr: D^2-VLA introduces dual-memory dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA, enabling long-horizon manipulation with periodic VLM updates and fast action replanning. It achieves significant success rate improvements on DOMINO, DOMINO-Long, real-robot tasks, LIBERO-Long, and RoboTwin 2.0.
tldr_zh: D^2-VLA 在预训练 VLA 的 KV 缓存接口引入双记忆双频控制，通过周期性的 VLM 更新和快速动作重规划支持长期操作。在 DOMINO、DOMINO-Long、真实机器人任务、LIBERO-Long 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得了显著的成功率提升。
summary_zh: 长时程操作要求机器人能够在记忆已不在视野中的线索的同时，对移动物体做出响应。然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常依赖于最新观测，而刷新其视觉上下文通常需要另一轮成本高昂的视觉-语言模型（VLM）推理。我们提出D$^2$-VLA，它在预训练VLA的KV缓存接口上结合了双记忆与双频率控制。D$^2$-VLA采用分块因果KV缓存来增量编码观测，并在不同时间注意力模式的引导下，为VLM和动作专家构建独立的历史KV读视图。在周期性VLM更新之间，一个门控适配器将新视觉特征融入最新的历史条件KV块，同时一个短时快速记忆队列支持动作重规划。我们引入DOMINO-Long，一个包含十个任务的基准测试，要求机器人在操作移动物体时利用早期视觉线索。D$^2$-VLA在DOMINO上实现了29.3\%的完整任务成功率，而$π_{0.5}$为9.6\%，PUMA为17.2\%；在DOMINO-Long上达到60.0\%，相比之下两者分别为35.4\%和20.6\%。它在八个真实机器人任务上提升了成功率，并在LIBERO-Long上达到97.5\%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到74.3\%。

title: CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git
tldr: CAR-VLA proposes a driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus, using three reasoning modes (Fast Intuition, Slow Thinking, Reflex Response) trained via progressive supervised learning and reinforcement learning, achieving competitive performance on NAVSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CAR-VLA 提出了一种驾驶 VLA 模型，联合考虑场景复杂度和动态风险来指导推理深度、紧急程度和聚焦点，通过渐进式监督学习和强化学习训练三种推理模式（快速直觉、慢速思考、反射式响应），在 NAVSIM 基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
summary_zh: 现有的自适应驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理方法主要关注“是否推理”，却忽视了不同驾驶情境下“如何推理”应有所差异。我们的核心见解在于：场景复杂度决定推理深度，而动态风险在时间紧迫的情境中同样对推理方式的决策至关重要。为此，我们提出CAR-VLA，一个统一的驾驶VLA模型，联合考虑场景复杂度与动态风险，以引导推理的深度、紧迫性与关注焦点。CAR-VLA将四种复杂度-风险类别映射为三种推理模式：\textit{快速直觉}，用于简单低风险场景中的直接轨迹生成；\textit{慢速深思}，用于复杂低风险场景中的审慎推理；以及\textit{反射响应}，用于高风险场景中紧凑且聚焦于危险的推理，不论场景复杂度如何。反射响应并非仅仅是缩短推理时间，而是将推理集中于最关键的危险源及即时安全应对措施。我们通过渐进式监督学习训练CAR-VLA，将场景评估、推理模式选择与轨迹生成相衔接，并随后采用推理增强的强化学习以提升驾驶质量与推理行为。在NAVSIM v1（PDMS 91.1）、NAVSIM v2（EPDMS 90.3）及Navhard（EPDMS 35.0）上的实验展示了具有竞争力的驾驶性能。在navtest及内部高风险场景上的定性比较进一步验证了风险感知推理与危险响应式轨迹生成的有效性。本文代码将公开发布于：https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git

title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.
tldr: WorldGuide improves Vision-Language-Action policies by learning success-failure boundaries in latent world models and using them as a differentiable reward during training, achieving state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv.
tldr_zh: WorldGuide通过在潜在世界模型中学习成功-失败边界，并将其用作训练中的可微奖励，从而提升视觉-语言-动作策略的性能，在LIBERO 100和SimplerEnv上达到最先进水平。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过捕捉动作的后果，为提升视觉-语言-动作策略提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，主要基于专家演示训练得到的模型对于失败结果的接触有限，可能难以区分视觉上相似的成功与失败交互。我们提出\textbf{WorldGuide}框架，该框架学习潜在空间中的这些差异，并利用这些差异来指导策略训练。WorldGuide将对成功和失败轨迹的预测性预训练与对匹配的成功-失败对比学习相结合。学习得到的预测器随后提供可微分的奖励，以指导策略和视觉编码器的联合优化。该预测器在训练后被舍弃，因此部署时无需额外的世界模型推理。大量实验表明，WorldGuide显著提升了VLA的可靠性，在LIBERO 100和SimplerEnv上达到了最先进的性能，分别取得\textbf{96.8\%}和\textbf{72.0\%}的结果。代码将公开可用。

title: ReDrive: Shaping Representations with World Modeling for End-to-End Driving
summary: Driving policies require capabilities of scene understanding and future evolution prediction. To achieve this goal, current end-to-end models typically construct complex perception-planning pipelines or introduce world models that explicitly predict future states, resulting in a complex system architecture. Inspired by the transferability of general-purpose visual representations, we argue that combining sufficiently strong visual representations with representation world modeling can support effective planning without relying on complex inference-time auxiliary modules. Based on this insight, we present ReDrive, an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction. To achieve this, ReDrive adopts a three-stage training pipeline consisting of driving video pretraining, joint world-modeling and planning training, and planner adaptation. This yields a strong planning-oriented representation and a high-performance planner, while requiring neither auxiliary perception modules nor future prediction at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate strong performance, achieving 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. These results show that shaping representations with world modeling is sufficient to enable high-performance end-to-end planning while retaining a simple encoder-planner inference pipeline.
tldr: ReDrive is an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction, using a three-stage training pipeline to achieve high performance without auxiliary perception modules or future prediction at inference.
tldr_zh: ReDrive 是一种端到端驾驶框架，通过未来表示预测来强化面向规划的视觉特征，采用三阶段训练流程，在推理时无需辅助感知模块或未来预测即可实现高性能。
summary_zh: 驾驶策略需要具备场景理解与未来演化预测的能力。为实现这一目标，当前的端到端模型通常构建复杂的感知-规划流水线，或引入显式预测未来状态的世界模型，从而导致系统架构较为复杂。受通用视觉表示可迁移性的启发，我们认为，将足够强的视觉表示与表示世界建模相结合，即可支撑高效的规划，而无需依赖复杂的推理时辅助模块。基于这一认识，我们提出了ReDrive，一种通过未来表示预测来强化面向规划的视觉特征的端到端驾驶框架。为实现该目标，ReDrive采用三阶段训练流程，包括驾驶视频预训练、世界建模与规划联合训练，以及规划器适配。由此获得强面向规划的表示与高性能规划器，同时在推理阶段无需辅助感知模块或未来预测。在NAVSIM上的实验表明，该方法性能优异，在NAVSIM v1上达到91.0 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.8 EPDMS。这些结果表明，利用世界建模塑造表示，足以在保持简洁的编码器-规划器推理流水线的同时，实现高性能的端到端规划。

title: The Low-Rank Structure of VLA Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet how RL reshapes these policies remains poorly understood. We find that RL across widely used flow-based VLA models, including $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T~N1.5/N1.6, on LIBERO, ManiSkill, MetaWorld, and CALVIN induces substantially lower-rank parameter updates that are highly concentrated in the action expert's Timestep Modules, a small and previously overlooked component. Through systematic module-replacement experiments, we further show that these modules capture a disproportionate share of the performance gains from RL. We then characterize what is encoded in these Timestep Modules. First, we show that RL specializes them to the discrete denoising timesteps used during rollouts, and that this discrete-timestep training underlies the low-rank updates. Second, we find that among their outputs, the shift vector changes most distinctly under RL, and through probing, we show that shift update directions strongly predict task success (ROC-AUC up to $99.6\%$). Third, we find that the geometry of shift updates reflects task relationships, as their pairwise similarity correlates with cross-task transfer patterns. Building on these findings, we show that steering along shift update directions further improves RL-trained policies without additional RL training. Overall, we provide a systematic understanding of how RL reshapes VLA policies by studying how learned signals are encoded in parameter space, offering insights into more efficient and interpretable VLA post-training.
tldr: This paper studies how reinforcement learning (RL) post-training reshapes vision-language-action (VLA) models, discovering that RL induces low-rank parameter updates concentrated in the action expert's Timestep Modules, which encode discrete denoising timesteps and shift vectors that predict task success and transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文研究强化学习（RL）后训练如何重塑视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，发现RL产生低秩参数更新，集中在动作专家的时间步模块中，该模块编码离散去噪时间步和位移向量，可预测任务成功和迁移。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）正越来越多地用于对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练，然而RL如何重塑这些策略仍知之甚少。我们发现，在广泛使用的基于流匹配的VLA模型（包括$π_{0.5}$和GR00T~N1.5/N1.6）上，在LIBERO、ManiSkill、MetaWorld和CALVIN基准上进行RL训练会引发秩显著更低的参数更新，且这些更新高度集中于动作专家（action expert）中的时间步模块（Timestep Modules）——这是一个规模较小且此前被忽视的组件。通过系统的模块替换实验，我们进一步表明，这些模块承载了RL带来性能提升的绝大部分。随后，我们刻画了这些时间步模块中所编码的内容。首先，我们表明RL使这些模块专门服务于推理（rollout）过程中所使用的离散去噪时间步，而这种离散时间步训练正是低秩更新的根源。其次，我们发现，在这些模块的输出中，平移向量（shift vector）在RL作用下的变化最为显著，且通过探针实验，我们证明平移更新方向能够强有力地预测任务成功率（ROC-AUC最高达$99.6\%$）。第三，我们发现平移更新的几何结构能够反映任务之间的关联，因为它们的成对相似性与跨任务迁移模式相关。基于这些发现，我们证明，沿平移更新方向进行引导（steering），可以在无需额外RL训练的情况下进一步提升RL训练后策略的性能。总体而言，我们通过研究学习到的信号如何在参数空间中被编码，系统性地理解RL如何重塑VLA策略，为更高效且更具可解释性的VLA后训练提供了洞见。

title: CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
summary: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.
tldr: This paper proposes a GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired collision distance metric for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, enabling efficient and tunable collision-aware motion planning with image-conditioned objectives for real-world navigation and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于概率的、可在GPU上加速的碰撞距离度量，直接用于3D高斯泼溅场景，结合图像条件奖励实现高效且可调节保守性的碰撞感知运动规划，并已在真实导航和操作任务中验证。
summary_zh: 摘要：将稠密视觉信息融入运动规划仍是一项挑战，因为几何规划器依赖抽象的场景表示，这些表示丢弃了视觉丰富性，而学习的视觉模型往往缺乏几何可解释性和计算效率。本文提出CollisionSplatting，一种简单、模块化、GPU加速、基于概率思想且可调节保守程度的距离度量，直接作用于标准3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景。当与学习的图像条件奖励函数结合时，该度量通过统一碰撞感知成本与图像空间目标，实现了几何与视觉的联合规划。我们将该度量集成到GPU加速的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）和快速探索随机树（RRT）规划器中，并展示了与代表性基线相当或更优的碰撞分类性能，同时显著提高了碰撞检测吞吐量并大幅降低了显存使用。最后，我们展示了该度量在真实世界视觉引导导航和操作任务中的有效性，凸显了3DGS作为丰富感知与实时运动规划之间实用桥梁的作用。

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
summary: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.
tldr: F4R is a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop framework that automatically identifies, reconstructs, and refines robot manipulation policies from real-world failures, improving OOD success without extra real demonstrations.
tldr_zh: F4R是一种故障驱动的真实到仿真到真实的闭环学习框架，通过自动识别、重建和精化机器人操作策略，在不增加真实演示的情况下提升分布外成功率。
summary_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作模型在现实世界中的性能从根本上受到专家演示覆盖范围有限及其对物理交互理解不足的制约。常见的补救措施是收集新遇到失败场景的额外现实演示。然而，这一过程成本高昂、效率低下、存在潜在安全风险且难以规模化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出F4R（Failure for Rising），一种以失败驱动的真机-仿真-真机闭环学习框架，将现实世界中的失败转化为有针对性的策略改进。F4R首先利用智能体从策略执行中自动识别并诊断失败。随后，它将每个失败场景重建为以物体为中心的交互式桌面环境，该环境保留了与任务相关的空间和物理条件。接着，通过失败条件下的仿真-真机协同训练，并在重建环境中进行有针对性的强化学习，对策略进行优化。改进后的策略随后被重新部署，而新观察到的失败则持续反馈至下一轮重建与学习循环中。在四项操作任务上的真机评估表明，F4R实现了93.75%的分布内（In-Distribution）成功率与90.0%的分布外（OOD）成功率，在OOD条件下较同等预算的Targeted BC基线高出18.75个百分点，且无需额外收集真实世界纠正性演示。

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.
tldr: EdgeVLN introduces a runtime-aware, memory-pruned, 4-bit quantized VLN model with a lightweight stopping-head verifier (LATTE) that runs on an NVIDIA Jetson edge device, achieving 58.02% SR in R2R VLN-CE while drastically reducing latency and energy versus BF16 baselines.
tldr_zh: EdgeVLN通过运行时感知的4-bit量化和轻量级停止头验证器(LATTE),在NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备上实现了58.02%的R2R VLN-CE成功率,并大幅降低延迟与能耗。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）模型虽然性能优异，但主要面向计算资源丰富的平台，难以部署在内存和功耗受限的机器人边缘设备上。仅靠模型压缩无法确定VLN模型在满足边缘平台内存、延迟和能量预算的同时，是否仍能保持导航行为。我们提出EdgeVLN，一种具备运行时感知能力、可直接部署的量化VLN模型，填补了这一空白。EdgeVLN将量化的StreamVLN模型与潜在轨迹终止提取器（LATTE）相结合，后者是一种轻量级因果Transformer，通过预测“停止动作”验证器排名来提升实时停止能力。两者均通过我们开发的llama.cpp VLN驱动程序执行，该驱动可在设备端重建流式上下文并剪枝内存令牌。我们对预训练的StreamVLN主干网络在8位至2位权重量化及多种推理运行时下进行了表征，以确定可行的运行点。LATTE在量化释放的预算内复用主干网络的隐藏状态，无需额外的视觉编码器或额外的主干网络前向传播。我们在BF16和IQ4 NL精度下，对六种主干网络精度和七种候选停止头在所有1,839个R2R VLN-CE验证未见过场景上进行了评估。我们在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB上测量了模拟环境中的成功率（SR）以及延迟、能耗和常驻内存。LATTE在部署的4位模型上取得了最高的成功率，达到58.02%，相比BF16基线仅增加每导航步0.013秒的额外延迟，同时超越了基线性能。4位格式的成功率几乎相同，但每步能耗因执行路径不同而相差36.8倍。仅IQ4 NL在我们的VLN驱动下能够适配开发板，其常驻内存为11.35 GB，运行速度比存储流式BF16快20.8倍，能耗降低13.3倍。INT2精度则出现性能崩塌。运行时选择、内存令牌剪枝和量化对于高效边缘部署至关重要。

title: Robot Tool Design from Scratch via Behavior-Aware Hierarchical Optimization
summary: The ability to design a tool for a task marks a level of intelligence beyond merely understanding, selecting, or using one. Existing methods for robotic tool design typically optimize a tool's continuous shape and action within a structure that is prescribed or generated beforehand, so the structure itself stays outside the physical optimization loop. We study task-driven tool design from scratch, where tool structure, shape, and action are all derived from the desired physical outcome. Here we show that the three elements can be designed jointly by HOT, a hierarchical optimization whose upper level searches over discrete tool structures with BASS, while lower-level physical optimization evaluates their task behavior and returns milestone progress as behavioral evidence for the search, ultimately providing jointly optimized shape and action. On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.
tldr: This paper introduces HOT, a hierarchical optimization framework for designing robot tools from scratch that jointly optimizes tool structure, shape, and action, validated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为HOT的分层优化框架，用于从头设计机器人工具，联合优化工具的结构、形状和动作，并在仿真和真实机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 为某项任务设计工具的能力，标志着一种超越单纯理解、选择或使用的智能层次。现有的机器人工具设计方法通常是在预设或预先生成的结构框架内优化工具的连续形状与动作，因此结构本身并未纳入物理优化的循环之中。我们研究从零开始、以任务为导向的工具设计，其中工具的结构、形状与动作均源自期望的物理结果。我们展示了这三要素可通过HOT——一种分层优化方法——实现联合设计，其上层利用BASS搜索离散的工具结构，而下层的物理优化则评估这些结构的任务行为，并将阶段性进展作为行为证据反馈给搜索过程，最终提供联合优化的形状与动作。在四项具有不同物理功能的工具使用任务中，HOT仅在评估了包含多达5600万种结构的搜索空间的一小部分后，便发现了功能性结构；随后对其几何形状的细化，在所有任务上降低了任务损失，同时保持了成功率，且这些变形在功能上具有可解释性。一旦通过3D打印制造出来，这些工具便能使用仿真中发现的动作，在真实机器人上完成所有任务。从所需的物理效应而非已知工具目录出发设计工具，是迈向人类与动物所展现的开放式工具制造能力的一步。

title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.
tldr: CATok introduces a causal action tokenizer that uses conditional annealing in flow matching to create a coarse-to-fine discrete token space for autoregressive VLA models, improving reconstruction fidelity and task success rates on simulation and real-world robotic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CATok 提出了一种因果动作分词器，通过流匹配中的条件退火机制构建从粗到细的离散令牌空间，从而提升自回归 VLA 模型的重建保真度和任务成功率。
summary_zh: 自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人学习提供了一条可扩展的路径，然而现有的动作分词器将分词视为压缩问题，所产生的表示在语义上与自回归骨干网络不一致。为此，我们提出CATok，一种因果动作分词器，将分词重新定义为一种因果结构化的生成过程。CATok引入条件退火机制，通过逐步退火流匹配过程来提取动作词元：每个词元以所有先前词元为条件，并在特定噪声水平下编码残差重构信号，从而构建从粗到细的因果词元空间，其生成语义与自回归建模在结构上保持一致。基于多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）构建的词元条件流匹配解码器，以混合扩散头架构的精度，从这些离散词元中重构连续动作片段。该离散瓶颈通过设计实现知识隔离，在不依赖显式注意力掩码的情况下，将高层语义推理与低层运动执行清晰分离。在三个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，CATok在重构保真度-压缩权衡和推理效率方面均持续优于现有分词方法，同时提升了VLA任务成功率与训练效率，为纯自回归VLA系统奠定了高性能、可扩展的基础。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.
tldr: Uni-VLaT integrates whole-body tactile sensing into VLA policies via a predictive tactile pathway, improving contact-rich humanoid loco-manipulation on real robots.
tldr_zh: Uni-VLaT 通过预测性触觉通路将全身触觉感知集成到 VLA 策略中，提升了真实机器人上的接触丰富型人形移动操作能力。
summary_zh: 物理接触往往决定了人形机器人在移动操作过程中应如何作出响应，然而仅依靠视觉和本体感觉通常不足以刻画物理交互，尤其是在接触区域被遮挡的情况下。与仅在预定区域进行稀疏力或力矩测量不同，分布式触觉传感能够保留覆盖机器人全身的、具有空间分辨率的接触模式。因此，我们研究如何将这种全身触觉信息整合到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，以实现接触丰富的控制。我们提出的方法Uni-VLaT引入了一条触觉通路，其潜在状态不仅用于动作生成，还用于预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征。该预测目标构建了以触觉为锚点的多模态上下文，促进了对物理世界更具结构化的理解。我们在五个真实机器人任务上评估了Uni-VLaT，涵盖触觉触发的 locomotion、持续物理交互、人机接触以及移动操作。Uni-VLaT实现了75%的平均成功率，较无触觉输入的基线高出43个百分点，较有触觉输入但无预测监督的基线高出7个百分点。在两种预训练的VLA骨干网络上，我们的方法在桌面清扫任务上均提升了30个百分点，在背部触碰行走任务上提升了85至90个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，情境化的触觉预测和绝对未来目标对性能至关重要。这些结果表明，预测性触觉学习为将预训练的VLA策略推广至全身物理交互提供了一条有效途径。

title: Passive-Dynamic-Walking-Inspired Dynamics Guidance for Energy-Efficient Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Learning energy-efficient humanoid locomotion requires discovering mechanically economical gait coordination, not merely reducing actuator effort. Reinforcement learning promotes efficiency through effort-related reward penalties, which guide the step-to-step mechanics of walking only indirectly. This article proposes a framework inspired by passive dynamic walking (PDW) that temporarily creates slope-equivalent conditions favorable to economical gait discovery and removes all PDW-specific guidance before nominal-dynamics optimization. During early training, a tilted-gravity field assists sagittal progression on flat collision geometry, complemented by curriculum-coupled reward terms. The core framework requires no reference trajectories, gait phases, or contact schedules. In a five-seed forward-locomotion study on a 29-DoF Unitree G1, the framework reduces mechanical cost of transport by 6.8-15.2% over commanded speeds of 0.5-2.0m/s without degrading velocity tracking. Mechanical-work decomposition attributes the reduction to positive actuator work, and reward-matched comparisons separate the guided regime's faster gait acquisition from the tilt's additional benefit to converged economy. The framework extends to unassisted omnidirectional locomotion, where its benefit persists once a walking-specific motion prior supplies kinematic coordination, the combination reducing speed-matched cost of transport by 18.7%. On hardware, forward cost of transport falls by 16.3% with the motion prior and by 4.5% without it, the latter within the trial-to-trial spread.
tldr: The paper proposes a Passive-Dynamic-Walking-inspired framework that uses a temporary tilted gravity field during early RL training to discover energy-efficient gait coordination for humanoid locomotion, reducing mechanical cost of transport on a Unitree G1 without reference trajectories.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种受被动动态行走启发的框架，通过在早期强化学习训练中临时使用倾斜重力场来发现人形机器人行走的节能步态协调，在不使用参考轨迹的情况下降低了 Unitree G1 的机械运输成本。
summary_zh: 学习节能型人形机器人 locomotion 需要发现机械上经济的步态协调方式，而不仅仅是降低执行器出力。强化学习通过引入与能耗相关的奖励惩罚来促进效率，这些惩罚只能间接引导行走的逐步力学过程。本文提出一种受被动动态行走（PDW）启发的框架，该框架在名义动力学优化之前，暂时创造有利于经济步态发现的等效斜坡条件，并移除所有 PDW 特定的引导项。在训练早期，倾斜重力场在平坦碰撞几何上辅助矢状面前行，并结合课程式奖励项进行补充。该核心框架不需要参考轨迹、步态相位或接触时间表。在29自由度 Unitree G1 上进行的五随机种子前行 locomotion 研究中，该框架在指令速度 0.5–2.0 m/s 范围内将机械运输成本降低了 6.8%–15.2%，且未降低速度跟踪性能。机械功分解表明，该降低来自正执行器功的减少；奖励匹配对比进一步区分了引导机制带来的更快步态习得与倾斜场对收敛经济性的额外增益。该框架还可扩展到无辅助的全向 locomotion，在行走特定运动先验提供运动学协调后，其优势依然存在，两者结合将速度匹配的运输成本降低了 18.7%。在硬件实验中，有运动先验时前行运输成本降低 16.3%，无先验时降低 4.5%，后者处于试验间波动范围之内。

title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
summary: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.
tldr: P2P-T introduces a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool manipulation from human demonstrations by pretraining a world model to extract pose priors and integrating them into a pose-aware low-level policy, achieving a 73% improvement over prior state-of-the-art on real-world tool manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: P2P-T提出了一个数据高效、以对象为中心的框架，通过预训练世界模型提取位姿先验，并将其集成到位姿感知的低层策略中，从人类演示中学习工具操作，在真实世界工具操作任务上比先前最先进方法提升了73%。
summary_zh: 扩展机器人操作规模的主要瓶颈在于真实世界机器人数据的稀缺性。尽管近期一些方法利用人类视频示范来缓解这一短缺，但这些方法计算成本高昂，且仍依赖配对的人机数据进行领域对齐。虽然当前最先进的方法在长时程任务中表现出色，但在复杂工具操作所需的精细和精确控制方面仍力有不逮。为克服这些局限，我们提出P2P-T（从像素到工具操作位姿），一种数据高效、以对象为中心的框架，可直接从人类示范中学习工具使用。P2P-T通过两阶段方法弥合认知与物理执行之间的鸿沟：首先，预训练一个以对象为中心的世界模型以提取稳定的位姿先验；其次，将这些先验集成到一个高效的、位姿感知的低层级策略中。借助由现代基础模型驱动的稳健自动化数据处理流水线，P2P-T完全绕开了人机对齐数据的需求，从而大幅降低了整体训练开销。在最小化每任务微调的情况下，我们的框架在复杂的真实世界工具操作任务上，相较先前最先进方法在执行性能上实现了73%的提升，而这些任务目前仍超出大规模预训练模型的能力范围。

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
summary: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.
tldr: DexAgent is an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts single egocentric human videos into physically grounded robot trajectories for dexterous manipulation, using a self-evolving tool library and property-specific verifiers to handle diverse objects and long-horizon tasks, achieving 3.5x higher success rates than baselines in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: DexAgent 是一个智能体化的 Human2Sim2Robot 框架，将单个第一人称人类视频转换为物理可行的机器人轨迹用于灵巧操作，通过自进化工具库和属性特定验证器处理多样物体和长时程任务，在真实任务中成功率比基线高 3.5 倍。
summary_zh: 人类视频为灵巧机器人操作提供了可扩展的示范数据来源。然而，现有的人-仿真-机器人（Human2Sim2Robot）流程依赖于预定义的程序，难以适应多样的物体属性和交互场景，尤其是涉及关节物体和可变形物体的情形。我们提出了DexAgent，一个智能体化的Human2Sim2Robot框架，能够将单段第一视角人类视频和任务提示转化为物理可实现的机器人轨迹，用于策略训练。该框架通过四个阶段运行：人类视频语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化以及机器人数据生成。在每个阶段，DexAgent通过从工具库中选择合适的技能，或在必要时开发新技能，来适应任务和物体属性。属性特定的验证器对各阶段输出进行物理有效性和任务特定要求的评估，并提供反馈以进行改进，从而防止错误在流程中传播。这种自适应且由验证引导的流程使DexAgent能够处理多样化的物体和长期任务。在最终阶段，DexAgent在仿真中改变物体和机器人状态，从单段人类视频生成多样化的机器人轨迹，然后对渲染观测进行重新纹理化，以促进仿真到真实的迁移。新开发的技能和验证器会被保留在工具库中，使其能够自我进化，积累可复用的能力。这减少了DexAgent在处理更多人类视频时的处理时间。在十一个真实世界任务中，使用DexAgent生成的数据训练的策略，其成功率比对照基线高出3.5倍。项目网站：https://dexagent123.github.io/。

title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
summary: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.
tldr: RoGSW4RLD is a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera video world model rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field, improving cross-view consistency and spatial accuracy for robot world model predictions.
tldr_zh: RoGSW4RLD 是一个前馈框架，将同步多摄像头视频世界模型生成的结果提升为统一的、可按时间查询的度量 4D 高斯场，从而提高机器人世界模型预测的跨视角一致性和空间精度。
