summary_zh: 动作条件下的视频世界模型能够从多个摄像头预测未来的机器人交互，但其输出仍然是彼此分离的视频集合，而非可在不同视角和时间上查询的共享度量场景。尽管现有的4D重建方法为将这些预测空间化提供了途径，但独立重建并合并每个摄像头流无法确保跨视角一致性。这一局限在结合机器人搭载的移动摄像头与固定外部视图时尤为不利。为解决这一问题，我们提出RoGSW4RLD，一种前馈框架，可将同步的多摄像头展开序列提升为统一的、可时间查询的度量4D高斯场。RoGSW4RLD并非学习独立的几何转移模型，而是直接重建现有世界模型生成的视觉未来。其核心创新在于两阶段架构：第一阶段通过融合跨视角证据与机器人特定的关节几何和运动学，联合构建度量4D场；第二阶段在严格保持初始时间位移的同时，细化该场的几何与外观。在256个保留的DROID片段上进行评估，RoGSW4RLD显著优于逐摄像头重建配合校准合并的方法，将新视角PSNR提升2.15 dB，深度AbsRel降低47%，机器人位移误差减少61%。这些显著改进同样适用于动作条件下的Cosmos 3展开序列，表明预测的视频未来可成功转化为一致、可空间查询的4D度量表示。

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.
tldr: NUDGE is a training-free, reactive obstacle-avoidance method that injects signed distance field gradients into diffusion or flow-matching robot policies at inference, supporting common action parameterizations and preserving task distribution.
tldr_zh: NUDGE 是一种无需训练的反应式避障方法，在推理时将符号距离场梯度注入扩散或流匹配机器人策略，支持常见动作参数化并保持任务分布。
summary_zh: 我们提出了NUDGE（基于可微几何的轻推更新）方法，这是一种无需训练的避障程序，可集成到任何基于扩散或流匹配的机器人策略中，包括扩散策略和视觉-语言-动作模型。我们的方法在推理时将符号距离场（一种返回每个点到最近障碍物距离的函数）的梯度注入策略中，以引导其避开障碍物。它通过可微的关节轨迹解码器，支持从绝对或相对关节位姿到末端执行器位姿的任何常见动作参数化。实验表明，NUDGE能够保持策略的任务分布，并实现实时响应。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT
tldr: ReCAT introduces a language-conditioned robot manipulation policy with structured recurrent memory (Mamba-2 plus causal attention) that outperforms baselines on memory-dependent tasks requiring recall, counting, and timing, achieving high success on LIBERO, RMBench, and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: ReCAT提出了一种具有结构化循环记忆（Mamba-2加因果注意力）的语言条件机器人操作策略，在需要记忆、计数和计时的任务上优于基线，在LIBERO、RMBench和真实机器人实验中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 依赖记忆的操作要求机器人利用当前传感器无法获取的信息进行决策，例如回忆先前看到的视觉线索、跟踪任务进度、计数重复事件或估算经过的时间。我们提出了ReCAT，一种具有结构化循环记忆的语言条件策略。指令条件编码器从当前观测中提取特征，循环记忆通过Mamba-2层和一层因果注意力整合观测流。流匹配Transformer解码器在每个模块中通过独立的交叉注意力读取当前表示和历史表示。ReCAT在LIBERO上达到95.3%的平均成功率，在RMBench上达到62.4%，在九个任务中的六个上取得最佳或并列最佳结果。在涉及空间回忆、事件计数和时间间隔估计的三项真实机器人任务中，最佳的ReCAT变体达到66.7%的平均成功率，而最强的短历史基线仅为8.3%。ReCAT内部的受控比较表明，观测编码器和每个模块的记忆条件化对于实现该性能是必需的。这些比较还表明，为高效序列建模而设计的更新规则在作为机器人记忆时表现出不同特性：加性更新在计数和计时任务中取得最高成功率，而delta规则更新在空间回忆任务中表现最佳。项目网站位于https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
tldr: EMPIRIC learns residual world models by extending a physics engine with learned programs for missing mechanisms, enabling a robot to predict outcomes, plan experiments, and solve tasks with fewer interactions.
tldr_zh: EMPIRIC 通过学习残差世界模型，用程序扩展物理引擎以覆盖缺失机制，使机器人能预测结果、规划实验，并以更少交互完成任务。
summary_zh: 一个机器人应当能够通过实验来学习陌生物体的行为及其相互作用方式，并利用所学知识进行规划。它无需从零开始：物理引擎提供了运动和接触方面的知识，但可能遗漏某些完整的机制，例如胶水固化、水加热或风力作用。我们提出了EMPIRIC——一种学习残差世界模型的智能体：该模型以物理引擎为基础，并附加代码以补全缺失的机制。所学习的程序能够引入新的力、约束和隐藏状态，而贝叶斯推断则可根据含噪声的观测估计其参数和状态。由此得到的模型使智能体能够预测行动结果、选择信息量丰富的实验，并在预测失败时修正其假设。在五个模拟领域中，EMPIRIC学习了可解释且可复用的模型，并以比三种基线方法更少的环境交互解决了更多任务。在实体机器人上，它学会了风力作用和多米诺骨牌的质量，从而完成了一项操作任务。网站及代码：https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric

title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.
tldr: This paper introduces Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed output interface for VLA policies that allows them to abstain from acting under uncertainty, demonstrating improved reliability in robotic harvesting under occlusion without retraining the backbone.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了可拒绝且校准的决策头（RCDH），为VLA策略提供了一种类型化输出接口，使其在不确定性下能够放弃行动，并在遮挡条件下的机器人采摘中展示了更高的可靠性，且无需重新训练骨干网络。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过行为克隆或流匹配进行训练，其优化目标为输出动作轨迹，但无法表达“我不知道”或“我不应行动”。在机器人采摘中，遮挡使得单帧决策存在根本性模糊：相同的像素既可以对应可切割的茎，也可能完全不存在茎。现有VLA被迫做出决策，导致高置信度的错误并产生不可逆后果。我们认为，VLA的失效模式并非由主干网络规模决定，而是由其输出接口决定。我们提出可拒绝且校准的决策头（RCDH），这是一种带类型、可拒绝且经过校准的输出接口，可附加到冻结的VLA主干网络上，无需重新训练或新增特征。RCDH引入了（i）具有显式拒绝和有序、条件分解的决策模式，以及（ii）用于风险感知弃权的校准流程。我们在具有可控叶片遮挡的机器人采摘平台上评估RCDH，比较了生成式、枚举式、校准式和可拒绝式接口。我们表明，仅替换输出头即可在遮挡条件下恢复分布外可用性，同时保持分布内性能。我们进一步测试了拒绝空间的有序性是否关键。我们的结果表明，拒绝的权利——而非更大的模型——才是不确定性条件下可靠操作所缺失的接口。

title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
summary: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.
tldr: JRDB-AVR is a benchmark for active visual reasoning in embodied agents, built from real-world JRDB robotics data, that evaluates both final answers and the grounded visual evidence acquired through bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle. The authors also present JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference agent using a graph-based world model, and show that current VLMs often produce unsupported correct answers.
tldr_zh: JRDB-AVR 是一个面向具身代理的主动视觉推理基准，基于真实 JRDB 机器人数据，通过限时和视角的观察来评估最终答案及其视觉证据。作者还提出了 JRDB-AVR-Agent 参考代理，并揭示了当前 VLM 常生成无证据支持的正确答案。
summary_zh: 在复杂的具身视觉推理场景中，智能体通常仅具有有限的视野，而回答问题所需的证据可能分布在时间、视角和交互对象之间。因此，模型可能在从未观察到相关对象、时间或视角的情况下给出看似合理的答案。当前的视觉推理基准大多评估被动观察和最终答案，忽视了需要主动推理和证据获取的场景。我们提出了JRDB-AVR，一个通过结构化问题生成引擎从现有真实世界JRDB机器人数据中构建的基准，将这一差距转化为明确的评估：具身智能体系统接收视觉推理问题，按时间戳和视角请求有限观测，并同时对最终答案及其支持的基于视觉的证据进行评估。该基准包含多个真实世界环境中涉及时间搜索、视角选择和面向人的组合推理的多样化问题。我们还介绍了JRDB-AVR-Agent，一种参考型主动推理智能体方法，该方法维护一个显式的基于观测证据的图结构世界模型，并通过求解来回答问题。实验揭示了当前基线在答案准确性和证据准确性之间存在显著差距，表明当前视觉语言模型（VLM）可能产生无证据支持的正确答案，且主动的、面向证据的评估对于具身视觉推理是必要的。代码和基准可在https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR获取。

title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during training. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during inference is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: environmental perturbation, data efficiency, and task generalization. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from preparing the future, not generating it. We therefore propose Simple-WAM, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/
tldr: This paper investigates why world action models (WAMs) generalize, finding that the benefit comes from preparing future representations via a single denoising step, and proposes Simple-WAM, which achieves explicit WAM generalization with latent WAM efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了世界动作模型（WAM）泛化的原因，发现其收益来自单步去噪的未来表示准备，并提出了Simple-WAM，在保持显式WAM泛化性能的同时具备潜在WAM的效率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）在训练期间随动作一同预测未来。由于视频去噪的计算成本高昂，推理阶段是否仍需生成未来存在争议：显式WAMs在每个动作块中将其去噪为干净帧，而潜变量WAMs则完全舍弃未来以加速。我们发现，尽管潜变量WAMs在分布内任务上与显式WAMs表现相当，但它们未能保留最初促使WAMs提出的泛化优势。为证明这一点，我们从三个维度评估泛化能力：环境扰动、数据效率和任务泛化。在匹配骨干网络、训练数据和计算预算的受控比较中，当动作专家不再以未来表示为条件时，三个维度均出现一致的性能下降。进一步分析表明，这一差距几乎完全源于第一步去噪：其益处在于准备未来，而非生成未来。因此，我们提出Simple-WAM，将未来建模简化为对完全噪声化视频标记的单次前向传播，并将训练时的噪声调度适配至该推理行为。在仿真和真实世界任务中，Simple-WAM兼得二者之长，在泛化性能上超越显式WAMs，同时效率与潜变量WAMs相当。项目主页：https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/

title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.
tldr: RoboFL introduces a federated learning framework for world-action models, using a Mixture of Slotted Adapters (MoSAIC) with server-side routing and a Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation method to efficiently assemble locally trained LoRA adapters into a global policy, improving performance on simulated and real robot manipulation tasks while drastically reducing communication costs.
tldr_zh: RoboFL提出了一种用于世界动作模型的联邦学习框架，通过Mixture of Slotted Adapters (MoSAIC)和路径共识专家聚合方法，将本地训练的LoRA适配器高效组装成全局策略，在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中提升了性能，同时大幅降低了通信成本。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型日益流行，但其发展仍受制于物理交互数据的瓶颈——这类数据稀缺、机构间孤立且任务异构。一种自然的联邦学习解决方案是让每个客户端通过参数高效微调来适配共享的基础模型，从而避免交换完整的模型更新。然而，对这些适配器进行联邦聚合并非易事：简单聚合可能纠缠不兼容的更新，而将MoE（混合专家）风格的路由引入联邦聚合又可能稀释专家特化并破坏专家选择的稳定性。我们提出RoboFL，它实现了MoSAIC（槽位适配器混合体）用于联邦世界-动作学习。MoSAIC直接将本地训练的LoRA适配器作为服务器端MoE的专家分支安装。服务器端路由器学习在这些先验信息引导的分支上进行token分配，同时联合优化路由和专家参数。前瞻-动作路由蒸馏（FARD）使路由在模型的三个路径间对齐，而路径共识专家聚合（PCEA）将完整的专家更新转换为紧凑的全局适配器，用于个性化再分配。在RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench和真实Franka机器人臂上的实验表明，RoboFL凭借结构化专家组装展现出优越性，在Franka臂上比集中式PEFT InternVLA-A1高出12.23%，同时与基于MoE的联邦VLA基线相比，每轮客户端通信量最多减少86.81%。

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
summary: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose Action Upcycling, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2-1.7x with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.
tldr: This paper introduces Action Upcycling, a training-free algorithm that extends the execution horizon of chunked robot policies by reusing otherwise discarded actions, reducing policy calls by 1.2-1.7x without sacrificing success rate across multiple VLA models and a World Action Model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出动作升级（Action Upcycling）算法，一种无需训练的方法，通过重用原本会被丢弃的动作来延长分块机器人策略的执行范围，在不损失成功率的情况下减少1.2-1.7倍策略调用次数，适用于多种VLA模型和世界动作模型。
summary_zh: 现代机器人策略从单次观测中预测一系列未来动作，仅执行其中的前缀部分，并在重新规划前丢弃其余内容。选择此前缀的长度，即执行时域，需要在反应速度与运行效率之间做出权衡。较短的执行时域能使策略对环境保持反应灵敏，但需要频繁调用策略。近期的测试时方法会为每个动作块自适应选择时域长度，但这些方法要么需要读取模型内部信息（该信号需针对每种架构单独选取），要么需要额外采样，从而增加计算成本。我们提出了“动作升级”（Action Upcycling），一种无需训练的算法，该算法复用策略原本会丢弃的动作，既无需访问模型内部信息，也无需额外采样。研究发现，只要动作速度保持平滑，被丢弃的动作与其重新规划后的版本之间差异就很小。因此，动作升级可将执行时域延长至速度开始波动的临界点。在模拟及真实世界的操作任务上开展的大量实验表明，动作升级在多种视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）乃至世界动作模型（WAM）上，均能将策略调用次数减少1.2至1.7倍，且成功率不下降。该方法适用于任意分块策略，成本可忽略不计，且与其他策略加速方法（如少步采样和流式动作解码）正交，为策略加速开辟了新的维度。

title: ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation
summary: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.
tldr: ECHO introduces a wrist-only latent world action model that leverages event cameras to provide temporal and spatial context (hindsight and outlook) for robust manipulation policies under extreme lighting, outperforming RGB and RGB+event baselines in both simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: ECHO 提出了一种仅依赖腕部事件相机的潜在世界行为模型，通过事后与预瞻模块提供时空上下文，在极端光照下显著优于 RGB 和 RGB+事件基线，并在仿真与真实世界任务中验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 基于RGB相机的学习型操控策略在极端曝光条件下常常因观测质量下降而失效。事件相机通过异步检测像素级强度变化来缓解这一问题，从而提供高动态范围。然而，其观测结果高度依赖相机安装位置，因为固定相机会遗漏静态场景内容，而腕部安装相机的运动又会导致先前访问过的区域移出视野。为解决这些时空局限性，我们提出了ECHO（带有回望与前瞻的事件增强上下文），一种仅依赖腕部相机的潜在世界动作模型，该模型将腕部事件编码为紧凑的运动表示，为策略推理提供时间与空间上下文。具体而言，ECHO利用预训练的事件编码器来解释帧间视觉特征变化。其回望模块通过保留过去的事件流中的夹爪轨迹，作为可寻址的相机外上下文。与此同时，前瞻模块引入了可学习的事件预判查询，并受监督以预测未来动作的事件窗口，从而使策略能够预判即将发生的场景变化。在仅使用腕部相机的RLBench任务评估中，ECHO在正常光照下分别比RGB基线和RGB+事件基线高出20.6和12.0个百分点，在严重曝光降低条件下分别高出14.6和11.3个百分点，同时其性能也超越了使用第三视角相机的RGB参考方法。使用腕载事件相机的真实世界实验验证了在正常及极暗光照下，ECHO在多个任务中均优于仅RGB基线和RGB+事件基线。项目页面位于https://echo-wam.github.io/。

title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.
tldr: CoHuB is a simulation benchmark for evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration tasks under egocentric visual observations, providing synchronized VR-teleoperated demonstrations and revealing challenges for visuomotor policies.
tldr_zh: CoHuB 是一个用于在自我中心视觉观察下评估多人形机器人协作任务的仿真基准，提供了通过 VR 遥操作收集的同步演示，并揭示了视觉运动策略面临的挑战。
summary_zh: 许多人类环境中的物理任务都需要协作，从协助伙伴到共同操作物体。然而，现有人形机器人基准大多侧重于单人形技能，缺乏在自我中心视觉观察下对多人形协作的评估。我们引入了CoHuB（协作式多人形机器人基准），这是一个在自我中心视觉观察下进行多人形协作的模拟基准。CoHuB提供了10项任务，其中八项由两个人形机器人完成，两项由三个人形机器人完成，涵盖了多样化的协作模式。我们还提供了通过多操作员VR遥操作流程采集的同步演示，每位操作员从自我中心视角控制一个人形机器人。使用代表性视觉运动策略进行的实验揭示了不同形式的协调感知与控制中存在的重大挑战。CoHuB为开发和评估多人形协作策略奠定了基础。

title: PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.
tldr: PanoVLN enhances vision-and-language navigation by using panoramic observations with a confidence-guided execution strategy for long-horizon action prediction, improved training routes, and combined semantic-geometric features, achieving SOTA on benchmarks and real-robot deployment.
tldr_zh: PanoVLN 通过全景观察、置信度引导的执行策略、改进的训练路径和语义几何特征融合，提升了视觉语言导航的性能，在基准测试和真实机器人上均取得领先成果。
summary_zh: 近期开发的视觉语言模型（VLMs）推动了视觉与语言导航（VLN）的进展，使模型能够根据视觉观察和语言指令预测导航动作。在本研究中，我们探讨了基于全景观察的VLN，并提出了PanoVLN方法。我们的动机很直接：更完整的视觉上下文应当有助于模型做出更明智的导航决策。例如，全景图像可以显示透视相机视野之外的通道，使模型无需额外探索即可识别预定路线。然而，我们发现仅仅将透视图像替换为全景图像只能带来有限的性能提升。我们的诊断表明，充分利用更广的可视范围需要对动作预测、训练监督和视觉表示进行调整。首先，更广的视野支持更长时域的动作规划。我们使模型预测更长的动作序列，从而使单一全景图像能够实现更大的转向和后续移动。具体地，我们提出了一种置信度引导执行（CGE）策略，该策略动态决定在重新规划之前执行多少预测动作。其次，更广的视野也带来了更复杂的路线选择。因此，我们构建了具有频繁分支点和清晰指令的训练路线，以针对路线选择提供专门的监督。第三，全景导航需要理解不同视角方向之间的空间关系，而不仅仅是识别单个地标。我们将RGB全景图像中的语义特征与几何特征相结合，以捕捉场景内容和空间布局，且不增加视觉标记数量。基于40亿参数的主干网络和仅RGB输入，PanoVLN在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val-Unseen上的成功率分别超越了先前的最优方法11.9%和8.7%。在四足机器人上进行的真实世界实验进一步表明，与先前的VLN方法相比，我们的方法实现了更快的导航速度，且暂停次数更少。

title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world. See our project page (https://dexweave.github.io) for videos.
tldr: DexWeave is a unified framework for learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations, featuring interaction-consistent motion retargeting and an anatomy-aware Transformer policy, deployed on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid with Inspire hands.
tldr_zh: DexWeave是一个统一的框架，用于从人类演示中学习灵巧的人形机器人移动操作，包括交互一致的运动重定向和解剖感知的Transformer策略，并在真实的Unitree G1人形机器人上进行了部署。
summary_zh: 从人类示范中学习灵巧的人形移动操作，不仅需要迁移人体运动，还需迁移示范行为背后协调的交互结构。这一任务颇具挑战性，原因在于本体差异会扭曲身体运动、腕部位置、手指关节运动与物体交互之间的耦合关系，而运动学上精确的参考轨迹在机器人动力学约束下仍可能难以实现。我们提出了DexWeave，一个将交互一致性运动重定向与解剖感知全身策略学习相统一的框架。DexWeave首先采用两阶段重定向流程，利用专用求解器初始化身体和手部运动，随后在上半身交互链上进行耦合优化，同时保持下半身的支撑作用。所得参考轨迹由一种解剖感知的Transformer策略进行跟踪，该策略将解剖区域表示为结构化标记，并使用定向掩码注意力来建模它们之间的依赖关系，物体信息选择性地作用于上半身通路以实现灵巧交互。该策略联合输出身体和灵巧手动作，并直接通过强化学习训练，无需预训练的跟踪策略、师生蒸馏或后续残差优化。与MLP基线相比，DexWeave在提高重定向保真度和交互一致性的同时，实现了更高的操作性能和更快的策略收敛速度。我们进一步将所学策略部署到配备Inspire灵巧手的实体Unitree G1人形机器人上，在真实世界中实现了灵巧的全身移动操作。视频请参见我们的项目页面（https://dexweave.github.io）。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.
tldr: This paper introduces an evaluation framework for VLA models that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability, showing that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs, and that these metrics improve policy-failure prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于VLA模型的评估框架，将预测精度、目标状态响应性和上下文稳定性分离，证明高自然轨迹精度可以与弱受控目标状态响应性共存，这些指标可改善策略失败预测。
summary_zh: 准确解码视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部表征中的物体状态，并不能证明其预测结果对目标物理状态的变化作出了忠实响应。在自然观察中，物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡和任务进度会同时变化，从而使得上下文线索可能对预测产生贡献。本文提出了一种评估框架，该框架通过将目标坐标与机器人上下文进行交叉的物理验证观测，来分离预测准确性、目标状态响应性和上下文稳定性三个维度。我们证明，在固定的表征-读出配对中，高自然轨迹准确性可能与较弱的目标状态受控响应性并存。对表征、读出机制及训练数据所进行的比较和干预实验表明，这三项属性提供了各自独立的诊断信息。此外，在基于初始状态误差和物理变量的故障预测器中加入响应性及上下文敏感性，能够在新的初始条件下，相对于指定基线降低策略故障预测误差，同时同观测条件下的受控平均绝对误差（MAE）也具有信息价值。上述发现提示，在评估自然预测准确性的同时，还应对目标状态响应性和上下文稳定性进行考察，并探讨它们与实际策略行为及任务结果之间的关系。

title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.
tldr: Ledger pairs an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory built from a SAM3 tracker and VLM captioner, read by an LLM planner, to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation in memory-augmented VLAs.
tldr_zh: Ledger 将策略内的帧采样记忆与由 SAM3 跟踪器和 VLM 描述器构建的外部时空对象记忆相结合，并由 LLM 规划器读取，以改进记忆增强型 VLA 在长时程机器人操作中的表现。
summary_zh: 记忆对于长时程、部分可观测的机器人操作任务至关重要：机器人必须记住哪个物体被放入了抽屉、它移动了谁的杯子、或者已经过去了多少个动作周期。最近的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将记忆直接嵌入策略内部，但基准测试显示，没有任何单一的策略内机制能够覆盖所有时空维度，与最优方法相比仍存在较大差距。我们认为，记忆类型决定了记忆应存放的位置：短期感知记忆（重复、计时、回溯）应位于策略内部，而长期物体记忆（持久空间状态、包含关系、事件历史）则应作为显式、可读的记录存放于策略外部。我们提出Ledger，一种通过将策略内帧采样记忆与外部时空物体记忆（即分类账）配对，在单一微调$π_{0.5}$策略上实现这种分离的框架；该外部记忆由SAM3跟踪器和VLM描述器从演示中构建，并由LLM规划器在步骤边界处读取以做出决策。在RoboMME上，Ledger在被评估方法中取得了最高的四套件平均分，达到64.3%（而在相同评估条件下，此前最强方法为45.9%），在物体引用（60.7%对40.3%）和物体持久性（86.7%对56.2%）方面均领先，且仅使用一组权重。在运行时根据指令和记录选择记忆来源，无需任务级路由器。

title: Model-Informed Safe Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion via Step-to-Step Prediction
summary: Humanoid robots promise versatile mobility in cluttered, human-centric environments, but real deployment demands principled safety. Classical model-based gait generators yield interpretable motions but often lack the robustness and adaptability of modern reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches. We propose a model-informed reinforcement learning framework anchored to the analytical Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP) template. We provide a step-to-step safety certificate for ALIP stepping via a discrete exponential control barrier function (DECBF) and use it as (i) a training-time shaping signal and (ii) a runtime action filter that minimally adjusts swing-foot placement to satisfy template-level constraints. Full-order safety is evaluated empirically on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo with a whole-body controller stack. Compared to an unconstrained baseline, our approach reduces safety-violation events in the reported external-disturbance trial, while larger lateral-velocity transients reveal a safety-tracking tradeoff.
tldr: This paper proposes a model-informed safe RL framework for bipedal locomotion, using an analytical ALIP template with a DECBF to provide step-to-step safety certificates. The method integrates the safety certificate as a training-time shaping signal and a runtime action filter, and validates it on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo, showing reduced safety violations compared to an unconstrained baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模型信息的双足运动安全强化学习框架，利用ALIP模板和离散指数控制障碍函数提供步态级安全证书，并将其作为训练塑形信号和运行时动作过滤器，在MuJoCo中的Digit人形机器人上验证了减少安全违规的效果。
summary_zh: 人形机器人在杂乱、以人为中心的环境中承诺提供多功能移动性，但实际部署要求有原则性的安全保障。经典的基于模型的步态生成器能产生可解释的运动，但往往缺乏现代基于强化学习（RL）方法所需的鲁棒性和适应性。我们提出了一种模型引导的强化学习框架，以解析的角动量线性倒立摆（ALIP）模板为核心。我们通过离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）为ALIP步态提供了逐步安全证书，并将其用作（i）训练时的塑形信号和（ii）运行时动作过滤器，以最小程度地调整摆动脚位置，满足模板层面的约束。在MuJoCo中结合全身控制器堆栈对Digit人形机器人进行了全阶安全性实证评估。与未经约束的基线相比，我们的方法在报告的外部扰动试验中减少了安全违规事件，而更大的横向速度瞬态则揭示了安全与跟踪之间的权衡。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
summary: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.
tldr: This paper proposes CF-WAM, a World Action Model framework that dynamically generates multiple projections (visual, semantic, geometric, interaction) of the same future action-conditioned state in a unified video format, improving action learning and cross-embodiment generalization across human and robot data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CF-WAM，一种世界动作模型框架，通过动态生成同一未来动作状态的多种投影（视觉、语义、几何、交互）并统一为视频形式，提升动作学习效率及跨具身泛化能力。
summary_zh: 预测下一状态是世界模型模拟物理动力学的核心范式，强调预测的保真度。随着世界模型演进为世界-动作模型（WAMs），现有方法仍在下游任务训练前将下一状态固定为RGB图像、单一潜特征或预定义目标的静态组合，从而将动作学习限制在特定表征所保留的归纳偏置中。为解决这一局限，我们提出CF-WAM，一种动态下一状态预测框架，该框架对同一未来状态采样视觉、语义、几何和交互投影，将其标准化为统一的视频形式，并跨这些投影监督统一的WAM。这些投影所暴露的与动作相关的约束在训练步骤中累积，迫使WAM捕获支撑同一动作条件下未来状态的多重投影的底层状态转移结构。这一动态机制也为人类和机器人学习提供了自然的跨具身动力学参考框架。通过跨不同下一状态参数化的联合学习，异构的人类和机器人经验能够绕过外观差异，直接贡献于共享的状态转移学习，从而提升跨具身泛化能力。实验表明，CF-WAM同时提升了训练效率和最终控制性能，并有效将人类经验转化为策略增益。CF-WAM在RoboCasa-GR1上取得了最先进的性能，平均成功率达82.50%，在LIBERO-Plus上达到82.65%，在真实世界评估中高达84.00%。

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.
tldr: This paper introduces RoboIRGBench, a benchmark for evaluating implicit referential grounding in VLA models, revealing that models perform significantly worse when task-relevant information is implicit rather than explicit, with validations on both simulation and a real Franka robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 RoboIRGBench，一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中隐式指称接地能力的基准，揭示了模型在隐式指令下性能显著下降，并在仿真和真实Franka机器人上验证了这一差距。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出强大的能力，然而现有基准通常假设任务相关信息已在指令中明确给出。然而在实际应用中，人类常常隐式地指代物体、数量及关系，要求机器人从语言和感知上下文中恢复出预期目标。我们将这种能力定义为隐式指代接地（IRG），并提出了RoboIRG-Bench，一个旨在系统评估该能力的操作基准。基于RoboMME构建，RoboIRG-Bench包含源自11个任务的40个变体，涵盖四种挑战：直接指代接地、推理中介指代接地、空间指代接地和上下文指代接地。由于IRG通常需要保留并检索先前建立的上下文，我们评估了跨越不同记忆机制的代表性VLA模型。评估结果揭示出明显的指代鲁棒性差距：在显式指令下表现良好的模型，在同一任务相关信息需要从上下文中恢复时，性能可能急剧下降。推理中介和空间指代尤为具有挑战性，而使用外部VLM的模型表现出更强的鲁棒性，但仍存在显著失败。此外，将外部VLM替换为更强的模型并不能消除这些差距。我们进一步在Franka Research 3机械臂上验证了这些发现，发现该差距在真实世界操作中依然存在，并同时表现为错误的指代接地和下游执行失败。这些结果确立了IRG作为实现可靠机器人指令跟随的一项独特且尚未充分探索的能力，并凸显了开发能够稳健整合语言、感知、推理和动作的VLA模型的必要性。

title: LRC-JEPA: Disentangling Dynamics and Residual Context for Efficient World Models
summary: Compact JEPA world models enable efficient latent-space planning, but low-dimensional representation trained under reward-free self-supervision must encode both action-conditioned dynamics and predictable visual context. This competition can entangle controllable state with high-rank nuisance appearance and degrade planning as scenes become more complex. We introduce LRC-JEPA, a lightweight end-to-end world model that routes information into a compact predictive latent $\mathbf{z}$ and learned-query residual-context embeddings $\mathbf{u}$. Only $\mathbf{z}$ is propagated by the dynamics model and used for planning, while $\mathbf{u}$ captures temporally persistent information for cross-attention reconstruction; a differentiable residual connection encourages the latent to retain complementary dynamic content. Under explicit assumptions, we show that the resulting representation is sufficient, minimal, nuisance-invariant, and disentangled. Across four simulated control environments, LRC-JEPA improves average planning success over a parameter-matched JEPA baseline by 9 percentage points and matches or exceeds substantially larger pretrained models. On the real-world Bridge-v2 set, its 5.5M-parameter active encoder outperforms DINO-WM (22.1M) and V-JEPA2 (303.9M) encoders while also enabling faster planning. Physical-state probes, reconstruction interventions, and ablations confirm the effectiveness of LRC-JEPA's representation disentanglement.
tldr: LRC-JEPA introduces a world model that disentangles action-conditioned dynamics from residual visual context, improving planning efficiency and success in simulated and real-world control tasks.
tldr_zh: LRC-JEPA 提出了一种世界模型，将动作条件动态与残余视觉上下文解耦，从而提高了模拟和真实控制任务中的规划效率和成功率。
summary_zh: 紧凑型JEPA世界模型能够实现高效的潜在空间规划，但在无奖励自监督条件下训练得到的低维表示必须同时编码基于动作的条件动力学和可预测的视觉上下文。这种竞争可能将可控状态与高秩噪声外观纠缠在一起，并随着场景复杂度增加而降低规划性能。我们提出LRC-JEPA，一种轻量级端到端世界模型，将信息路由到紧凑的预测潜在变量$\mathbf{z}$和基于学习查询的残差上下文嵌入$\mathbf{u}$中。只有$\mathbf{z}$由动力学模型传播并用于规划，而$\mathbf{u}$捕获时间上持久的信息用于交叉注意力重建；可微分的残差连接鼓励潜在变量保留互补的动态内容。在明确假设下，我们证明所得表示是充分的、最小化的、噪声不变的且解缠的。在四个模拟控制环境中，LRC-JEPA相对于参数匹配的JEPA基线将平均规划成功率提高了9个百分点，并达到或超过了规模显著更大的预训练模型。在真实世界的Bridge-v2数据集上，其5.5M参数的主动编码器优于DINO-WM（22.1M）和V-JEPA2（303.9M）编码器，同时实现了更快的规划速度。物理状态探针、重建干预和消融实验证实了LRC-JEPA表示解缠的有效性。

title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.
tldr: FutureDuet decouples observation access from future supervision in World Action Models, assigning distinct future prediction objectives to main and wrist camera streams to improve robot manipulation performance on RoboTwin50 and LIBERO benchmarks without adding inference overhead.
tldr_zh: FutureDuet在世界动作模型中解耦观测访问与未来监督，为主摄像头和腕部摄像头分配不同的未来预测目标，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升机器人操作性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过引入未来视觉监督来增强机器人动作生成能力。现有WAMs通常将主相机与腕部相机的观测合并为单一视觉流，并采用相同的未来视频目标进行训练，尽管两者的视觉动态特性存在显著差异。稳定的主相机能够展现场景层面的任务演进过程，而腕部相机则随末端执行器运动，将局部交互变化与视角位移及自遮挡现象混杂在一起。这两种截然不同的预测需求表明，两个视角可能受益于不同的未来预测目标。我们提出了FutureDuet方法，该方法在控制阶段同时保留两个视角的信息，同时允许每条视觉流接收不同的未来预测目标。对于主视角，未来RGB图像用于建模任务演进过程，而交互掩码与机器人骨架则将监督重点聚焦于任务对象和机器人运动。对于腕部视角，未来潜变量预测用于建模短时程交互变化，无需进行像素级重建。ActionDiT联合读取由此生成的任务状态与交互状态，将场景级进展与近距离交互证据相结合。所有辅助预测模块仅在训练阶段启用，不增加任何推理开销。FutureDuet在RoboTwin50基准上分别实现了94.2%的干净环境成功率和94.1%的随机化环境成功率，在LIBERO基准上实现了99.2%的平均成功率。在RoboTwin50中六个需要精确交互的任务上，改进效果最为显著，相较于Fast-WAM在干净环境和随机化环境下的平均成功率分别提升了9.2%和12.8%。受控实验进一步证实，分离腕部通路并为两个视角分别设计未来监督目标能够带来互补性的性能增益。

title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
summary: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.
tldr: The paper introduces Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), a framework that uses a vision-language model (VLM) to predict physical events and object trajectories, combined with conformal prediction and backup-based safety filtering, to achieve safety-critical control for robots in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了预测性语义安全（PSS）框架，该框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）预测物理事件和物体轨迹，并结合共形预测和备份安全过滤，实现动态环境中机器人的安全关键控制。
summary_zh: 物理交互可能会引发当前机器人几何环境中不显见的未来危险。我们提出了一种名为预测性语义安全（PSS）的框架，该框架将视觉物理推理与基于备选动作的安全滤波相结合。视觉语言模型（VLM）预测物理事件及其发生时间，或直接预测物体位移。显式运动模型将事件假设转化为物体轨迹。分割共形预测在指定物体、观测时间和未来时间维度上联合校准位置误差；几何形状边界将所得位置区域转换为预测的物体占据空间。PSS针对该占据空间评估预设的备选动作，并推导出输入仿射约束，以在机器人动力学和输入限制下最小程度地修改标称输入，同时保持备选动作的可行性。使用Unitree Go1进行的MuJoCo实验考虑了倾倒固定物、冲击导致的支撑丧失以及接触传播等情况。PSS实现了99.3%的安全回合率，而仅使用当前障碍物几何信息的备选控制屏障函数基线仅为43.3%。

title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.
tldr: This paper introduces TVCache, a training-free token caching framework that exploits text-vision synergy to accelerate Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model inference by selectively filtering attention heads and choosing reuse layers, improving task success rates with reduced computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TVCache，一种无需训练的词元缓存框架，利用文本-视觉协同来加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理，通过选择性过滤注意力头和选择重用层，在降低计算量的同时提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型实现了泛化的机器人控制，但计算成本仍然较高。令牌缓存提供了一种无需训练、即插即用的加速替代方案。然而，现有的VLA缓存并未充分利用VLA模型的一个关键归纳偏置：文本-视觉协同作用，即文本语义引导任务相关区域的精确视觉定位。特别是，现有设计未能充分考虑注意力汇聚中的头级可靠性以及缓存复用中的层间稳定性。为解决这一问题，我们提出文本-视觉协同令牌缓存（TVCache），一种用于高效VLA推理的免训练框架。TVCache基于文本-视觉信息聚焦对注意力头进行筛选，以增强任务相关且物理一致的视觉定位。同时，我们引入一种由文本-视觉熵差引导的复用层选择机制，以避免缓存不稳定表示并优化缓存资源分配。在四个代表性VLA模型、两个仿真基准以及真实机器人任务上的大量实验证明了TVCache的有效性和通用性。在相同令牌保留比率下，TVCache在计算成本相当的情况下持续优于现有VLA缓存的任务成功率。在OpenVLA-OFT上，仅保留12.5%令牌时，相较于VLA-Cache，平均成功率最高提升14.5个百分点，同时相对于全令牌推理，FLOPs降低2.45倍。

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
summary: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive latent safety filter for robotic systems using world models, calibrating safety estimates via directly observed world-model errors with Adaptive Conformal Inference to handle model mismatch and reduce failures in simulation and hardware experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于世界模型的自适应潜在安全滤波器，利用自适应共形推断直接观测世界模型误差来校准安全估计，在模型不匹配时提高谨慎度，并在仿真和硬件实验中减少失败。
summary_zh: 世界模型为高维机器人系统中的安全推理提供了强大的基础，但它们也并非尽善尽美：其预测可能存在偏差、校准不当或过于自信地出错。这给潜在空间安全过滤器带来了核心挑战，此类过滤器通常在世界模型的动力学上学习Hamilton-Jacobi安全价值函数。如果世界模型不准确，所得价值函数可能继承其误差，并产生过度自信的安全估计。现有的潜在安全过滤器往往依赖集成分歧或价值目标一致性残差等辅助信号进行自适应调整，但当世界模型的预测偏离观测结果时，这些信号即使在世界模型出错的情况下也可能保持较小数值。我们提出了一种自适应潜在安全过滤器，利用直接观察到的世界模型误差来校准安全推理。我们的方法采用自适应共形推断，根据预测潜在状态与观测推断潜在状态之间的差异构建在线不确定性集合，然后通过在这些集合上最小化所学价值函数来进行悲观安全评估。这使得过滤器在世界模型准确时保持最小程度的保守性，而在观测揭示模型失配时变得更加谨慎。我们为自适应不确定性半径提供了有限时间覆盖保证。通过仿真和硬件实验，我们证明了相对于最先进的潜在安全过滤器，我们的方法在保持任务完成率的同时显著降低了故障率。

title: TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.
tldr: TLC-DiT is a plug-in extension for Multitask Diffusion Transformer robot policies that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps, improving multitask manipulation robustness and performance on LIBERO and real-world bimanual tasks.
tldr_zh: TLC-DiT 是多任务扩散 Transformer 机器人策略的即插即用扩展，通过添加显式任务导向的局部视觉特征图，提高了在 LIBERO 和真实世界双臂任务中的多任务操作鲁棒性和性能。
summary_zh: 语言条件化机器人策略在多任务操作领域已取得明显进展，但任务相关的局部视觉证据通常仍隐藏于视觉主干网络或注意力层内部。这导致策略难以被检查，且在视觉变化下表现脆弱——这两点正是缺乏显式、任务对齐的局部视觉通道的症状。我们提出TLC-DiT，一种多任务扩散Transformer（DiT）策略的即插即用扩展模块，在不改变扩散目标或动作生成过程的前提下，增加了显式的任务引导局部视觉特征图。对于每个相机视角，冻结的DINOv2补丁特征通过FiLM机制由CLIP任务嵌入进行调制，并经轻量级CoordConv CNN适配器细化为平滑的空间特征图，随后与原始全局图像、语言、关节状态及时间步条件拼接。在LIBERO基准上，TLC-DiT达到93.5%的平均成功率，而多任务DiT为86.5%，SmolVLA为79.25%。在LIBERO-plus上，总成功率从54.07%提升至57.24%，在相机、背景和传感器噪声变化下提升幅度更大。在真实世界双臂任务中，TLC-DiT将茶包放置任务完成率从44%提升至89%，同时保持火柴盒开启任务的相当性能。特征图可视化证实，模型能够跨视角和扰动关注任务相关区域，为检查视觉证据提供了直接途径。

title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
summary: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.
tldr: DTWM is a video world model that conditions a pretrained video diffusion transformer on tactile signals from instrumented gloves to improve egocentric hand motion and contact prediction in manipulation, outperforming vision-only and other visual-tactile baselines.
tldr_zh: DTWM 是一种视频世界模型，通过将预训练的视频扩散变压器与来自数据手套的触觉信号条件化，改善了以自我为中心的操作中的手部运动和接触预测，优于仅视觉和其他视觉触觉基线。
summary_zh: 摘要：用于操作的世界模型通常基于视频进行训练，然而决定操作过程如何展开的事件，例如接触的建立与释放，往往难以通过视觉直接观察，而更容易通过触觉感知。我们提出了灵巧触觉世界模型（Dexterous Tactile World Model, DTWM），这是一个视频世界模型，用于从观测到的视频以及双手佩戴手套所采集的触觉信号中，预测以自我为中心的操作用的未来帧。我们通过零初始化残差将预训练的视频扩散Transformer与每只手的触觉信号进行条件化处理，该残差作用于视频令牌中对应手部位置，同时因果掩码确保预测帧无法访问未来信息。与结构、参数和训练方式相匹配的纯视觉模型相比，DTWM将手部运动的低估从23%降至9%，同时在每种模型的三次训练中，手部区域的感知误差降低了7.4%。该优势随预测时域的延长而增强，后期预测块中的改进幅度约为初始块的4.1倍。DTWM在相同设置下也优于其他视觉-触觉世界模型，并且即使推理时无触觉输入，使用触觉进行训练也能改善未来帧预测。消融实验表明，模型同时受益于力的幅值和空间位置：将触觉信号替换为二值接触状态（无论按手还是按位置）均会增大预测误差。所观测的力的变化过程可指示交互是持续还是发生转变。

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.
tldr: NavHarness is a training-free embodied harness for lifelong navigation that integrates memory processing into the navigation loop, using maps, task records, and experience from previous sessions to improve task success on GOAT-Bench and IR2R-CE.
tldr_zh: NavHarness 是一种无需训练的具身导航框架，将记忆处理整合到导航循环中，利用地图、任务记录和先前会话的经验来提高 GOAT-Bench 和 IR2R-CE 上的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 前沿模型目前可以通过使用简单工具进行多轮多模态推理，在单个具身导航任务中表现出色。然而，在连续任务中，智能体还必须依赖不断更新的地图和早期的搜索记录，而这两者都可能不完整或与新观测相冲突。我们提出NavHarness，一种面向终身导航的免训练具身框架，将记忆处理纳入导航循环之中。在导航过程中，其多轮智能体会话调用地图、任务记录和房屋知识，将其与观测进行核对，并记录修正以指导后续动作。NavHarness将这些经验跨新对话保留下来，用于新任务或恢复尝试，同时通过结果验证和运行结束摘要支持其后续复用。在GOAT-Bench上，NavHarness相较于仅依赖上下文的独立会话，在s-SR上分别提升了18.6个百分点（Astra）和22.6个百分点（Opus 5）。在SLAM估计位姿条件下，搭载GPT-6 Astra的NavHarness在GOAT-Bench上实现了83.7 s-SR和36.9 e-SR的最新任务成功率，在IR2R-CE上实现了85.9 s-SR。为理解这些提升，我们考察了经验如何在会话之间传递，发现结构化恢复交接优于等长摘要。在跨房屋的扩展部署中，整合经验在保留地图和任务记录之外进一步提升了导航性能，案例研究展示了智能体如何利用早期经验来解读新目标、调查未解决问题以及恢复失败的搜索。我们认为，迈向终身导航的进展不仅依赖于单任务能力的提升，更取决于连续推理会话如何在前序经验基础上进行构建。

title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
summary: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.
tldr: RoboICL introduces an embodied in-context learning framework that improves GPT-6 Astra's zero-shot robot manipulation via demonstration context and interaction memory, enhancing performance on RoboDojo benchmarks and real robots without parameter updates.
tldr_zh: RoboICL 提出了一种具身上下文学习框架，通过演示上下文和交互记忆提升 GPT-6 Astra 的零样本机器人操作性能，在 RoboDojo 基准和真实机器人上均有显著改进，且无需参数更新。
summary_zh: 通用视觉-语言模型为零样本机器人控制提供了一种有前景的途径：\gptastra{} 在开放式以及语言或图像条件下的操作任务中表现优异，但在高精度和长时程任务上明显较弱。我们提出了 \emph{RoboICL}，一种基于上下文学习的机器人控制框架，无需针对特定机器人进行参数更新，也无需学习式的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），即可缩小上述差距。RoboICL 将 \emph{示范上下文}（在可用时提供录制示例）与 \emph{交互记忆}（积累模型自身动作及观察结果）分离。两者均采用统一的“观察—动作—反馈—观察”语法结构。为了跨任务阶段保留经验，RoboICL 将采样示范块与有界锚定记忆相结合。固定锚点使得较早的部署交互可供上下文学习使用，而最新交互则支持即时错误修正。在 RoboDojo 的 30 项任务中，Open 类别使用零样本，其余类别使用一个示范，RoboICL 在每一类别上的进度得分较官方零样本 \gptastra{} 提升 20–27 分。它在 Memory 和 Open 类别上领先排行榜基线方法，在 Precision 类别上与最强基线性能相当，在 Long-Horizon 类别上仍保持竞争力。其 30 项任务总分为 50.64，而最强基线为 33.68。在单独的十项任务子集上，RoboICL 得分为 60.60，与 $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} 混合方法相差不超过 2.00 分。在三项真实机器人任务中，平均进度从零样本时的 14.45 提升至单样本时的 63.33，以及三样本时的 78.89。在两项开发任务中，可选的 Jev 门控动作复用将 \gptastra{} 调用次数减少 33–48%。代码已开源，见 \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}。

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.
tldr: This paper introduces WAM-OPD, a method that uses on-policy distillation with prefix-weighted trajectory replay to adapt pretrained world action models to target tasks without additional environment interaction, improving performance while retaining generalist skills.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出WAM-OPD方法，通过带前缀加权轨迹重放的在线策略蒸馏，在无需额外环境交互的情况下将预训练世界动作模型适配到目标任务，提升性能同时保留通用技能。
summary_zh: 预训练世界动作模型（WAMs）在多种机器人操作任务中展现出通用能力，然而如何在不过度削弱预训练技能的前提下，将目标任务性能提升至专家水平仍具挑战性。我们探索了针对WAMs的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，并提出了WAM-OPD框架。WAM-OPD继承了OPD方法的优势，即在学生策略自身诱导的分布下迁移任务特定教师知识，而非直接将学生模型拟合到狭窄的任务特定数据分布上。然而，在闭环操作中，随着学生策略的演化，观测历史随之改变，需要不断生成新的环境交互轨迹以保持在线策略状态。将OPD应用于WAMs需要反复收集数据，即使在仿真环境中也代价高昂，在真实机器人上往往难以实施。为避免蒸馏过程中的重复环境交互，我们引入了前缀加权轨迹重放（PWTR）方法。PWTR使用一个固定的轨迹池，主要包含初始学生策略生成的轨迹，并辅以任务特定教师策略生成的轨迹以扩展轨迹覆盖范围。对于从该轨迹池中重放的每条轨迹，PWTR将当前策略基于连续的存储历史进行条件化，以生成新的去噪路径，并沿这些路径由任务特定教师提供监督信号。尽管这些去噪路径随策略演化而刷新，重放的环境轨迹保持固定不变。因此，PWTR利用基于每个决策前轨迹前缀累积路径得分计算的代理重要性权重，对逐决策蒸馏损失进行重新加权，以缓解由此产生的历史分布偏移。仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法在蒸馏过程中无需额外环境交互即可实现任务适应。在两种实验设置下，WAM-OPD均提升了目标任务性能，同时保持未纳入适应任务上的性能接近初始水平。

title: Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.
tldr: This paper presents a proprioceptive force estimation method for quadruped robots, jointly trained with locomotion policy, that supports both payload accommodation and leash-guided human-robot interaction, with real-world validation on a Unitree Go1.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种四足机器人本体感觉力估计方法，与运动策略联合训练，同时支持负载适应和牵引绳引导的人机交互，并在Unitree Go1上进行了真实世界验证。
summary_zh: 载荷力必须在运动过程中得到适应，而牵引力则可以指定期望的运动。我们研究是否一个共享的三维力估计（以牛顿为单位），通过在持续加载下的本体感觉历史推断而来，能够同时支持这两项任务。一个估计器和一个运动策略通过有监督的力与速度输出以及学习到的潜在上下文进行联合训练。估计的力调节运动，并进一步通过解析映射生成平面速度和偏航角速度指令以用于牵引引导。在持续力的仿真扫描中，各分量力均方根误差的时间均值范围为1.44至2.83牛顿。与域随机化的基线相比，该框架在速度跟踪和基座姿态误差评分上分别降低了21.6%和46.5%，并在独立的持续力测试中将平均生存率从68.29%提升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验展示了静态垂直和水平力估计、携带重量超过70牛顿训练力限制的8.5公斤载荷进行运动，以及使用相同力估计接口进行牵引引导。

title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback. However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.
tldr: This paper introduces a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action (UVTA) model that leverages large-scale human demonstrations with tactile data to improve dexterous robot manipulation, achieving significantly higher success rates than visual-tactile baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出统一视觉-触觉-动作（UVTA）模型，利用大规模人类演示中的触觉数据来提升灵巧机器人操作性能，在成功率上大幅超越视觉-触觉基线方法。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作需要触觉反馈。然而，机器人触觉演示难以规模化，因为灵巧手的遥操作为操作者提供的触觉反馈十分有限。相比之下，人类演示提供了来源更为丰富、可扩展性更强的多样化触觉交互数据。我们基于一个简单的假设：手可以改变，但交互背后的物理规律不变。我们利用人类触觉数据来提升灵巧操作策略。具体而言，我们首先构建了一套触觉动作捕捉系统，能够同步记录图像、触觉信号和手部运动。利用该系统，我们构建了涵盖五个接触密集型任务的UVTA数据集，包含1000次涵盖多种交互模式的人类演示，以及每个任务150次机器人演示。为了将人类交互背后的物理规律迁移到机器人控制中，我们提出了一种统一视觉-触觉-动作模型，该模型将两种具身形态映射到对齐的触觉和动作表示中，并联合预测未来的动作和触觉轨迹。该联合目标使得人类演示能够监督接触感知表征学习，而在部署阶段仅执行机器人动作。在五个任务的实际机器人评估中，我们的方法平均成功率达到70%，优于最强的视觉-触觉基线方法（29%）和消融架构（42%）。随着人类演示数据的增加，性能持续提升，且在每任务1000次演示时未出现饱和现象，验证了可扩展的人类触觉数据对灵巧操作的有效性。项目页面见https://uni-vta.github.io/。

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.
tldr: FailPatch introduces a failure-driven residual patching framework with a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank to improve VLA policy robustness by patching failure-associated action hidden states using only deployment trajectories and successful demonstrations.
tldr_zh: FailPatch提出了一种故障驱动的残差修补框架，通过空门控残差专家库，利用部署轨迹和成功示范修补VLA策略的故障相关动作隐藏状态，从而提升策略鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常通过成功演示进行适配，这些演示提供了直接的动作监督，但很少覆盖易失败的状態。部署中的失败暴露了这些状态，却缺乏传统监督学习所需的纠正动作。我们提出FailPatch，一种基于失败的残差修补框架，将动作监督与执行可靠性监督解耦。成功演示奠定了策略应如何行动的基础，而部署轨迹则指示其行为何时变得不可靠。我们进一步观察到，动作隐藏表示在直接调节动作生成的同时，在可靠状态与失败相关状态之间表现出清晰的线性可分性。基于这些洞见，FailPatch在冻结的VLA策略的动作隐藏空间中引入了一个空门控残差专家库。一个统一的保留-重定向-信任目标在可靠状态下保留原始策略，在失败相关状态下选择残差专家，并在有界干预下将表示从失败区域重定向至成功相关区域。仅使用0.52%的可训练参数，FailPatch在四个长时程RoboTwin任务中，在干净评估下将成功率提升了11.0个百分点，在干净到随机泛化下提升了9.5个百分点，并在三个真实世界任务中较基线提升了16.7个百分点。项目和代码：https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch。

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.
tldr: RAVEL is an asynchronous inference framework that reduces latency in flow-based vision-language-action models by enabling single-step denoising with a rolling buffer and decoupling VLM encoding from action generation via a Fast Observation Pathway, achieving low-latency closed-loop control on simulated and real robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RAVEL 是一种异步推理框架，通过滚动缓冲区实现单步去噪并利用快速观察路径解耦 VLM 编码与动作生成，从而降低基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的延迟，在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中实现低延迟闭环控制。
summary_zh: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作任务中表现出色，但其对计算密集型VLM编码和多步迭代动作生成的依赖，造成了显著的延迟瓶颈。由此产生的推理延迟使得机器人难以快速响应，尤其是在动态环境中。我们通过RAVEL（滚动异步VLA实现低延迟控制）框架解决了这一局限，该异步推理框架同时针对VLM主干网络和动作专家模块的计算瓶颈进行优化。为减少多步动作去噪带来的延迟，RAVEL通过滚动缓冲区携带部分去噪的未来动作，使得近期动作可在单步去噪后即被执行。为避免阻塞于慢速的VLM编码过程，RAVEL将VLM编码与滚动动作生成解耦，使动作专家模块能够利用最新可用的VLM上下文持续运行，同时引入轻量级快速观测通路（FOP）直接将当前观测信息传递给动作专家模块。在仿真及真实世界的操作任务中，RAVEL均持续实现了大幅降低的响应延迟，同时保持底层VLA的任务能力，从而实现高频、响应灵敏的闭环控制。

title: Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.
tldr: This paper introduces a reliability-aware sparse route memory to improve round-trip vision-language navigation, enabling a simulated Unitree Go2 robot to successfully return more often using language-only instructions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于可靠性的稀疏路线记忆方法，用于改善往返视觉语言导航，使模拟的宇树 Go2 机器人在仅使用语言指令的情况下更成功地返回。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）通常被评估为单向任务，尽管部署的机器人在到达目标后可能需要返回。我们研究了连续往返VLN，并诊断了方向可观测性、偏离恢复和终止稳定性方面的失败。我们提出了一种可靠性感知的稀疏路线记忆，将已执行的外出轨迹记录为有序的几何锚点，并通过结构化提示、动作层仲裁和终端验证以逆序查询这些锚点。在50个反向配对的情节中，使用NaVILA和仿真的Unitree Go2，仅依赖语言的返回在22.0%的情节中成功，而我们的在线系统达到了55.1%。在具备精确路线信息的情况下，相同的接口实现了86.0%的成功率，这表明有效的返回既需要准确的信息，也需要对该信息保持一致的行动。剩余的在线差距主要源于几何证据过于不可靠，无法授权干预。这些结果将信息质量、行为一致性和在线可靠性区分为长时程导航中的独立限制因素。

title: Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.
