tldr: This paper introduces a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph and SWRL reasoning stage to provide scene-grounded risk evidence for vision-language driving systems, improving safety-weighted planning on nuReasoning benchmarks over relevance-based retrieval.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入驾驶风险知识图谱和SWRL推理阶段，为视觉语言驾驶系统提供场景级风险证据，在nuReasoning基准上优于基于相关性的检索方法，提升了安全加权规划性能。
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）为视觉-语言驾驶系统提供了访问外部安全知识的途径，然而检索到的风险规则可能虽具相关性却并不适用于当前场景。接收此类知识的视觉-语言模型（VLM）必须在对物体进行 grounding、跨时间绑定实体并在决策前验证关系，这使得风险结论的支持依据隐含不清。我们通过引入驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG）和语义网规则语言（SWRL）推理阶段来解决这一相关性与适用性之间的差距，该阶段置于VLM决策之前。结构化感知实例化场景事实，当规则前件被联合满足时，SWRL规则据此推导出事件和有向风险关系。被识别的事件、绑定的风险关系以及激活规则的语义描述构成了紧凑的证据，用于条件约束VLM和扩散规划器。在nuReasoning上的匹配对比中，与基于相关性检索的基线相比，我们的方法将nuReasoning规划得分（NPS）提高了1.30分，无过错碰撞得分（NC）提高了2.76分。这些提升表明，相对于语义检索的风险知识，适用于场景的风险证据能够改善安全权重的规划性能。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.
tldr: The paper proposes a Quantile Head for VLA models, unifying regression and flow matching under a quantile objective to predict ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass, improving success rates and efficiency on LIBERO benchmarks and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文为VLA模型提出了分位数头，在统一回归和流匹配的目标下预测有序边际动作分位数，在LIBERO基准和真实机器人任务中提高了成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与动作头相结合，用于机器人控制。常见的动作头存在明显局限：点回归仅提供动作分布的点估计，而标准流匹配采样器则需要昂贵的迭代采样。为解决这些局限，我们将回归与流匹配统一在共同目标下，并将其扩展推导出分位数目标。该分位数目标指导了我们分位数头的设计，该分位数头在一次前向传播中预测中位数及正向间隔，从而形成有序的边缘动作分位数。这些分位数支持多种无需重新训练的采样策略，并通过联合监督来训练默认的中位数策略。我们对这种联合监督的局部分析表明，在邻近分位数校准、间隔固定且修正速度匹配的条件下，直接中位数更新的方差低于仅受中位数监督时的方差。实验表明，这种联合监督的中位数策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro以及两项真实机器人任务中，与所比较的方法相比取得了最高的平均成功率，并且在匹配的LIBERO基线中实现了最短的平均任务完成时间；代码可在 https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA 获取。

title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
summary: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.
tldr: The paper proposes learning a visual state estimator for a frozen, differentiable state-based expert policy using both state supervision and an action-consistency loss, demonstrating superior performance over imitation across manipulation tasks and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出为冻结的可微状态专家策略学习视觉状态估计器，结合状态监督和动作一致性损失，在多种操作任务及仿真到现实迁移中优于直接模仿学习。
summary_zh: 模拟训练的操作策略可以利用特权状态信息来学习有效的接触丰富行为，但在实际部署中，系统必须基于部分观测（如带噪声的相机图像）进行决策。一种常见解决方案是师生蒸馏（teacher-student distillation），即训练一个视觉运动策略来复现特权专家模型的动作。这要求学生模型同时推断任务相关状态，并重新学习专家已有的动作映射。另一种替代方案是复用基于状态的专家模型，仅学习一个感知接口，以重建其缺失的状态输入。然而，仅最小化状态估计误差并不一定能最小化由这些估计所引发的下游控制误差。为弥补这一不足，我们训练了一个视觉状态估计器，结合直接状态监督和通过冻结的可微专家模型反向传播的动作一致性损失。通过调度目标函数，首先建立具有物理意义的状态估计，再逐步强调影响专家动作的误差。在五个目标条件化的操作任务中，保留专家模型始终优于从相同专家演示语料库直接进行像素到动作的模仿学习。我们还进一步在实体Panda机器人上验证了仿真到现实的迁移，在不重新训练底层专家模型的情况下实现了76%的成功率。

title: TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.
tldr: TacGooseBumps retrofits normal-only tactile sensors with a passive domed film that encodes shear as pressure-map changes, improving contact-rich manipulation policies without new electronics or metric shear measurement.
tldr_zh: TacGooseBumps 通过在仅法向力触觉传感器上添加被动圆顶薄膜，将剪切力编码为压力图变化，从而在不增加电子设备或精确剪切测量的情况下提升接触丰富的操作策略性能。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的策略常常失败，因为不同的物理状态看似相同，却需要不同的动作。摄像头可能无法判断连接器是对齐还是完全就位，而许多仅支持法向力感知的触觉传感器可能遗漏垂直于抓取方向的切向交互，而这些交互恰恰是区分这些状态的关键。我们探讨的问题是：学习策略是否需要经过校准的剪切力测量，还是仅需一种可重复的观测，能够区分依赖剪切力的接触状态即可。我们提出了TacGooseBumps（TacGB），一种被动式穹顶薄膜，通过机械方式将切向载荷编码为现有传感器压力图中的图案变化。切向载荷使每个穹顶倾斜，并重新分布其足迹上的压力；端到端策略直接使用由此产生的压力图，无需增加额外电子元件、力重构或taxel级穹顶对齐。在四个模仿学习任务和两条数据采集流程中，TacGB显著提升了目标达成率、效率和接触质量：插入成功率最高提升36个百分点，成功插入的完成速度更快，易碎物体的放置更加轻柔，绘图过程更加连续且笔直。信号分析、分阶段分析、失败模式分析和轨迹分析均表明，这些改进源于接触状态中任务相关的切向交互难以仅凭视觉和法向压力分辨的场景。综合来看，这些结果表明，剪切力无需以度量方式测量即可惠及机器人学习；相反，它可以通过机械编码实现，而无需改变底层触觉传感器或策略的压力图输入格式。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: Simify is a training-free, test-time framework that reconstructs simulation-ready assets from a single RGB-D image and uses massively parallel physics simulation with evolutionary search to perform spatial reasoning for robot manipulation, outperforming prior foundation models on real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: Simify 是一种免训练、测试时框架，从单张 RGB-D 图像重建仿真就绪资产，并利用大规模并行物理模拟和进化搜索进行机器人操作的空间推理，在真实机器人任务上优于先前的 foundation model。
summary_zh: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，它使机器人能够完成涉及多物体交互的长时程任务。我们提出了Simify，一个无需训练、仅在测试时运行的框架，通过大规模并行物理模拟执行显式空间推理。给定场景的单一RGB-D图像，Simify利用3D生成模型和视觉-语言模型重建可直接用于模拟的资源。随后，针对由奖励函数指定的任务（例如，搭建最高的塔），Simify启动数千次并行模拟运行，并执行进化搜索以优化物体排列，通常在数秒内收敛。我们在真实机器人硬件上进行了定量实验，以展示我们的框架在从未见过的物体上端到端执行复杂物体重排任务的能力。结果表明，我们的框架通过在推理过程中有效利用大规模并行模拟，在空间推理的基础模型方法上优于先前工作，同时也凸显了完整且准确的几何信息对于成功的模拟到现实迁移的重要性。

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
summary: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.
tldr: This paper identifies a 'commitment-evidence gap' in asynchronous world-action models where action and video denoising schedules differ, and proposes 'ReSync', a training-free method that pauses action generation and advances the world stream within a computed window, improving success on RoboCasa and other benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了异步世界-动作模型中动作与视频去噪调度不同步所致的“承诺-证据差距”，并提出无需训练的ReSync方法，在计算窗口内暂停动作生成、推进世界流，提升了在RoboCasa等基准上的成功率。
summary_zh: 联合生成未来视频与动作已成为世界-动作模型的标准方案，而最强系统以不同的调度方式对两条流进行去噪：动作以少量步骤解码以保持控制快速，而视频流则运行更长时间以确保预测的未来保持清晰。这一设计是有意为之，但使两条流处于不同的时钟节奏，动作可能已可执行，而理应为其提供依据的未来仍大多未解决。我们将此形式化为异步推理的双时钟视角，并引入承诺-证据差距（commitment-evidence gap），这是一个直接从模型自身采样调度中读取而非通过搜索测得的量。该差距具有预测性：当差距扩大时，候选效用变得更难识别，额外候选采样带来的收益减少，而推进世界流带来的收益增加，两者产生交叉。因此，投入更多世界计算并非简单意义上的更优。有效区间两端闭合，且两端均可在任何 rollout 之前从调度中读出。ReSync 将计算置于该区间内：保持动作状态不变，仅在受支持的窗口内推进世界，然后恢复原生去噪。参数不变，候选亦不进行比较。在冻结的配对的 RoboCasa 面板上，该方法将成功率提升 4.48 个百分点，而同等计算量的对照组在不推进世界的情况下等待则无改善，且同一规则无需调参即可迁移至第二个基准和第二个骨干网络。

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.
tldr: DexTaG uses tactile signals from gloves as guidance in RL to retarget human demonstrations to robot hands for dexterous manipulation, training a generalizable retargeter and distilling it into a tactile-free student policy.
tldr_zh: DexTaG 利用手套捕捉的触觉信号作为强化学习中的引导，将人类演示重定向到机器人手部进行灵巧操作，训练一个泛化的重定向器并蒸馏出无需触觉的学生策略。
summary_zh: 基于手套的运动捕捉正成为一种可扩展的采集灵巧手示范数据的方法。然而，由于人手与机器人手之间的运动学差异，记录的人体运动无法直接在机器人上执行，尤其是在涉及手内重定向的接触密集型工具使用任务中。先前的工作在仿真中通过强化学习或轨迹优化来弥合这一差距，但在此类框架下，人的接触模式难以保持，常常导致不自然的操作和不稳定的功能性抓取。这些方法还为每条参考轨迹单独训练策略或单独求解优化问题，效率较低。为解决这些问题，我们提出DexTaG，一种用于灵巧操作的触觉引导强化学习框架。在训练过程中，手套捕获的触觉信号引导策略搜索朝向测量到的人体接触模式，减少了对精确参考几何形状用于接触监督的依赖。为提高效率，我们在同一物体的所有训练轨迹上联合训练一个可泛化的重定向器。该重定向器进一步蒸馏为基于目标物体轨迹的、无需触觉的学生控制器，以支持真实世界部署。在标记笔和锤子操作任务中，DexTaG学习到自然的、接触密集的行为，而基于距离接触启发式方法的基线方法无法学习这些行为；DexTaG还能泛化到同一物体和任务的未见过的轨迹，并在OakInk2数据集上优于单轨迹基线方法。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io
tldr: Robot-GST constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment from RGB-D observations to simulate and evaluate candidate actions before real-world execution, integrating geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning with large vision-language models to improve long-horizon manipulation reliability.
tldr_zh: Robot-GST 利用 3D 高斯泼溅和 SAM3D 从 RGB-D 观测构建高保真机器人环境，在执行前进行模拟和评估，并结合几何感知的时空推理与大视觉语言模型，提升长时程操作任务的可靠性。
summary_zh: 机器人操控策略正随着对视觉-语言模型在端到端决策中的日益依赖而快速发展。然而，可靠的部署仍面临挑战，因为许多策略缺乏显式机制来预测任务结果并评估所生成的动作是否能达到预期的最终状态，导致在执行长时程操控过程中误差不断累积。我们提出Robot-GST，一个几何感知的时空行为表征与评估框架，该框架构建了高斯-SAM机器人环境用于真实到仿真（real-to-sim）的策略验证，并提升了真实世界操控部署的可靠性。我们的方法利用3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）和SAM3D，从RGB-D观测中构建高保真机器人环境，实现“先仿真评估，后执行动作”。该框架将视觉观测和语言指令与时空推理相结合，利用大型视觉-语言模型进行长时程任务规划。为衔接高层规划与真实世界执行，我们通过几何采样和基于状态的轨迹规划引入高斯感知的最终状态估计。在执行前，候选动作序列在Gaussian-SAM环境中进行仿真和评估，以过滤不可行行为。我们在涉及刚体、软体和可变形物体的代表性操控任务上验证了该方法，包括立方体放置、玩具装箱和小鸭重排，结果表明几何感知的时空推理与状态感知的执行能够提升不同物体类别下的操控可靠性。我们的研究结果表明，将几何感知重建与高质量渲染和仿真相结合，为评估机器人操控行为提供了一种可扩展的方法。网站：https://robot-gst.github.io

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
summary: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/
tldr: This paper proposes a framework that uses the visual prediction of a world-action model as a goal proposal and optimizes the action head with Flow Policy Optimization, using feedback from a frozen action-conditioned world model, to improve real-world manipulation success rates without online interaction or task-specific reward models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种框架，将世界动作模型的视觉预测作为目标提议，并利用冻结的动作条件世界模型的反馈，通过流程策略优化来优化动作头，从而在无需在线交互或任务特定奖励模型的情况下提高真实世界操作的成功率。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型能够联合预测未来的视觉观测与机器人动作。然而，其视觉预测与所生成动作隐含的后果之间可能存在差异。我们观察到，世界-动作模型往往能在生成可靠达成任务的动作序列之前，先产生视觉上看似合理的任务完成结果。因此，我们将世界-动作模型生成的视觉预测视为目标条件下的视觉提议，而非可直接执行的计划。我们使用冻结的动作条件世界模型来预测动作条件下的后果，并基于两种未来预测之间的一致性以及与最终目标的对齐程度构建反馈。借助这一反馈，我们采用流策略优化（FPO）来优化世界-动作模型的动作头。该框架避免了在线机器人交互以及额外训练任务特定奖励模型的需求。在四个真实的UR5操作任务中，我们的方法将平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%，相比之下，\( \pi_{0.5} \) 的成功率为61.4%。这些结果表明，在所评估的操作任务中，跨模型预测差异能够为改进机器人策略提供有效反馈。网站：https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
summary: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.
tldr: OPIS is a benchmark for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models, using input-grounded annotations and an object-centric evaluator to assess presence, identity, and structure across diverse domains.
tldr_zh: OPIS 是一个用于评估视频世界模型多物体记忆的基准，通过基于输入的真实标注和以物体为中心的评估器，跨多个领域衡量存在性、身份和结构。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型必须随时间推移保持世界的视觉状态，但现有的评估协议往往依赖于生成的历程、视频参照或选定的重访视角，这些都可能混淆对模型真实记忆能力的评估。为解决这一问题，我们引入了OPIS，一个基于输入锚定的基准，严格将评估限定于初始观测中固定的一组对象实例，以评估视频世界模型中的多对象记忆能力。OPIS数据集包含500个案例，覆盖真实世界、具身机器人领域和游戏世界，为12,672个刚性、关节式及可变形实例提供了密集的对象级标注。我们的对象中心评估器结合了关联与显式可见性推理，以层级方式度量对象（O）存在（P）、身份（I）和结构（S），并利用基于对象运动学的静态或动态评估轨道。在八种图像到视频或相机条件世界模型中，我们提出的OPIS得分范围从48.65到56.01。随着参考清单从不足20个对象增长到超过40个，存在、身份和结构得分整体呈下降趋势，平均身份得分从40.22降至23.11。结果表明，保持输入中的特定对象实例远比生成看似合理的视觉元素更具挑战性。

title: CoDrive: Cross-Vehicle World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Trajectory Control for Cooperative Driving
summary: Real-world driving is inherently multi-agent, yet most existing driving world models generate observations from a single ego vehicle. Independently extending them to multiple vehicles does not ensure that different agents observe a consistent shared world. We present CoDrive, a cross-vehicle, multi-view driving video generation framework that jointly generates observations of vehicles sharing the same dynamic scene with precise camera-trajectory control. CoDrive interleaves local self-attention, which models spatiotemporal dependencies among the views of each vehicle, with global self-attention, which enables information exchange and consistency modeling across vehicles. To explicitly encode their spatial relationships, all camera trajectories are represented in a shared world coordinate system and injected into the attention layers through projective relative positional encoding. We further adopt a progressive mixed-task training strategy that combines large-scale real-world single-agent data with synthetic cross-agent interaction data, allowing the model to benefit from real-world appearance distributions while learning cross-agent consistency from simulation. For systematic evaluation, we introduce CoDrive-Bench, a benchmark covering real and synthetic multi-vehicle scenarios and evaluating trajectory controllability, scene geometry consistency, and instance-level consistency. Experiments show that CoDrive improves trajectory controllability and cross-agent geometric and instance consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality.
tldr: CoDrive is a cross-vehicle multi-view driving video generation framework that generates consistent observations of vehicles sharing a dynamic scene with precise camera-trajectory control, using interleaved local and global attention and projective relative positional encoding.
tldr_zh: CoDrive是一个跨车辆多视角驾驶视频生成框架，通过交错局部和全局注意力以及投影相对位置编码，在精确相机轨迹控制下生成共享动态场景中多个车辆的一致观测。
summary_zh: 真实世界的驾驶本质上是一个多智能体系统，然而现有的大多数驾驶世界模型仅从单一自车视角生成观测。简单地将这些模型独立扩展到多车辆场景，无法确保不同智能体观测到一致的共享世界。我们提出了CoDrive——一个跨车辆、多视角的驾驶视频生成框架，能够在精确的相机轨迹控制下，联合生成共享同一动态场景的多辆车观测。CoDrive交错使用局部自注意力与全局自注意力：前者对各车辆自身视角间的时空依赖关系进行建模，后者则实现跨车辆的信息交换与一致性建模。为了显式编码车辆间的空间关系，所有相机轨迹均表示在统一的世界坐标系中，并通过投影式相对位置编码注入注意力层。我们进一步采用渐进式混合任务训练策略，结合大规模真实世界单智能体数据与合成跨智能体交互数据，使模型既能学习真实世界的外观分布，又能从仿真中获取跨智能体一致性。为进行系统性评估，我们构建了CoDrive-Bench基准，涵盖真实与合成多车辆场景，并评估轨迹可控性、场景几何一致性以及实例级一致性。实验结果表明，CoDrive在提升轨迹可控性和跨智能体几何与实例一致性的同时，保持了具有竞争力的视觉质量。

title: VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k training episodes, and 1,250 evaluation episodes. Navigation serves as the primary evaluation, while diagnostic goal identification helps distinguish destination-resolution errors from subsequent navigation failures. We further propose MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations. Experiments reveal limited navigation performance, a substantial destination-resolution-to-navigation gap, and frequent navigation failures even after correct destination identification.
tldr: VCN-Bench is a video-contextualized navigation benchmark built on Matterport3D that probes closed-loop spatial reasoning in MLLMs by requiring agents to infer a target destination from prior video and navigate to it, revealing significant gaps in destination resolution and navigation performance. The paper also introduces MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations.
tldr_zh: VCN-Bench 是一个基于 Matterport3D 的视频情境化导航基准，通过要求智能体从先验视频中推断目标目的地并导航至该地点，来评测多模态大语言模型的闭环空间推理能力，实验揭示了目的地解析与导航性能之间的显著差距。文章还提出了 MV-DualVLN，一种联合利用先验视频和情节内观测的规划导向基线。
summary_zh: 空间推理对于具身智能体至关重要，然而空间理解能否被迁移以指导序列化交互，目前仍不明确。现有空间推理基准通常止步于离线预测，而导航基准则将空间推理作为指令跟随与探索的一部分进行评估。我们提出VCN-Bench——一个用于探究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在先前视觉经验基础上进行闭环空间推理能力的“视频情境化导航”基准。给定一段同时涵盖初始位置与目的地的先前视频，智能体需要推理出指令所指定的目标，并依据推断出的空间情境向其导航。基于Matterport3D构建，VCN-Bench包含五种指令类型、10万条训练样本和1,250条评估样本。导航作为主要评估任务，而诊断性目标识别则有助于区分目标解析错误与后续导航失败。我们进一步提出MV-DualVLN，一种以规划为导向的基线方法，联合利用先前视频与片段内观察信息。实验结果表明，导航性能有限，目标解析与导航之间存在显著差距，且即使在正确识别目标后，导航失败仍频繁发生。

title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.
tldr: RefineDrive is a failure-guided post-training framework for VLA driving models that learns from self-generated failures using structured diagnosis, minimum-correction target retrieval, and safety-layered GRPO, improving driving performance on NAVSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RefineDrive 是一种用于 VLA 驾驶模型的失败引导后训练框架，通过结构化诊断、最小修正目标检索和安全分层 GRPO 从自生成失败中学习，提升了 NAVSIM 基准上的驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中的应用高度依赖成功的专家示范，而模型特有的失败样本尚未得到充分利用。从这些失败中学习受到不可靠的诊断、匹配不当的修正目标以及粗糙的奖励信号的阻碍。我们提出RefineDrive，一种失败引导的后训练框架，通过针对性监督和安全感知的强化学习，从自生成的失败中学习。可靠诊断模块直接从模拟器状态中提取关于碰撞和可行驶区域违规的结构化、可验证反馈。最小修正目标检索模块在聚类的人类轨迹库中搜索满足当前场景硬安全约束的邻近修正轨迹，优先保留失败预测的运动模式。以驾驶上下文和失败轨迹为条件，修正SFT学习生成诊断结果并随后生成检索到的修正轨迹，作为仅用于训练的辅助任务。随后，我们应用带有安全分层奖励的GRPO，该奖励严格优先考虑硬安全轨迹，对不安全轨迹和硬安全轨迹均保留连续的安全反馈，并且仅在满足硬安全条件后才奖励驾驶进展。在推理时，策略直接根据驾驶上下文预测轨迹，无需显式的诊断或修复阶段。在NAVSIM v1上，RefineDrive将4B基础SFT策略的PDMS从87.7提升至91.7。使用相同的检查点且无需额外训练，RefineDrive在原始NAVTEST场景上以NAVSIM v2扩展指标评估达到了89.4 EPDMS。受控消融实验证实了结构化诊断监督、检索修正以及安全分层优化对直接规划的有效性。

title: VehicleArena: A Realistic Urban Environment for Multi-Agent Driving
summary: Real-world embodied agents often pursue independent objectives within a shared physical environment, where their actions can alter the conditions faced by others. Existing benchmarks, however, typically assume shared goals or explicitly prescribed interaction protocols, leaving such emergent physical coupling underexplored. We introduce VehicleArena, a 3D urban-driving benchmark for studying independently operating agents in a dynamic shared world. In VehicleArena, LLM-controlled agents must fulfill evolving passenger requests while navigating complex traffic, and each agent's driving decisions can reshape traffic flow, delays, risks, and subsequent observations for surrounding agents. The benchmark provides 112 evaluation tasks spanning single-agent and multi-agent driving. Across nine evaluated models, the highest arrival rates reach only 65.0% on single-agent tasks and 65.6% on multi-agent tasks, while strong passenger-request or cabin scores do not reliably translate into successful trip completion. Moreover, in matched multi-agent runs, every tested focal policy reduces the arrival rate of surrounding vehicles relative to the simulator's native traffic controller, revealing measurable externalities beyond the focal vehicle itself.
tldr: VehicleArena is a 3D urban-driving benchmark with 112 tasks for studying LLM-controlled agents in a shared environment, showing that current models achieve low arrival rates and create negative externalities on other vehicles.
tldr_zh: VehicleArena是一个3D城市场景驾驶基准，包含112个任务，用于研究共享环境中LLM控制的智能体，结果表明现有模型到达率低且对其他车辆产生负面影响。
summary_zh: 现实世界中的具身智能体往往在共享的物理环境中追求各自独立的目标，其行为可能会改变其他智能体所面临的状况。然而，现有基准测试通常假设智能体具有共同目标或明确规定的交互协议，使得这类涌现性的物理耦合现象尚未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了VehicleArena——一个用于研究动态共享世界中独立运行智能体的3D城市驾驶基准测试平台。在VehicleArena中，由大语言模型控制的智能体必须在应对复杂交通的同时满足不断变化的乘客需求，且每个智能体的驾驶决策都可能重塑周围智能体所面临的交通流、延误、风险及后续观察信息。该基准测试包含112个评估任务，涵盖单智能体和多智能体驾驶场景。在九个被评估的模型中，单智能体任务中的最高到达率仅为65.0%，多智能体任务中为65.6%，而较高的乘客需求满足分数或车厢舒适度分数并不能可靠地转化为任务的成功完成。此外，在配对的多智能体运行中，相对于模拟器原生交通控制器，所有受测焦点策略均会降低周围车辆的到达率，揭示出超出焦点车辆本身的可测量的外部效应。

title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
summary: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.
tldr: Proposes Uni-TMPO, a unified RL post-training framework using forward KL matching for diffusion/flow policies, addressing mode collapse in T2I generation and improving VLA generalization and diversity, validated in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: 提出Uni-TMPO，一种基于前向KL匹配的统一RL后训练框架，用于扩散/流策略，解决T2I生成中的模式崩溃问题，并提升VLA的泛化性与多样性，在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 奖励最大化的强化学习（RL）被广泛用于对文本到图像（T2I）生成的随机扩散和流策略进行后训练。然而，即使在参考KL或熵正则化下，奖励最大化的强化学习也会导致策略模式坍缩，使策略退化为单一的高奖励模式。在T2I中，这会产生相似的图像并导致奖励黑客行为。当扩展到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，同样的坍缩会消除备选的成功策略，削弱任务和场景的泛化能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了统一轨迹匹配策略优化（Uni-TMPO），这是一个用于扩散和流策略的统一强化学习后训练框架。首先，Uni-TMPO将标准化奖励转化为每个轨迹组内的目标分布，并从轨迹对数概率中推导策略分布。然后，前向KL散度优化匹配这两个分布，而非最大化期望奖励。一个基于进度条件的从粗到细调度器高效地构建T2I轨迹。在统一框架内，反馈条件采样利用更新的观测构建VLA轨迹。大量实验表明，Uni-TMPO在T2I奖励和VLA指令成功率上均优于最强基线。更重要的是，它在T2I奖励-多样性-效率权衡以及VLA对未见任务和场景的泛化上取得了最佳表现，而真实机器人评估则证明了当高奖励目标被阻挡时多种动作策略的价值。

title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
summary: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.
tldr: WorldWeave introduces a world generation framework that decouples structural memory from visual rendering, using continual elevation-map generation and agent-guided scene organization to build explicit, expandable 3D worlds for consistent video generation across trajectories and revisits.
tldr_zh: WorldWeave提出了一种世界生成框架，将结构记忆与视觉渲染解耦，通过连续高程图生成和智能体引导的场景组织来构建可扩展的显式3D世界，从而在轨迹和重访中保持视频生成的一致性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
尽管进展迅速，世界模型仍然缺乏显式、持久的结构记忆，这使得在连续场景扩展和跨视角重访过程中难以保持一致的世界结构。为解决这一局限，我们提出了WorldWeave，一种将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦的世界生成框架。具体而言，WorldWeave将连续高程图生成与智能体引导的场景组织和拼接相结合，构建可扩展的显式三维世界，在保留现有结构的同时逐步扩展结构记忆。首先，其地形模块利用基于扩散的图像外推技术，在邻域条件约束和边界约束下生成连续的度量高程图。接着，一个智能体整合用户意图、地形证据和跨区域连通性约束，通过分层语义规划、确定性几何编译和局部修正来构建场景。最后，在视觉生成阶段，规划的相机轨迹通过只读接口查询世界几何，生成深度序列以引导视频合成，而无需将生成结果写回世界状态。由此，结构记忆独立于短窗口视频生成，能够在无预定义地图边界的情况下持续扩展，并为跨轨迹和重复访问的观测提供一致的几何基础。

title: FlexiWorld: Learning and Planning via Flexible Action Chunks Across Multiple Time Scales
summary: Latent world models predict future states for goal-directed planning using action chunks spanning multiple primitive steps. Existing methods typically use fixed-length chunks and either omit goal-conditioned action generation or limit their supervision to short goal spans. We introduce FlexiWorld, a JEPA-based world model that combines mixed-span goal supervision with variable-length action chunks to improve long-horizon control. During training, we sample varying goal spans and randomly partition the actions into variable-length chunks. We jointly train the world model with a causal action encoder that embeds variable-length chunks and an autoregressive actor that generates primitive actions sequentially. Student Forcing reduces exposure bias by training on generated action prefixes. For planning, Actor-Residual Cross-Entropy Method (ARCEM) combines action-residual search with within-chunk autoregressive feedback and chunk-boundary latent prediction. Across four benchmarks and goal distances, FlexiWorld with ARCEM achieves 89.29% mean success, compared with 83.98% for the strongest baseline. PushT ablations show improved direct control from mixed-span supervision, variable-length chunks, and Student Forcing. Without retraining, FlexiWorld supports different planning chunk lengths: longer chunks accelerate ARCEM by approximately $1.3\times$ on average while maintaining comparable average success.
tldr: FlexiWorld introduces a JEPA-based world model with variable-length action chunks and mixed-span goal supervision to improve long-horizon control, demonstrating higher success rates across four benchmarks and planning flexibility.
tldr_zh: FlexiWorld 提出了一种基于 JEPA 的世界模型，采用可变长度动作块和混合跨度目标监督来改进长时程控制，在四个基准测试中展示了更高的成功率和规划灵活性。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型利用跨多个基本步骤的动作块预测未来状态，以支持目标导向的规划。现有方法通常使用固定长度的动作块，并且要么省略目标条件下的动作生成，要么将其监督限制在较短的目标跨度内。我们提出了FlexiWorld，一种基于JEPA的世界模型，结合了混合跨度目标监督与可变长度动作块，以提升长时程控制能力。在训练过程中，我们采样不同的目标跨度，并将动作随机划分为可变长度的块。我们联合训练世界模型与一个因果动作编码器（用于嵌入可变长度动作块）以及一个自回归动作生成器（用于逐步生成基本动作）。学生强迫（Student Forcing）通过在生成的动作前缀上进行训练来减少曝光偏差。在规划方面，动作残差交叉熵方法（ARCEM）将动作残差搜索与块内自回归反馈及块边界潜状态预测相结合。在四个基准测试及不同目标距离下，FlexiWorld结合ARCEM取得了89.29%的平均成功率，而最强基线为83.98%。PushT消融实验表明，混合跨度监督、可变长度动作块和学生强迫均能提升直接控制性能。在无需重新训练的情况下，FlexiWorld支持不同的规划块长度：较长的动作块可使ARCEM平均加速约1.3倍，同时保持相当的平均成功率。

title: Brain-Conditioned Action Policies for Neural Motor Decoding
summary: Motor brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to decode motor intention, enabling people with paralysis to control external devices. Neural motor decoding typically learns task-specific mappings from neural activity to kinematics, yet remains constrained by scarce paired neural-action data. We propose BrainVLA, a framework that enables neural motor decoding by drawing on a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model through language-mediated alignment. BrainVLA mitigates reliance on scarce paired neural-action data by leveraging VLA policies. We first construct VLA-compatible datasets including paired neural activity, action signals, language instructions, and rendered visual observations. Then, we adapt the OpenVLA-OFT policy to the target action spaces through LoRA fine-tuning. To establish an effective interface through which neural activity can convey motor intention to adapted VLA policies and guide action generation, we train a neural encoder via neural-language alignment, using language representations as semantic targets to capture latent motor intent from neural activity. The resulting neural representations serve as an endogenous intention signal to guide VLA policies to generate executable actions, while visual observations provide complementary information about the evolving task state. BrainVLA is evaluated on two neural motor datasets with different action dimensionalities using causal rollout decoding. It outperforms the evaluated baselines in cross-session decoding $R^2$ and task success rate, while demonstrating high training data efficiency. These results establish a route for neural motor decoding to draw on large-scale robotic priors through brain-conditioned VLA policies.
tldr: BrainVLA adapts a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model to decode neural activity into motor commands for brain-computer interfaces, using language-mediated alignment to reduce reliance on scarce neural-action data and improve cross-session decoding.
tldr_zh: BrainVLA通过语言介导的对齐，将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型应用于神经运动解码，减少了对稀缺神经-动作数据的依赖，并提高了跨会话解码性能。
summary_zh: 运动脑机接口（BCI）旨在解码运动意图，使瘫痪患者能够控制外部设备。神经运动解码通常学习从神经活动到运动学信息的任务特定映射，但受限于稀缺的神经-动作配对数据。我们提出BrainVLA框架，通过语言介导的对齐机制，借助预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型实现神经运动解码。BrainVLA利用VLA策略，减轻了对稀缺配对神经-动作数据的依赖。我们首先构建兼容VLA的数据集，包括配对的神经活动、动作信号、语言指令和渲染视觉观测。随后，通过LoRA微调将OpenVLA-OFT策略适配到目标动作空间。为了建立有效的接口，使神经活动能够向适配后的VLA策略传递运动意图并引导动作生成，我们通过神经-语言对齐训练神经编码器，以语言表征作为语义目标，从神经活动中捕获潜在的运动意图。由此产生的神经表征作为内源性意图信号，引导VLA策略生成可执行动作，同时视觉观测为不断演化的任务状态提供补充信息。BrainVLA在两个具有不同动作维度的神经运动数据集上进行了因果展开解码评估。在跨会话解码$R^2$和任务成功率方面，它优于所评估的基线方法，同时展现出较高的训练数据效率。这些结果为神经运动解码借助脑条件VLA策略利用大规模机器人先验知识开辟了路径。

title: Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models point toward general-purpose robotic intelligence by unifying perception, instruction, and control. Despite impressive progress, existing VLA models often adapt poorly due to \emph{tri-modal misalignment} among vision, language, and action, which weakens action grounding and hurts generalization and fine-tuning efficiency. In this work, we present Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), a novel framework that explicitly enforces tri-modal alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, bridging the representational gap across modalities and enhancing task adaptation. While prior research has predominantly emphasized bi-modal vision--language alignment, we systematically formalize and study tri-modal alignment in VLA models, and provide both ablations and analysis to isolate its role in improving adaptation and robustness. To further accelerate deployment, we adopt a flow-matching objective, enabling substantially fewer inference steps than diffusion-based policies while maintaining accuracy. Theoretically, we establish a quantitative connection between the tri-modal alignment gap and the optimization tightness of flow matching; empirically, experiments on the extensive benchmark show that AGFT achieves superior success rates and lower inference latency compared to SOTA baselines, underscoring tri-modal alignment as a key ingredient for scaling robust VLA manipulation.
tldr: AGFT introduces a tri-modal alignment loss and flow-matching objective for VLA policies, improving adaptation, robustness, and inference efficiency for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: AGFT通过三模态对齐损失和流匹配目标改进了VLA策略，提升了机器人操作的适应性和推理效率。
summary_zh: 近期在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型方面的进展，通过统一感知、指令与控制，正朝着通用机器人智能的方向发展。尽管取得了显著进展，现有的VLA模型往往由于视觉、语言和动作之间的三模态错位而适应能力不佳，这削弱了动作基础，损害了泛化能力和微调效率。在本项工作中，我们提出了对齐引导流变换器（AGFT），一个通过专门的对齐损失显式强制三模态对齐的新框架，弥合了跨模态的表征差距，增强了任务适应性。虽然先前的研究主要强调双模态的视觉-语言对齐，我们系统性地形式化并研究了VLA模型中的三模态对齐，并提供了消融实验和分析，以分离其在提升适应性和鲁棒性方面的作用。为进一步加速部署，我们采用了流匹配目标，使得推理步骤远少于基于扩散的策略，同时保持准确性。在理论上，我们建立了三模态对齐差距与流匹配优化紧密性之间的定量联系；在实证上，在广泛基准上的实验表明，AGFT在成功率和推理延迟方面均优于最先进的基线，凸显了三模态对齐作为扩展鲁棒VLA操作的关键要素。

title: LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots
summary: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.
tldr: The paper proposes a hierarchical control framework combining offboard vision-based ArUco marker navigation with onboard inertial/encoder feedback to achieve stable navigation and asymmetric manipulation on a two-wheeled inverted pendulum robot, validated in physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种分层控制框架，将基于ArUco标记的离车视觉导航与车载惯性/编码器反馈相结合，使两轮倒立摆机器人在非对称操作中实现稳定导航与操控，并通过实物实验验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种分层控制框架，以解决两轮倒立摆（TWIP）机器人在进行非对称物体操作时出现的严重动态不稳定及导航漂移问题。尽管两轮平台具有高度机动性，但其持续的平衡调整导致机载里程计在精确导航方面极为不可靠。此外，侧装机械臂在举升负载时会引入未驱动的侧倾力矩，这一挑战在崎岖地形上尤为严峻。为解决这些耦合问题，我们的架构将任务分工处理。机外视觉系统通过追踪头顶ArUco标记提供高延迟的全局航点导航，从而规避里程计漂移。与此同时，低延迟的机载控制回路利用惯性及编码器数据抑制主动物理扰动。在物理实验中，这种双回路方法使定制机器人能够精准导航，有效抵抗减速带带来的瞬态冲击，适应动态跷跷板坡道，并在窄轮距下安全携带负载而不倾倒。

title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning
summary: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.
tldr: This paper introduces Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL), which uses structural priors of policies as an interface between skill composition and skill generalization, improving out-of-distribution generalization and enabling unseen skill compositions in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了代理先验引导的策略学习（APPL），利用策略的结构先验作为技能组合与技能泛化之间的接口，在机器人操作任务中改进了分布外泛化并实现了未见过的技能组合。
summary_zh: 从少量演示中学习的机器人通常需要两种泛化形式。组合泛化将技能重新组合以解决新任务，而技能泛化则使每项技能背后的学习策略能够在新的情境中发挥作用。二者相互依赖，然而在组合过程与其所调用的技能之间，信息会发生丢失。技能在何处有效，取决于其策略训练时所采用的结构；而组合过程仅能通过一种独立的描述（如名称、指令或符号操作符）来理解技能，这种描述省略了该结构。我们的核心思想是，将每种策略的结构性先验作为组合过程与技能之间接口的一部分。结构性先验描述了行为所依赖的因素，例如，抓取仅依赖于夹爪相对于物体的位姿。该先验内置于训练过程中，塑造了策略泛化的范围；以语言形式表达时，它则告知组合过程策略适用的范围。我们将这一思想具体化为先验引导的策略学习（Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning, APPL）方法。一个构建智能体将完整的演示分割为可复用的技能，为每项技能提出若干结构性先验，并为每个先验训练和验证一个策略。随后，一个运行时智能体在这些先验特定的策略中进行选择，并利用它们的接口将其组合以达成新的任务目标。在MetaWorld和长时域ManiSkill任务中，APPL提升了分布外技能泛化能力，并实现了此前未见过的技能组合；去除接口信息后，性能显著下降。这些结果支持将训练时的结构假设作为技能学习与技能组合之间桥梁的做法。

title: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm
tldr: The paper presents D4orm, a diffusion-denoising framework for multi-robot trajectory planning, which uses parallel sampling and iterative deformation to generate kinodynamically feasible, conflict-free trajectories. It also introduces decoupled, online, and distributed planners built on this framework, demonstrating strong performance in simulations and real-world multi-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了D4orm，一种基于扩散去噪的多机器人轨迹规划框架，通过并行采样和迭代变形生成运动学可行且无冲突的轨迹，并在此基础上开发了分离式、在线和分布式规划器，在仿真和真实多机器人实验中展示了优越性能。
summary_zh: 多机器人轨迹规划是多机器人协调中的一个基本问题，但由于其非凸、多模态和高维特性，在计算上仍然具有挑战性。本工作基于D4orm——一种动力学感知的扩散去噪框架，开发了一系列适用于不同运行需求的规划架构。与传统数值优化方法不同，D4orm采用基于采样的优化，通过大规模并行采样生成解轨迹，充分利用GPU等现代计算架构。其扩散去噪结构对候选控制轨迹进行迭代优化\textit{变形}，为生成满足运动动力学可行且无冲突的轨迹提供了一种高效且通用的范式。以D4orm作为高级规划器的构建模块，我们提出了一种用于提升可扩展性的解耦规划器、一种带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器，以及一种适用于资源受限场景的分布式规划器。在二维和三维环境中使用差速驱动机器人和全向机器人的评估表明，基于D4orm的方法相比MPPI等其他基于采样的优化方法以及一种基于学习扩散模型的方法，能够更快、更可靠地找到高质量解。我们进一步展示了在十台带障碍物的真实四旋翼上的零样本部署、100个模拟机器人的大规模冲突消解，以及六台地面机器人的完全机载分布式“终身”运行。总体而言，这些结果确立了扩散去噪作为多机器人协调中一种可扩展且可靠的框架。代码和视频：https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

title: Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts
summary: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.
tldr: This paper presents a terrain-aware autonomous exploration framework for quadruped robots in lunar-like environments, combining exteroceptive (RGB-D) and proprioceptive mapping to assess traversability and energy cost, with simulation results in Isaac Sim showing reduced Cost of Transport during subsequent navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向月球环境的四足机器人地形感知自主探索框架，结合外部感知（RGB-D）与本體感知绘图评估可通行性和能量消耗，在Isaac Sim仿真中验证了地图扩展及后续导航中较低的运输成本。
summary_zh: 自主行星探测需要机器人在未知、崎岖的地形中导航，同时评估风险、可通行性和能量消耗。四足侦察机器人非常适合这一任务，因为它们能够穿越不规则表面，并在运动过程中收集与机动性相关的信息。本文提出了一种地形感知探索框架，将外部感知与本体感知映射相结合，用于月球类似环境中的四足机器人。机载RGB-D相机构建以机器人为中心的 elevation maps（高程图），估计几何可通行性，并推导用于自主规划的导航代价。与此同时，本体感知测量提供基于交互的地形线索，补充基于几何的评估。局部地图逐步注册到全局多层表示中，探索模块利用该表示在未探索的兴趣区域选择目标。目标由自主导航系统实现到达，该系统利用可用地图和代价层引导考虑碰撞的运动。在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中的仿真结果表明，系统能够实现自主探索、地图扩展以及地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间的空间关联。利用这些信息进行的后续导航，其平均运输代价（CoT）低于初始探索阶段。

title: CoBrush: A Hierarchical Planning Framework for Human-Robot Co-Painting
summary: Embodied co-painting requires a robot to repeatedly update a shared physical canvas while human intent evolves over interaction. Existing reference-driven painters or reactive assistants are typically optimized for single-shot rendering or sketch completion, limiting their ability to sustain coherent multi-round collaboration or to construct complex, content-rich scenes over time. We present CoBrush, a hierarchical framework that formulates multi-round co-painting as a coordinated semantic, spatial, and execution process. By separating high-level intent inference from spatial grounding and stroke-level control, the system supports progressive scene development on real acrylic canvases. We evaluate the framework through real human-robot painting sessions, stress tests, and user studies. Compared to single-turn baselines, our approach achieves stronger semantic alignment, more stable spatial progression, and higher perceived plausibility of robot actions. These results demonstrate that structured multi-stage reasoning improves the coherence and robustness of interactive painting and supports the progressive development of content-rich physical artworks.
tldr: CoBrush introduces a hierarchical planning framework for human-robot co-painting that separates semantic intent, spatial grounding, and stroke-level control, enabling progressive multi-round collaborative painting on real canvases.
tldr_zh: CoBrush 提出了一种分层规划框架，用于人机协同绘画，将语义意图、空间定位和笔划控制分离，实现了在真实画布上渐进的多轮协作绘画。
summary_zh: 具身协同绘画要求机器人在人类意图随交互不断演变的同时，持续更新共享的实体画布。现有关注参考图像的绘画系统或反应式辅助系统通常针对单次渲染或草图补全进行优化，限制了它们在多轮协作中保持连贯性，或随时间逐步构建复杂、内容丰富场景的能力。我们提出CoBrush，一个分层框架，将多轮协同绘画建模为语义、空间与执行三个层面协同运作的过程。通过将高层意图推断与空间定位及笔触级控制相分离，该系统支持在真实丙烯画布上实现渐进式场景发展。我们通过真实的人机绘画会话、压力测试和用户研究对该框架进行了评估。与单轮基线方法相比，我们的方法在语义对齐、空间推进稳定性以及机器人行为感知合理性方面均表现更优。这些结果表明，结构化的多阶段推理能够提升交互式绘画的连贯性与鲁棒性，并支持内容丰富实体艺术作品的渐进式创作。

title: Manifold-Stable Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.
tldr: This paper introduces manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), a flow matching method that uses contraction theory to guarantee generated samples stay on the data manifold, improving geometric adherence and task performance in robotic manipulation experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了流形稳定流匹配（MSFM），利用收缩理论保证生成样本保持在数据流形上，从而在机器人操作实验中提高了几何一致性和任务性能。
summary_zh: 流动匹配（Flow Matching, FM）通过速度回归学习生成动力学过程。几何流动匹配变体通常假设先验分布支撑在数据流形上，这要求具备往往不可得的几何知识。在缺乏此类知识的情况下，仅凭低回归误差并不能保证流形依从性。流形依从性可使生成样本保持在有效构型内，并在经验上与更好的任务性能相关。我们提出了流形稳定流动匹配（Manifold-Stable Flow Matching, MSFM），该方法可从任意环境先验出发，无需该先验支撑在流形上。利用非线性动力学中的工具，即收缩理论，MSFM将学习得到的切向输运与预设的法向收缩相结合。该构造对已知流形使用解析投影算子，对未知数据几何则使用通过主成分分析估计的局部仿射近似。通过在已知和未知流形两种情形下实施收缩理论，我们保证了流形不变性以及在期望时间窗口（例如一秒）内横向收敛到流形。我们推导出一族相容的概率路径，并将训练损失分解为可学习的切向项与法向残差。一个椭圆实验实现了量级为$10^{-6}$的平均终端离流形误差。在Push-T机器人实验中，MSFM将成功率从$74\%$提升至$82\%$。在Robomimic Square任务中，成功率从$60\%$提升至$72\%$，同时旋转流形偏差从$10^{-2}$量级降至$10^{-7}$量级。MSFM的终端几何误差由所选的数值容差控制。这些结果展示了更强的几何依从性和更高的观测任务性能，支持将预设法向收缩作为学习生成输运的补充。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/
tldr: This paper proposes Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), a method for world-action models that treats the predicted visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it via a learned revision bridge after execution feedback, improving closed-loop task success rates on RoboMME and RMBench.
tldr_zh: 本文提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测视觉未来作为持久动作条件，并通过学习到的修订桥在执行反馈后修订它，从而提升RoboMME和RMBench上的闭环任务成功率。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型利用预测的未来视觉信息来调控机器人动作，然而执行反馈可能使预测中的部分内容失效，但任务结构仍具参考价值。我们提出可修正时序规划（Revisable Temporal Planning, RTP），该方法将视觉未来保持为持续的动作条件，并在反馈后对其进行修正。其核心机制是一个学习得到的修正桥（revision bridge）：它从视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态恢复，并根据当前观测调整其后续生成。视觉与动作监督将该修正过程与后续控制相连接。具备时间感知的历史信息提供观测证据，自适应策略在解码下一动作前，选择保留原有预测、进行桥接修正，或从新噪声中重新规划。在RoboMME和RMBench基准上，RTP分别取得了48.6%和84.8%的任务平均成功率。配对比较支持学习型延续机制；估计的检查点来源与动作前缀效应为正，但精度解析尚不够明确。这些结果将反馈驱动的视觉规划修正与闭环任务性能联系起来。项目页面：https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.
tldr: This paper introduces a conformal residual calibration method to adaptively filter actions from a frozen ACC policy, improving safety and reducing computation while preserving the base policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于共形残差校准的自适应安全过滤方法，用于冻结的自适应巡航控制策略，提高了安全性和计算效率。
summary_zh: 冻结的自适应巡航控制（ACC）策略在部署环境与其训练条件不一致时可能会违反约束。我们提出了一种残差感知共形动作滤波方法（RACF），该方法对固定标称预测器的残差进行校准，并将其分位数转化为有限模型动作投影的运行裕度。已完成的转移会更新裕度与候选选择，而无需重新训练策略。在包含2400个控制器试验单元的注册比较中，自适应RACF实现了94.3%的回合安全性，相较于评估的标称CBF-QP基线提升了19.9个百分点，同时将投影频率从8.11%降至6.63%。一项对照研究单独分离出残差裕度注入带来的4.54个百分点改进。在另一项匹配硬件评估中，自适应方法相较于鲁棒CBF-QP将平均摊还展开时间降低了21.2%，安全回合数分别为161/180和170/180。我们刻画了将一步残差覆盖与约束满足联系起来的相关条件，并量化了所观察到的安全性与计算量之间的权衡。

title: QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning
summary: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.
tldr: QuadHand presents a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm and passive CoG compensation, along with a novel MRC-SDF representation and whole-body trajectory optimization for safe aerial manipulation in complex environments.
tldr_zh: QuadHand 提出了一种带有3自由度机械臂和无源重心补偿模块的紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂，并利用新颖的 MRC-SDF 表示和全身轨迹优化实现了复杂环境中的安全空中操作。
summary_zh: 无人飞行操纵器（UAMs）将机械臂与空中平台相结合，用于三维物理交互。然而，工作空间的增大会增加机械臂引起的扰动，而现有几何表示在近距离交互中面临几何保真度与计算效率之间的权衡。本文提出了QuadHand，一种紧凑型四旋翼空中操纵器，配备三自由度机械臂、夹爪及电池辅助的被动质心补偿模块，以减少机械臂引起的显著扰动。我们进一步提出了MRC-SDF，一种多关节机器人中心符号距离场，可在计算量可控的情况下保留精细几何细节，并构建了一种时空全身轨迹优化框架，该框架联合优化四旋翼与机械臂，以实现安全且可执行的轨迹生成。仿真与真实世界实验证明了在复杂环境中进行安全且可执行的空中操纵的可行性。

title: Graph-Based Simultaneous Path and Foothold Planning for Multi-Limbed Intra-Vehicular Robots in Space Stations
summary: Robot-aided operations in space stations are essential for reducing the workload of astronauts and improving the efficiency of on-orbit activities. Multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots (MLIVRs) equipped with grappling end-effectors have emerged as a promising solution, as they can securely grasp pre-existing interfaces, such as handrails and seat tracks, thereby enabling stable locomotion and forceful manipulation in microgravity environments. Since graspable locations on these interfaces are spatially limited and discretely distributed, motion planning for MLIVRs must be addressed jointly with foothold planning. This paper presents a simultaneous path and foothold planning framework based on graph theory for MLIVRs. The proposed method efficiently searches for feasible stance sequences for a multi-limbed robot while satisfying manipulability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through simulations in a 3D model of the International Space Station (ISS) cabin, demonstrating its capability to generate feasible and efficient locomotion plans in realistic intra-vehicular environments.
tldr: This paper presents a graph-based planning framework that simultaneously determines paths and foothold sequences for multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots operating in space stations, validated in a simulated ISS cabin.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的规划框架，可同时为空间站内多臂机器人规划路径和支撑点序列，并在国际空间站舱内仿真中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 空间站中的机器人辅助操作对于减轻航天员工作负担、提升在轨活动效率具有重要意义。配备抓取式末端执行器的多臂舱内机器人（MLIVRs）因其能够牢固抓取扶手、座椅滑轨等既有接口，从而在微重力环境中实现稳定移动与强力操作，已成为一种有前景的解决方案。由于这些接口上可抓取位置在空间上有限且呈离散分布，MLIVRs的运动规划必须与立足点规划联合进行。本文提出了一种基于图论的MLIVRs路径与立足点同步规划框架。该方法在满足可操作约束的同时，高效搜索多臂机器人的可行支撑序列。通过在国际空间站（ISS）舱段三维模型中的仿真验证，证明了该框架在真实舱内环境中生成可行且高效运动规划的能力。

title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
summary: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/.
tldr: NavJev improves Vision-and-Language Navigation efficiency by replacing repeated MLLM inference with action-centric visual compression and a discriminative memory, achieving strong success rates at drastically lower latency and cost.
tldr_zh: NavJev 通过动作中心的视觉压缩和判别性记忆替代重复的 MLLM 推理，提高了视觉语言导航的效率，在显著降低延迟和成本的同时实现了较高的成功率。
summary_zh: 近期，零样本视觉与语言导航（VLN）方法日益依赖多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）来对视觉观察、导航指令及候选动作进行推理。尽管这些方法效果显著，但在每个导航步骤中反复调用自回归多模态推理会带来大量推理延迟，限制了具身智能体的响应能力。为此，我们提出了NavJev，一种高效的VLN框架，将在线导航从重复的多模态生成任务重构为紧凑的视觉压缩加轻量级类型化动作选择。具体而言，动作中心视觉压缩（ACVC）将途径点几何信息、BLIP描述及RAM语义标签整合为候选动作的紧凑表示，而判别性动作-语义记忆（DASM）则在各导航步骤间过滤共享语义，维持具有区分性的动作特定证据。基于这些表示，Jev直接对可用动作集进行结构化概率决策。在R2R-CE上的实验表明，NavJev实现了27.0%的SR和22.4%的SPL，且每步导航仅需0.65秒，与基于MLLM的VLN方法相比，大幅降低了推理延迟与成本。项目页面见 https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/。

title: AGRO-SUVIDE: Agentic Robotics for Surgical Viscoelastic Debridement
summary: Augmented dexterity has the potential to reduce the fatigue experienced by surgeons during repetitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we propose the first AGentic RObotics framework for SUrgical VIscoelastic DEbridement (AGRO-SUVIDE), the repeated removal of small fragments attached to a viscoelastic substrate. Leveraging the self-improving and coding capability of agents, AGRO-SUVIDE adopts a modular framework. Specifically, the demonstration analysis module automatically identifies recurring skills from a single expert demonstration, using both visual and kinematic information. The construction module then builds each skill, either as a procedural model-based skill the agent codes against a scaffolded library or as a model-free policy-based skill. At runtime, the monitoring module composes the skills into a loop-style graph sized to the number of fragments it observes, then verifies pre- and post-conditions of each skill to decide whether to advance or retry. We evaluate AGRO-SUVIDE through 340 physical trials on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). AGRO-SUVIDE achieves an average single-fragment removal success rate of 85%, completing consecutive three-fragment removal at 60% and at 95% with one human intervention. It further generalizes to unseen five-fragment scenarios with an average success rate of 80% for single-fragment removal. Project page: https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/
tldr: AGRO-SUVIDE presents an agentic robotics framework for surgical viscoelastic debridement, using agent coding and modular skills to achieve 85% single-fragment removal success on the da Vinci Research Kit across 340 physical trials.
tldr_zh: AGRO-SUVIDE 提出了一种用于外科粘弹性清创的代理式机器人框架，利用代理编程和模块化技能在达芬奇研究套件上实现85%的单片段移除成功率。
summary_zh: 增强灵巧性有潜力减少外科医生在执行重复性外科任务时所经历的疲劳。本文提出了首个用于外科粘弹性清创术的智能体机器人框架（AGRO-SUVIDE），该任务涉及反复移除附着在粘弹性基质上的小碎片。利用智能体的自我改进与编码能力，AGRO-SUVIDE采用模块化框架。具体而言，示范分析模块利用视觉和运动信息，从单次专家示范中自动识别重复出现的技能。构建模块随后构建每项技能，既可作为基于过程模型的技能（智能体根据脚手架库进行编码），也可作为基于无模型策略的技能。在运行时，监控模块将技能组合成循环式图结构，其规模与观察到的碎片数量相匹配，然后验证每项技能的前置条件和后置条件，以决定是继续推进还是重试。我们通过达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上的340次物理试验对AGRO-SUVIDE进行了评估。AGRO-SUVIDE实现了85%的平均单碎片移除成功率，连续移除三个碎片的成功率为60%，在一次人工干预下可达95%。它进一步泛化到未见过的五碎片场景，单碎片移除的平均成功率为80%。项目页面：https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/

title: SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.
tldr: SOR-Nav presents a hierarchical object navigation system that uses an LLM-driven supervisor to decide between exploring the current area or relocating to a more promising region, achieving state-of-the-art results on HM3D and MP3D benchmarks and demonstrating real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: SOR-Nav 提出了一种层次化目标导航系统，利用 LLM 驱动的监督器在继续探索当前区域与迁移至更有前景的区域之间进行决策，在 HM3D 和 MP3D 基准上取得了最优结果，并展示了真实世界部署。
summary_zh: 目标导航要求具身智能体在部分可观测且运动预算有限的条件下，于未见环境中寻找目标物体。现有方法主要通过排名候选目的地来优化机器人下一步的移动方向。与此不同，我们提出SOR-Nav，一种分层导航系统，显式地在继续探索当前情境与放弃当前情境转而前往更有潜力的可达区域之间进行仲裁。首先，构建自主语义探索系统，该系统累积持久的三维物体簇，并将可达前沿组织为簇决策图，以提供高效的搜索抽象。随后，SOR-Nav利用情境门控的大语言模型驱动的物体搜索监督器，评估当前搜索情境的适宜性，并决定是继续探索还是跨区域转移到另一个可达前沿簇。在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和MP3D的完整未过滤验证集上，SOR-Nav在所有三个基准测试中均取得了已报告的最高成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）。特别是在MP3D上，其将此前最优SPL从18.1\%提升至38.5\%，实现翻倍以上增长，同时将SR从50.7\%提升至61.8\%。嵌套的HM3D-v2消融实验验证了所提出的决策结构，而连续三目标物理部署则展示了真实场景中的持久目标导航运行能力。

title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.
tldr: HOI-Retarget is a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers human-object interactions onto humanoid robots via windowed trajectory optimization, enabling large-scale motion-data generation for learning demonstrations. It handles monocular video contacts, object-size variation, and multi-robot manipulation scenarios, with released code and datasets.
tldr_zh: HOI-Retarget 是一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，通过窗口轨迹优化将人-物交互迁移到人形机器人上，支持大规模运动数据生成。它能够处理单目视频接触、物体尺寸变化以及多机器人操作场景，并公开了代码和数据集。
summary_zh: 从演示中学习（LfD）使仿人机器人能够获取多样化的全身技能，但将该范式扩展至人-物交互（HOI）受到机器人兼容交互参考数据可用性的限制。我们提出HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，将人-物交互迁移至仿人机器人，用于大规模运动数据生成。其窗口化轨迹优化将每个标注接触点作为物体坐标系中的目标，在机器人运动学约束下平衡身体跟踪、足部支撑与平滑性。该方法可对单一演示进行跨物体尺寸的增强，吸收从单目视频重建的接触信息，并支持多机器人协同操作同一物体。我们公开发布了代码及重定向运动数据集。

title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
summary: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.
tldr: This paper investigates numerical reliability issues in differentiable physics-based optimization for robotic material manipulation, specifically using MPM benchmarks for system identification, and reveals gradient instability, unreliable finite-difference checks, and sensitivity to observation definitions.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了机器人材料操作中基于可微物理优化的数值可靠性问题，通过MPM基准测试识别系统参数，揭示了梯度不稳定性、有限差分校验不可靠以及对观测定义的敏感性等问题。
summary_zh: 可微物理（differentiable physics）日益被用于机器人材料操控中的系统辨识、轨迹或技能优化、演示生成以及机器人或末端执行器设计等领域。这些应用依赖于通过长时程、富含接触的仿真推演所传播的梯度。我们利用两个基于弹塑性和颗粒操控的材料点法（Material Point Method, MPM）系统辨识基准，研究了这些梯度的数值可靠性。所构建的基准为三类现象提供了受控测试案例，这些现象同样出现在更广泛的基于可微物理的优化中。GPU上多对一求和（其顺序取决于线程调度）会改变长时程梯度的结果，并使某一参数梯度相对于确定性参考发生符号反转。对于更长推演，有限差分校验的可靠性下降，因为重复运行导致的损失方差增长远快于所测试参数扰动引起的损失变化。观测定义和损失定义会改变优化行为以及独立指标所偏好的解。这些结果促使我们采用可复现的累加方式，在有限差分验证中比较扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行方差，并在使用可微仿真进行机器人优化时明确报告目标函数的构建方式。

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.
tldr: This paper introduces WAMACHINE, a training-free framework that accelerates World Action Model inference by preserving and adapting intermediate inference states across control loop replans, denoising steps, and Transformer layers, achieving significant speedups on LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks while preserving task success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WAMACHINE，一种无需训练、通过保留并自适应中间推理状态来加速世界动作模型（WAM）推理的框架，在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上实现1.47-3.05倍延迟和2.23-3.27倍GPU时间加速，同时保持任务成功率。
