summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模动作与环境动态，实现了具有前瞻性的控制。然而，迭代式扩散或流推理引入了大量的去噪延迟。先前的推理状态为加速提供了天然机会，但规划情境、观测数据及中间表示的不断变化，可能使保留的状态迅速失效。因此，保留有效计算需要调整推理状态，而非直接复用。为此，我们提出$\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$，一个无需训练的框架，通过保留并适配推理状态，在控制循环演化过程中实现高效且准确的连续推理。在闭环重规划层面，轨迹重映射将前一次重规划的状态重新映射以初始化下一次重规划，减少冗余的轨迹生成。在去噪步骤层面，观测重绑定在动作执行期间进行预期推理，并在一致性检查通过时将保留的去噪状态与真实观测重新绑定以继续推理，从而减少暴露于控制循环的延迟。在Transformer层层面，残差缩放选择性地调整保留的层状态，并在探针检查失败时通过中间层的完整计算刷新状态，减少重复的Transformer计算。在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上对三种代表性WAM架构的评估表明，$\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$在观测到动作的延迟上实现了1.47–3.05$\times$的加速，在每次重规划的GPU推理时间上实现了2.23–3.27$\times$的加速，同时保留了原生WAM任务成功率的96.69–99.54%。

title: Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner
summary: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time inverse-game planner for an aerial gripper to capture non-cooperative targets, using gradient-based optimization and anti-disturbance control, validated in simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于空中抓取器的实时逆博弈规划器，通过梯度优化和抗扰动控制实现对非合作目标的捕获，并在仿真和真实实验中验证了其高效性和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 精确捕获非合作目标至关重要。为应对这一棘手挑战，本文提出了一种集成基于梯度的实时逆博弈预测与规划器（GRIPPER）框架的空中抓取系统。该交互过程被建模为不完全信息条件下的广义和追逃博弈。具体而言，目标潜在的代价参数被在线推断，并在滚动时域循环中迭代优化开环纳什均衡（OLNE）策略。为确保高频执行，开发了一种计算友好的基于梯度的逆博弈求解器。该求解器无需显式计算Hessian逆矩阵，而是基于隐式微分和快速Hessian向量积实现优化解的高频更新（>50 Hz）。同时，设计了抗扰动控制器以克服不确定载荷和抓取器驱动带来的扰动，从而实现对规划轨迹的精确跟踪和目标抓取的精准执行。仿真与实物实验验证了GRIPPER框架优越的计算效率和任务性能。成功完成了非合作目标的捕获与递送任务，突显了该框架在高度对抗场景下的鲁棒性、适应性和实时性能。

title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.
tldr: This paper introduces gaze prompting, an eye-tracker-supervised method that provides frame-level visual guidance during VLA fine-tuning, improving success rates on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了凝视提示方法，通过眼动仪监督在VLA微调期间提供帧级视觉指导，提高了真实世界双臂操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）微调在每一步都将图像与动作配对，但通常仅提供任务级别的语言指令，使得逐时刻的视觉相关性隐而不显。我们提出了一种基于眼动追踪监督的注视提示方法，利用虚拟现实遥操作过程中记录的眼动数据，为VLA微调提供帧级别的视觉引导。在训练阶段，记录到的注视位置以十字准星的形式渲染在机器人头部摄像头的图像上。在部署阶段，一个轻量级预测器根据近期图像和指令估计注视位置，在不使用眼动仪或改变策略架构的前提下，提供相同类型的视觉提示。以π₀为模型实例，注视提示在六个真实世界双臂操作任务中将平均成功率从26.3%提升至56.0%，并且在单一策略同时训练所有六个任务时也观察到了性能提升。我们发布了\textsc{GazeMani}数据集，包含1,200条带有同步眼动数据的遥操作轨迹。

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
summary: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars
tldr: ARS is an inference framework that uses a 27B VLM with adaptive visual inspection and verification to estimate per-frame task progress rewards from offline trajectories, improving reward modeling and policy learning in simulation and on a real robot without extra reward-model training.
tldr_zh: ARS是一个推理框架，利用27B视觉语言模型通过自适应视觉检查和验证来估计离线轨迹中的逐帧任务进度奖励，无需额外奖励模型训练即可提升模拟和真实机器人上的策略学习。
summary_zh: 进度奖励建模是估计机器人行为如何随时间改变任务进度的问题。可靠估计要求区分有意义的状态变化与失败尝试及与任务无关的动作。我们提出了智能体奖励系统（ARS），一种利用通用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行进度奖励建模的推理框架，无需额外的奖励模型训练。给定离线轨迹和任务指令，ARS采用自适应视觉检查进行事件提议和验证。一个子智能体提出与任务相关的事件时间线，主智能体在估算逐帧进度前对其进行验证和修订。ARS可结合可选的终端结果标签和视觉参考以辅助判断，还能审计外部奖励模型的进度估计。我们在受控语义失配基准测试、仿真环境及真实机器人上的下游策略学习中，使用27B规模的VLM对ARS进行了评估。基准测试表明，即使在简单的抓取-放置场景中，多个被评估的奖励基线也会将虚假进度归因于错误物体的操作。ARS能更好地抑制这些错误，并在仿真策略学习中优于这些基线。我们进一步证明，ARS支持在真实机器人上，利用混合质量的离线经验进行多螺丝紧固这一工业洗衣机装配线全尺寸实验室复制环境中的长时程策略学习。这些结果表明，结构化推理与验证能够提升通用VLM在机器人奖励建模中的实用性。代码见https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

title: When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.
tldr: This paper investigates whether autonomous driving benchmark score gains remain reliable evidence of improvement when scores are directly optimized, decomposing the scoring process and showing that gains can reverse under different execution interfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在直接优化自动驾驶基准分数时，分数提升是否仍是驾驶改进的可靠证据，通过分解评分过程表明在不同执行接口下分数提升可能逆转。
summary_zh: 驾驶基准分数日益被用于评估和优化目标。这引发了一个根本性问题：一旦分数本身成为优化对象，分数提升是否仍能作为驾驶改进的可靠证据？我们通过考察评分过程如何响应驾驶行为的变化，以及这些提升在重复执行和重新规划下是否持续存在，来解答这一问题。我们将该过程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射和聚合。受控干预揭示了显著的行为变化，但这些变化在评分中几乎未获响应，原因在于请求动作与实际执行动作之间的差异被省略、阈值化或衰减。闭环比较进一步表明，当执行接口改变时，优化增益可能发生逆转，这显示了增益对请求如何被执行并反馈回来的依赖性。综上，这些发现将评分指标所保留的行为差异与其增益可迁移的条件联系起来。因此，优化条件下的指标有效性要求同时检验评分过程所测量的内容以及优化行为如何被执行。

title: From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom
summary: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.
tldr: This paper introduces a typed semantic-to-geometric interface that compiles natural-language manipulation instructions into task maps and policies, preserving task-relevant freedoms, and validates it in simulated robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种类型化的语义到几何接口，将自然语言操作指令编译为任务地图和策略，同时保留任务相关的自由度，并在仿真机器人实验中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 自然语言操作指令通常描述定性关系，而连续控制器则需要可状态评估的任务量、微分项及完成条件。由于定性关系通常未完全指定相对构型中的部分内容，将其展开为完整位姿可能会引入非预期的约束。我们提出了一种类型化的语义—几何接口，其中语言指定实体、关系及阶段，而每种关系索引其任务相关区分与保持自由度的注册规范。机器人端编译器对这些规范进行落地，利用共形几何代数构建关系特定的任务映射与一致的微分项，并通过RMPflow组合所得策略。为评估语言模型与编译器之间的职责分工，我们对比了语义拓扑接口与额外要求关系特定几何规范的接口，后者覆盖60条指令。两者在41/60情况下生成了正确的共享语义内容，但在各自接口要求下的关键错误分别出现在19/60和58/60情况下。在涵盖八种几何关系形式的64项落地评估中，任务映射保持了注册的零方向，并对关系相关扰动产生响应；解析方向导数与有限差分结果一致，雅可比矩阵秩与注册维度匹配。在使用MuJoCo中模拟Franka Emika Panda的三项闭环消融实验中，固定一个关系保持坐标使中位终端进度误差增加了20.24至71.00毫米，而保留关系误差仍保持在评估界限内。这些结果支持将关系可见的几何与保持自由度共同编译为可组合的连续目标函数。

title: Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging
summary: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.
tldr: This paper presents a contact-aware impedance controller for robot-assisted ultrasound imaging that uses B-mode ultrasound images for contact detection and localization, reducing interaction forces during imaging.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助超声成像的接触感知阻抗控制器，利用B模式超声图像进行接触检测与定位，在成像过程中降低了交互力。
summary_zh: 安全机器人辅助超声成像需要一种可靠的控制器，能够检测并定位探头与组织之间的相互作用。本文提出了一种基于B型超声图像的接触感知方法，以及一种面向机器人超声成像的接触感知阻抗控制器。该方法在不依赖力测量的情况下检测声学接触，从而实现基于接触状态的力/力矩置零，以减少残余 wrench 偏差。在接触过程中，该方法沿弯曲探头表面连续估计有效接触位置，并利用该位置更新控制器的交互坐标系，从而在成像过程中实现对物理探头-组织接触点的视觉伺服控制。在琼脂体模上的实验表明，在探头滚转角从$-15^\circ$到$15^\circ$的范围内，接触定位的均方根误差为$\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm。在静态滚动过程中，所提出的控制器在保持任务空间跟踪精度与传统固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的同时，将最大压缩交互力从$\mathbf{31.56}$~N降低至$\mathbf{20.09}$~N，降幅达$\mathbf{36.3\%}$。上述结果表明，超声图像作为直接接触反馈在安全、准确的机器人辅助超声成像中具有应用潜力。

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
summary: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.
tldr: This paper presents a Bayesian active learning framework for clarifying ambiguous natural language instructions in interactive robot planning by grounding them as Signal Temporal Logic specifications, using LLMs to generate candidate specifications and clarification questions while Bayesian optimization selects queries maximizing information gain. The method achieves higher task satisfaction with fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines across simulations and real robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种贝叶斯主动学习框架，在交互式机器人规划中通过将模糊的自然语言指令落地为信号时态逻辑规范来澄清意图，利用LLM生成候选规范和澄清问题，并采用贝叶斯优化选择信息增益最大的查询。在仿真和真实机器人上，该方法比LLM基线实现了更高的任务满意度且所需的澄清轮次更少。
summary_zh: 交互式机器人规划要求机器人能够从自然语言指令中推断并执行人类意图，而这类指令往往存在歧义、信息不完整或表述不明确的问题。尽管大语言模型（LLM）为澄清机制提供了强大的交互接口，但依赖生成模型驱动多轮对话可能引入系统性失效。我们提出一种贝叶斯框架，将澄清问题视为基于语义信号时序逻辑（STL）任务规范上的主动学习问题。该方法利用大语言模型初始化候选形式化规范，并将信息性对比转换为自然语言澄清问题；同时，贝叶斯优化持续维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，并选择信息增益最大的查询进行提问。收敛后，推断所得的STL规范被传递给形式化规划器，以合成可验证的机器人轨迹。在四个仿真及真实世界任务领域中，与基于大语言模型的基线方法相比，我们的方法通常能够实现更高的任务满意度，并减少澄清轮次，同时帮助较小模型缩小与更大推理模型之间的性能差距。

title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).
tldr: SAGE introduces a lightweight symbolic gate and local plan editing for LLM-based task planners in embodied household agents, improving safety and efficiency in AI2-THOR benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SAGE 为具身家庭智能体的 LLM 任务规划器引入了轻量级符号门控和局部计划编辑，在 AI2-THOR 基准测试中提高了安全性和效率。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）现已成为具身家庭智能体的默认认知核心，然而它们在执行前很少依据环境接地模型对其生成的计划进行校验，且其报告的任务成功率往往在高度饱和的基准上测量，以至于任何方法之间都无法区分。我们提出SAGE（符号动作门控与编辑，Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing），这是一种基于单一LLM的规划器，由两个轻量级机制构成：一个领域无关的符号门控（约250行Python代码，零token开销，复杂度为$O(|π|)$），作为运行时安全监控器，以类型化原因阻止违反前置条件的动作；以及一种局部编辑机制，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保持已完成和未受影响的工作不变；同时，混合种子+实时记忆存储支持冷启动覆盖。我们在无泄漏协议（留一检索）下，对五个开放权重模型和一个包含75个任务的AI2-THOR基准进行了评估。在标准基准上，目标完成率已饱和（52%的实例可平凡求解），SAGE与强分层基线持平。在更困难、方法无关的多目标组合任务上，SAGE的完成率优势重新显著显现（四个模型上提升+0.06至+0.23）。在注入的中途执行失败场景下，SAGE以2.4至3.3倍更少的LLM调用次数达到与全计划重规划器相当的恢复可靠性。作为执行前验证门控，符号监控器在执行前阻止不安全动作，并提升了所有被测规划器的模拟器报告步级成功率（最高+0.11），而验证器从未见过该信号（非循环）。由于门控不调用模型（0.008毫秒/计划），它本质上是一种在边缘端几乎零成本运行的安全层：SAGE规划在Jetson AGX Orin上复现了同等质量，而小型模型验证在此场景中带来的帮助最大。我们发布了该基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控测试框架，以及验证器可移植性研究（在ALFWorld上自动诱导，保留集上达到0.89）。

title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
summary: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.
tldr: RLE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on robot learning engineering tasks, covering interactive control, policy learning, perception, and mechanical design, aggregating metrics into an RLE Index.
tldr_zh: RLE-Bench 是一个基准，用于评估编码代理在机器人学习工程任务中的表现，涵盖交互控制、策略学习、感知和机械设计，并将指标汇总为 RLE 指数。
summary_zh: 编码代理正开始超越纯数字任务，涉足物理世界的挑战，尤其是在机器人领域。然而，现有的机器人基准主要聚焦于单个制品（如策略或控制器）的性能表现，对编码代理更广泛的工程能力的覆盖十分有限。现实世界的机器人技术远不止控制层面：代理必须在资源约束下构建、集成、诊断并改进异构制品，同时还要基于多模态反馈进行推理。为评估这些更广泛的能力，我们提出了RLE-Bench，一个涵盖四类代表性机器人开发工作流的机器人学习任务基准：交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计，以及机械设计。我们采用多样化的任务专属指标来评估编码代理提交的制品，涵盖代理实现的成功率、其训练出的策略代理、其构建的测试框架代理，以及其设计的机械结构。我们将这些指标聚合为一个综合的RLE指数，并输出各工作流的能力画像，从而支持在多个能力维度上对编码代理进行系统比较。除性能排名外，我们还开展了深入的案例研究，考察代理在代表性任务中的行为，既突出其当前能力，也揭示其局限性，并指明机器人任务为未来代理训练所提供的机遇。

title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.
tldr: AGILE-GS introduces an anchor-guided next-best-view selection method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that separates the search for maximally informative camera poses from candidate ranking, achieving large speedups in selection latency while matching or improving reconstruction quality in both offline and closed-loop embodied acquisition settings.
tldr_zh: AGILE-GS提出了一种基于锚点引导的3D高斯溅射下一最佳视角选择方法，将寻找信息量最大的相机位姿与候选排序分离，在离线及闭环具身采集场景中大幅提升选择速度，同时保持或提升重建质量。
summary_zh: 辐射场需要数百个视角，且视角的位置与数量同等重要。针对三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的下一最佳视角（NBV）选择方法通常会对候选集中的每个视角进行评分，并保留得分最高的一个。然而，信息搜索与相机选择是两个可分离的问题。我们提出AGILE-GS，一种锚点引导的NBV方法，将这两个问题分离开来。一个虚拟锚点姿态通过黎曼梯度上升法在SE(3)空间中基于期望信息增益进行优化。该锚点姿态无需可达，也无需存在于候选集中；它标记了模型不确定性最大的位置。候选视角根据锚点的观测几何进行评分，并通过贪心岭杠杆步骤将候选集精简为一个小型且无冗余的候选短名单，无需渲染任何候选视角。该短名单可有两种使用方式。AGILE-GS将短名单中的第一个视角作为下一视角，因此无需为任何候选视角计算Fisher信息。AGILE-GS+则计算短名单中每个视角的Fisher信息增益并选择最优者，从而使昂贵的评估仅运行在少数几个视角上，而非整个候选集。在标准基准测试和闭环具身体验采集中，两种方法均达到或超越现有基线，同时将选择延迟降低一至两个数量级。

title: Embodied Semantic Communication for Collective Autonomous Agents: A Tutorial on Representation, Wireless Delivery, and Closed-Loop Coordination
summary: As autonomous systems and embodied intelligence enter the dynamic physical world, multi-agent collaboration calls for a paradigm shift in communication design. However, existing communication paradigms overlook that agents form action understanding from their own states, environmental observations, and collaboration relations through a process that evolves as a task unfolds. Consequently, reliable bit delivery, general semantic recovery, or single-task utility optimization alone cannot ensure that heterogeneous agents form coordinated actions compatible with their own conditions from shared information during task execution. To address this gap, this paper proposes embodied semantic communication (ESC) as a paradigm that transforms information transmission into action-oriented semantic interaction. Specifically, ESC characterizes how an explicit communication link can encapsulate multimodal perceptual states, intrinsic hardware capabilities, and collaborative intents into unified actionable semantic representations, thereby enabling heterogeneous receiving agents to parse, align, and ground them in local motor control. This paper clarifies the conceptual boundary, system characteristics, and environment-constrained technical pathways of ESC. It maps the underlying mathematical tools, including semantic information theory, world models, and multi-agent decision theory. Finally, this paper summarizes key open challenges, including measurable semantic reliability, ambiguity-triggered interaction under dynamic environments and tasks, and bandwidth-adaptive semantic transmission, outlining a roadmap for collective embodied networks.
tldr: This paper introduces embodied semantic communication (ESC), a paradigm for multi-agent autonomous systems that transmits action-oriented semantic representations—encapsulating multimodal perception, hardware capabilities, and intents—to enable coordinated motor control, and maps underlying mathematical tools and open challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文提出具身语义通信（ESC），一种面向多智能体自主系统的通信范式，通过传输包含多模态感知、硬件能力和意图的行动导向语义表示来实现协调控制，并梳理了相关数学工具与开放挑战。
summary_zh: 随着自主系统与具身智能进入动态物理世界，多智能体协作呼唤通信设计的范式转换。然而，现有通信范式忽视了智能体在任务展开过程中，通过自身状态、环境观测和协作关系逐步演化形成动作理解这一事实。因此，仅靠可靠的比特传输、通用的语义恢复或单一任务效用优化，无法确保异构智能体在执行任务时能够从共享信息中形成与其自身条件相协调的动作行为。为弥补这一缺口，本文提出具身语义通信（ESC）范式，将信息传输转变为面向动作的语义交互。具体而言，ESC刻画了显式通信链路如何将多模态感知状态、内在硬件能力及协作意图封装为统一的可行动语义表征，从而使异构接收智能体能够在局部运动控制中对其进行解析、对齐和落地。本文阐明了ESC的概念边界、系统特征及环境约束下的技术路径，梳理了包括语义信息论、世界模型和多智能体决策理论在内的底层数学工具。最后，本文总结了关键开放挑战，包括可度量的语义可靠性、动态环境与任务下歧义触发的交互，以及带宽自适应的语义传输，勾勒了协同具身网络的发展路线图。

title: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
summary: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.
tldr: FAR learns to retrieve episodic memories for world models by training a retriever with future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring, improving prediction in diverse settings.
tldr_zh: FAR通过利用未来感知的预测监督和自适应多线索评分来训练检索器，为世界模型检索情节记忆，从而在各种设置中改善预测。
summary_zh: 世界模型根据当前的体验和动作预测未来的观测，然而预测可能依赖于久远过去的观测。情景记忆保存过去的观测以备后续回忆；但随着记忆的累积，一个根本性问题随之产生：哪些记忆对当前预测有用，以及应当信任哪些可用的检索线索来找到这些记忆？这一问题颇具挑战性，因为基于近因性、位姿重合度或视觉相似性的固定标准在不同环境和查询条件下可能并不可靠。我们提出未来感知回忆（FAR），一个通过未来感知预测监督和自适应多线索评分来学习情景回忆的框架。在训练阶段，FAR通过给定回忆上下文条件下已实现未来的条件对数似然来衡量预测效用，该似然以负扩散预测损失近似，并利用其训练一个在推理时对未来保持盲态的检索器。该检索器学习线索特定的相关性，并在选择记忆时自动判定每个查询应信任哪些可用的检索线索，如时间、位姿、视觉和音频。在三个互补的实验设置中，即便使用相同的检索线索，FAR也优于人工设计的回忆策略，能够自动适应性地信任可用的线索，并在世界变化时回忆正确历史。综合而言，这些结果确立了FAR作为世界模型中情景记忆访问的一种灵活且原理性方法的地位。

title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
summary: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.
tldr: WorldPlay2 introduces a factorized hybrid control interface and a co-designed compressed memory with stable distillation to enable real-time, long-horizon interactive world modeling, demonstrating superior generalizability and performance.
tldr_zh: WorldPlay2 提出了因子化混合控制接口以及压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏的协同设计，实现了实时、长时程的交互式世界建模，并在泛化性和性能上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 交互式世界模型需要实时响应多样化的控制指令，同时保持长时间范围的一致性。然而，对异构控制进行建模仍然十分困难，同时爆炸性的上下文和不稳定的蒸馏过程阻碍了在长时间一致性与实时响应性之间取得平衡。本文提出WorldPlay2，一种交互式世界模型，将分解式混合控制接口与压缩记忆和稳定蒸馏的协同设计相结合。1) 我们提出的分解式混合控制接口将帧对齐的动作控制与结构化语义控制相结合，显式区分场景外观、角色身份和动态语义事件，从而促进有效的控制学习。2) 为实现高效的长时间范围建模，我们将历史上下文压缩为紧凑的记忆标记，由自回归学生模型和双向教师模型共享。该设计支持以片段为单位、基于记忆条件的分数评估，而非对完整长序列进行联合处理，从而大幅降低蒸馏开销。3) 我们进一步提出稳定强制策略，通过少步策略初始化自回归学生模型，并利用完整序列回放来保持长序列生成质量，确保蒸馏过程的稳健性和稳定性。大量实验证明，该模型具有很强的泛化能力，且性能优于现有方法。

title: WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.
tldr: WorldAttention proposes an efficient attention architecture for interactive video world models, combining Hybrid Sparse Attention and Hierarchical KV Cache management to reduce computational and memory costs while preserving long-range context, achieving superior performance on VBench-Long and InterVBench.
tldr_zh: WorldAttention 提出了一种用于交互式视频世界模型的高效注意力架构，通过混合稀疏注意力和分层 KV 缓存管理来降低计算和内存成本，同时保留长程上下文，在 VBench-Long 和 InterVBench 上取得了优越性能。
summary_zh: 利用自回归扩散范式，文本条件驱动的交互式视频世界模型旨在模拟由文本指令引导的时序一致环境。尽管实现低延迟、长时程生成对于具身智能和基于仿真的规划至关重要，但现有框架主要依赖滑动窗口机制来限制计算复杂度。然而，这种方法本质上会牺牲历史上下文信息，削弱长程交互能力。相反，保留完整历史缓存的计算开销和内存占用则难以承受：注意力机制的二次复杂度导致计算开销过大，而KV缓存的线性增长不可避免地导致GPU内存饱和。为克服上述限制，我们提出WorldAttention——一种面向系统的注意力架构，通过专用注意力内核与分层KV缓存管理的协同设计实现高效性能。首先，我们引入混合稀疏注意力（HSA），将线性全局注意力与头自适应稀疏注意力相结合。此外，我们设计了分层KV缓存（HKV），将历史KV对按语义索引组织到跨多层内存的页面中，实现细粒度检索和受控的GPU驻留。这两种设计均配备定制内核，以将理论效率有效转化为实际性能。在VBench-Long和InterVBench上的大量实验表明，WorldAttention持续超越现有最先进方法，在VBench-Long上取得0.9472的主体一致性得分，在InterVBench上取得0.9668的主体一致性得分。

title: Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.
tldr: This paper introduces Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), an auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly latent representations for sampling-based planning, improving success rates across multiple control environments and planners.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了控制几何拉直（CGS），一种学习有利于采样的规划器友好潜在表示的辅助损失，在多个控制环境和规划器中提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构使得利用潜在世界模型进行规划成为可能，但仅凭准确的转移预测并不能确保规划目标易于优化。我们引入了控制几何拉直（CGS），这是一种单一的辅助损失，通过直接拉直控制几何来实现采样高效的规划，从而学习适合规划器的表示。CGS仅利用像素-动作对的局部转移，将动作之间的成对余弦相似性与相应潜在差异之间的成对余弦相似性进行匹配。该损失可应用于使用端到端学习或预训练表示的世界模型架构。在线性动力学条件下，我们的理论分析将该目标与时间拉直以及全规划范围内更均衡的终端代价曲率联系起来，为MPPI提供了有限预算保证，为CEM提供了局部收缩结果，并为梯度下降提供了收敛界限。在四个控制环境和多种规划器中，CGS以更少的采样候选和细化步骤改善了规划性能，在使用每次更新128个候选的基于采样的规划器时，相较于LeWorldModel（LeWM）及其时间拉直变体（LeWM+TS），成功率分别提升了高达20和12.6个百分点。探针实验、与DINO-WM架构的比较以及规划器侧的消融研究阐明了潜在运动组织、状态依赖性和动力学背景如何塑造规划行为。因此，拉直控制几何使得在有限的规划预算下更容易找到良好的动作序列。

title: Shaping Persistent Representations from Independent Interactions
summary: World models learn environment dynamics from interaction experience. These dynamics depend on the current state and actions, as well as on properties that persist across interactions. Yet standard predictive training can reduce error using local evidence alone, without organizing persistent information into reusable context. We introduce SPRII, a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision for persistent context while retaining the learner's native objective. For example, different trajectories of the same system share persistent properties even when their states and actions differ. SPRII uses such relations to guide context learning without numerical property labels. Two composable components encourage contexts from related interactions to agree (Align) and use one interaction's context to predict another's future (Cross). Our analysis distinguishes three linked questions: what persistent information is accessible in the learned context (Formation), how that context influences a fixed predictor (Use), and whether it reduces task error (Value). Success at one stage does not guarantee success at the next. Controlled experiments show that more reliable relations improve representation organization, but adding a shared-property constraint can reduce access to a property that remains shared. Context substitutions change predictions at fixed model weights, while the benefit from history depends on prediction horizon and readout. Evaluations span thirteen settings, including controlled physical systems, public dynamics tasks, robotic and tactile data, and partner interaction, across multiple learner families. Relative to the corresponding baselines, SPRII yields average gains of over 10% in downstream task performance and over 15% in persistent-property readout. The project page is available at https://persistent-learning-review.netlify.app/interactive.html.
tldr: SPRII introduces a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision to shape persistent representations in world models, improving downstream task performance and property readout across diverse settings including robotic and tactile data.
tldr_zh: SPRII 提出一种训练原则，利用交互之间的关系作为弱监督来塑造世界模型中的持久表示，在包括机器人和触觉数据在内的多种设置中提升了下游任务性能和属性读取。
summary_zh: 世界模型从交互经验中学习环境动态。这些动态既取决于当前状态和动作，也取决于在多次交互中持续存在的属性。然而，标准的预测训练可以仅利用局部证据来减少误差，而无需将持久信息组织为可复用的上下文。我们提出SPRII，这是一种训练原则，利用交互之间的关系作为持久上下文的弱监督，同时保留学习器自身的原生目标。例如，同一系统的不同轨迹即使状态和动作不同，也共享持久属性。SPRII利用此类关系引导上下文学习，而无需数值属性标签。两个可组合的组件促使来自相关交互的上下文趋于一致（对齐），并利用一个交互的上下文预测另一个交互的未来（交叉）。我们的分析区分了三个相互关联的问题：学习到的上下文中可访问哪些持久信息（形成），该上下文如何影响固定预测器（使用），以及它是否能降低任务误差（价值）。某一阶段的成功并不能保证下一阶段的成功。受控实验表明，更可靠的关系能改善表征组织，但添加共享属性约束可能会降低对仍然共享的属性的可访问性。上下文替换会在固定模型权重下改变预测结果，而历史信息的收益取决于预测时域和读出方式。评估涵盖十三个设置，包括受控物理系统、公开动态任务、机器人与触觉数据以及伙伴交互，涉及多种学习器家族。与相应基线相比，SPRII在下游任务性能上平均提升超过10%，在持久属性读出上平均提升超过15%。项目页面位于https://persistent-learning-review.netlify.app/interactive.html。

title: Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids
summary: Detecting failures in World Model (WM)-based planning requires monitoring whether the model is behaviorally aligned with the current task, which in turn requires studying its internal representations. Here, we show that centroids---sub-component Jacobian row-sums---effectively identify the behavioral properties of WMs, complementing traditional activation-based knowledge signals. The centroids of a model are easily computed through Jacobian vector products and characterize how the model organizes the geometry of its input space, yielding an efficient perspective on internal representations, including the generation of task-relevant saliency maps. Evaluated on continuous control tasks using JEPA WMs, this behavioral view reveals a structural dissociation, where the encoder correctly represents the goal while the predictor remains behaviorally unresponsive. This failure mode directly predicts planning failure before any action is taken, allowing for goal resampling to recapture out-of-distribution success. Moreover, centroid-based methods outperform baseline methods as distribution-shift detectors. Together, these tools yield a behavioral monitoring stack that is operational and consequential under distribution shifts.
tldr: This paper introduces Jacobian centroids, a method for monitoring the behavioral alignment of JEPA world models in continuous control tasks, enabling detection of planning failures before actions are executed and improving distribution-shift detection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了雅可比质心方法，用于监控JEPA世界模型在连续控制任务中的行为对齐性，从而在动作执行前检测规划失败并改进分布偏移检测。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在基于世界模型（WM）的规划中检测故障，需要监测模型是否与当前任务在行为上保持一致，这进而要求研究其内部表示。本文表明，质心——子组件雅可比行和——能够有效识别世界模型的行为属性，补充了传统的基于激活的知识信号。模型的质心可通过雅可比向量积简便计算，并能刻画模型如何组织其输入空间的几何结构，从而提供一种高效的内部表示视角，包括生成任务相关的显著性图。在使用JEPA世界模型进行的连续控制任务评估中，这种行为视角揭示了一种结构性分离：编码器正确地表征目标，而预测器则在行为上无响应。这种失效模式可直接在采取任何行动之前预测规划的失败，从而允许通过目标重采样来重新捕获分布外成功。此外，基于质心的方法在分布偏移检测方面优于基线方法。综合来看，这些工具构成了一套在分布偏移下具有可操作性和实际效用的行为监测体系。

title: RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation
summary: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a industrial excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.
tldr: RoboCompiler is a graph-native framework for compiling closed-chain robot mechanisms into shared mechanical interfaces, ensuring consistent modeling, control, and simulation across different robots and simulators.
tldr_zh: RoboCompiler 是一个图原生框架，将闭链机器人机构编译为共享机械接口，确保在不同机器人和仿真器中建模、控制和仿真的一致性。
summary_zh: 具有运动学闭环、耦合驱动和变接触状态的机器人，需要统一且一致的构型、运动、力与动力学模型。然而，这些接口在实际中往往分别为控制与仿真单独构建，导致闭环和驱动一致性难以维持。本文提出了RoboCompiler，一种图原生的框架，将规范的机构图编译为共享的机械接口。基于刚体、关节、坐标系、惯性参数和驱动器端口，该框架构造闭环路径并解析求解残差雅可比矩阵，进而通过带秩校验的延拓与修正过程组装可行构型。切向提升将独立速度映射至完整机器人与任务运动，同时配对驱动器端口映射保持虚功守恒。约束曲率修正将降维进一步扩展至加速度与投影刚体动力学，覆盖浮动基座与支撑模式。循环局部求值、生成的雅可比矩阵以及依赖感知的复用机制，使得闭环输入发生变化时能够进行局部更新。我们在工业挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo以及六-UPS Stewart平台上，对物理闭环和任务引入约束进行了评估。高精度约束动力学结果与独立的Pinocchio校验确认了机械一致性；MuJoCo和Isaac Sim/PhysX实验验证了原生接触下的任务性能与模型复用能力。以Kangaroo为例，编译使残差与雅可比矩阵求值时间减少96.7%，闭环滚动仿真墙钟时间减少66.8%，且动力学与控制部分保持不变。

title: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
summary: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.
tldr: This paper introduces low-altitude question answering (LAQA) with a multi-UAV memory aggregation framework, featuring a generative adversarial exam (GAE) for memory valuation and a memory-centric resource allocation with water-filling power control, validated in CARLA simulations and real-world experiments including UAV-to-robot-dog navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出低空问答（LAQA）的多无人机内存聚合框架，利用生成对抗考试（GAE）评估内存价值，并在通信约束下进行内存为中心的功率分配，在CARLA仿真和真实实验中验证，包括无人机到机器狗导航。
summary_zh: 本文研究了低空问答（LAQA）问题，其中分布式无人机（UAV）的记忆在地面服务器上进行聚合，以回答关于长时间跨度观测的问题。与基于感知、通信、控制或计算指标的传统资源分配不同，LAQA需要一种显式的记忆价值度量。我们提出了一种生成对抗考试（GAE）方法，利用前向仿真评估记忆检索，并通过考试成绩量化记忆质量。这使得在不访问黑盒字幕生成、检索和推理流水线内部机制的情况下，能够度量并优化候选记忆的下游问答价值。基于这一指标，我们开发了一种以记忆为中心（MemCen）的框架，该框架联合选择无人机并在通信约束下分配发射功率，以最大化记忆质量。在噪声受限条件下，我们推导出一种QoM感知的封顶注水法则，将任务效用与物理层功率分配显式关联。我们进一步开发了罚函数逐次优化（PSO）和记忆学习（L2M）求解器。在CARLA Town04和Town05场景中，MemCen在静态和动态通信条件下分别实现了92.4%和84.0%的问答准确率。在真实世界实验中，MemCen在全景多智能体系统（PMAS）基准上实现了88.5%的问答准确率。最后，无人机到机器狗（UAV-to-robot-dog）的演示进一步验证了所获取记忆在环境理解和导航中的实际效用。

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.
tldr: This paper introduces Boundary Feature Repair (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns residual corrections at modality interfaces to improve the robustness of camera-LiDAR 3D object detectors against corruptions, without retraining the deployed detector.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了边界特征修复（BFR），一种冻结主干的适配框架，通过在模态接口学习残差修正，在不重新训练部署检测器的情况下提高相机-激光雷达3D目标检测器对损坏的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 相机-激光雷达检测器即使在两种传感器均存在、同步且已标定的情况下，仍可能持续消耗不可靠的特征。我们提出**边界特征修复**（Boundary Feature Repair, BFR），一种冻结宿主适配框架，在检测器已消费的多模态接口处学习任务监督的残差校正。BFR-C修复融合模块读取的每个相机特征层级，而BFR-L将宿主条件下的激光雷达候选框对齐到选定边界，并相对于冻结锚点路由逐站点创新。二者联合训练的组合即为BFR-CL。零初始化的逐通道缩放使每种变体在优化前严格保持检测器级恒等映射；仅修复模块参与训练，编码器、融合消费模块、路由器、检测头及宿主归一化统计量均保持固定。推理时，BFR无需干净参考、退化元数据、时间历史或在线更新。在完整的20种退化、5级严重度的KITTI-C网格上，相对于复现的冻结基线，BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从$14.07$降至$11.92$，将Focals Conv-F的RCE从$14.29$降至$11.00$。在后一宿主机上，BFR-L将AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$从$73.65$提升至$74.48$，而BFR-CL达到$77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$和$10.46$ RCE，同时保持$86.02$的干净AP。在nuScenes-R上，BFR-CL将复现的MoME基线的mAP鲁棒性比率从$80.1$提升至$81.4$。这些结果确立了边界修复作为一种针对“退化但存在”感知场景的定向改造方案，且无需重新训练已部署的检测器。

title: Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.
tldr: This paper introduces SCOOT, a DRL algorithm for high-risk high-precision motion control, using elite sample policy optimization, mixture-of-experts policy, and distance regularization to learn physically-based billiard shots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SCOOT，一种面向高风险高精度运动控制的深度强化学习算法，通过精英样本策略优化、专家混合策略和距离正则化，学习物理台球击球动作。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）算法在运动控制中的评估与基准测试通常基于序贯决策任务，在此类任务中，不精确的动作可通过后续动作加以修正，因此即便存在噪声动作，仍可获得较高回报。然而，本文关注一类研究较少的高风险、高精度运动控制问题，其动作具有不可逆的后果，导致状态-动作奖励景观中出现尖锐的峰值与脊线。以计算台球作为此类问题的典型代表，我们提出并评估了状态条件射击（SCOOT）算法，这是一种新颖的DRL算法，基于优势加权回归（AWR）并进行三项关键改进：1）仅使用精英样本进行策略优化，使策略能够更好地锁定稀有高奖励动作样本；2）采用专家混合（MoE）策略，以便根据状态在不同奖励景观模式之间切换；3）引入距离正则化项及学习课程，鼓励在适应最优样本之前探索多样化策略。我们展示了所提出特征在学习基于物理的台球击球中的性能，证明了其能够实现高动作精度，并在给定球布局下发现多种击球策略。

title: Simulation for Planetary Robotic Perception and Autonomy: A Concise Survey of Recent Capabilities and Gaps
summary: Planetary robotics is an important enabler of scientific exploration in environments where direct human-in-the-loop operation is costly, hazardous, or infeasible. However, developing and validating planetary robotic systems remains difficult because representative field testing is expensive, limited, and often unrepeatable under mission-relevant conditions. In this setting, simulation serves as a central tool for perception and autonomy research, synthetic data generation, system integration, and pre-deployment evaluation. Despite its importance, the literature on planetary robotics simulation remains dispersed across different simulation engines, implementations, and application settings. This paper surveys simulation works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy across four practical axes: Openness and Availability, Scenario and Platform Coverage, Sensor and Perception Support, and Environmental and Operational Realism. The surveyed simulation works report visual or physical fidelity and support perception-oriented workflows. They also indicate uneven public availability, rover-centered coverage, partial support for specialized sensing modalities, and uneven reporting of operational constraints such as onboard computation, energy, and communication restrictions.
tldr: This paper surveys simulation tools and works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy, analyzing them across axes of openness, platform coverage, sensor support, and realism, and identifies gaps such as uneven availability and limited operational constraint modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了用于行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工具与工作，从开放性、平台覆盖、传感器支持与真实性等维度进行分析，并指出了公开资源不均衡、运行约束建模不足等缺口。
summary_zh: 行星机器人技术在人类直接介入操作成本高昂、存在危险或不可行的情况下，是科学探索的重要推动力量。然而，开发和验证行星机器人系统仍面临诸多挑战，因为在任务相关条件下，代表性实地测试成本高昂、条件受限，且往往无法重复进行。在此背景下，仿真成为感知与自主研究、合成数据生成、系统集成及部署前评估的核心工具。尽管仿真至关重要，但关于行星机器人仿真的文献仍分散于不同的仿真引擎、实现方式及应用场景中。本文从四个实用维度对行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工作进行了综述：开放性与可用性、场景与平台覆盖、传感器与感知支持，以及环境与运行真实性。所综述的仿真工作报告了视觉或物理保真度，并支持面向感知的工作流程。同时，这些工作也显示出公共可用性不均、以火星车为中心的平台覆盖、对专用传感模态的部分支持，以及在机载计算、能量和通信限制等运行约束方面报告不一致的问题。

title: ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation
summary: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.
tldr: ExcavaTwin proposes a training-free, geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework for autonomous excavation, using frozen vision models to fuse multi-view RGB observations into a task-oriented spatial representation.
tldr_zh: ExcavaTwin 提出了一种无需训练、几何引导的语义高程映射框架，用于自主挖掘，利用冻结的视觉模型将多视角 RGB 观测融合为面向任务的空间表示。
summary_zh: 自主挖掘任务需要一种空间表征，能够同时捕捉地形几何信息与任务相关的语义信息。现有的挖掘建图方法大多以高程为核心，而通用语义模型在非结构化的室外场景中往往稳定性不足。我们提出了ExcavaTwin，一种无需挖掘专用训练的纯视觉几何引导语义高程建图框架。该框架基于多视角RGB图像：1）利用冻结视觉模型重建场景几何并生成语义观测；2）提取地形与非地形的几何支撑信息；3）执行几何约束的多视角语义融合，以抑制不合理预测并补全不完整观测；4）将融合后的状态投影为面向任务的语义高程图。在公开数据集和真实挖掘场景上的实验表明，该系统能够实现可靠的几何与语义感知。在实际挖掘过程中，系统在动态变化区域的平均更新间隔约为1.4秒，平均高程误差为12.74厘米。较大误差主要出现在地形快速变化以及机械运动引起的瞬时视觉干扰期间。

title: MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation
summary: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/.
tldr: MarsLab is an open-source, ROS2-native Martian rover simulator built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim, providing customizable terrain, lighting, and dust conditions with sensor data output, and demonstrates SLAM and VPR benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MarsLab 是一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的开源、ROS2 原生火星车模拟器，提供可定制的地形、光照和尘埃条件及传感器数据输出，并展示了 SLAM 和 VPR 基准测试。
summary_zh: 未来的火星任务将要求火星车具备自主性，能够在非结构化地形、变化的光照条件、大气尘埃以及有限通信环境下运行。仿真是在部署前研究这些条件的实用途径，但现有的火星相关资源在范围上存在差异，包括面向任务的仿真器、固定模拟数据集、特定任务环境以及开放的机器人接口。在此背景下，我们提出了MarsLab——一个开源、基于ROS2原生的火星车仿真器，用于自主性与导航算法开发。MarsLab结合了源自HiRISE的地形与程序化生成的地形，并提供可定制的岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照及大气尘埃设置，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中运行一款“毅力号”级别的火星车模型。运行时会通过标准ROS2话题发布RGB图像、深度图像、RGB-D点云、激光雷达、惯性测量单元（IMU）、轮式里程计以及真实位姿（GT）数据。我们使用同时定位与建图（SLAM）基准测试对MarsLab进行了验证，覆盖不同感知模态、尘埃水平、场景几何及路线长度；同时，在重复火星基地遍历中，针对光照和尘埃变化，进行了视觉位置识别（VPR）基准测试。结果表明，受控场景变化和共享的真实轨迹可用于在同一仿真器内比较轨迹级估计与图像级位置识别。我们的项目页面：https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/。

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
summary: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.
tldr: This paper theoretically and empirically analyzes reward shaping for policy gradient methods in stabilization control, showing that zeroth-order (configuration) reward terms are sufficient and necessary, while first-order (velocity) rewards introduce sensitivity and are not required.
tldr_zh: 本文从理论和实验上分析了策略梯度方法在镇定控制中的奖励塑形，表明零阶（构型）奖励项是充分且必要的，而一阶（速度）奖励项会引入敏感性且并非必需。
summary_zh: 奖励塑形对于基于深度强化学习的现代机器人控制至关重要，然而实践者仍严重依赖从经典最优控制和轨迹优化中借鉴而来的启发式原则。现有方法很少区分与控制目标内在相关的奖励项与数值正则化项，导致超参数调优极为脆弱。为确定奖励必须包含哪些量，我们聚焦于镇定控制问题，并特别关注零阶（构型）信息与一阶（速度）信息。我们从理论和实验两方面证明，策略梯度方法可以在不含一阶奖励项的情况下成功解决镇定任务，而添加此类项反而会随着其量级增大引入严重的敏感性。相反，我们的研究结果证实，奖励函数必须在与目标相关的坐标上具备零阶完备性，同时，在低耗散假设下，策略观测中仍需保留一阶状态信息。总体而言，这些结果为机器人强化学习中的奖励设计提供了可操作且具有原理性的指导。

title: MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors
summary: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.
tldr: This paper presents MonoEgo, a capture system that uses monocular reconstruction with passive wrist markers and sparse workstation anchors to create image-aligned metric ego-centric demonstrations, reducing hardware requirements for data collection in embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MonoEgo，一种利用单目重建与被动腕部标记及稀疏工作站锚点来生成图像对齐的度量自我中心演示的采集系统，降低了具身AI数据采集的硬件要求。
summary_zh: 图像对齐的度量演示通常需要专用的追踪硬件和多设备之间的同步。我们提出了MonoEgo，一种采集系统，它用离线的单目重建替代了主动式腕部仪器。一个90帧每秒的全局快门相机在统一的图像时钟下，同时观测经过标定的被动腕部标记星座、稀疏工作站锚点以及场景。MonoTag SLAM将标记角点与ORB几何特征相结合，并利用视觉证据来排除模糊的平面标记位姿。其度量Atlas支持区间尺度的重新锚定、验证后的地图合并，以及基于最终地图对早期帧的事后定位。相机和腕部星座的输出保持有效性和地图来源信息，不支持的运动则被保留为缺失状态。实验表明，该方法能够在超过连续锚点可见范围的情况下进行度量追踪，重连支持的地图组件，并恢复部分缺失的相机位姿。与多传感器相机参考系统及独立的静态星座测试的对比，刻画了轨迹一致性和精度，同时也揭示了覆盖不完整和残余几何不确定性问题。结果表明，被动固定装置和离线重建能够降低采集端的要求。动态精度、部署可行性及下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

title: Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration
summary: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.
tldr: This paper demonstrates robot-assisted deployment and maintenance of inflatable lunar habitat modules using a modular reconfigurable robot, covering inspection, alignment, locking, and 3D mapping, validated in lab and lunar analogue environments.
tldr_zh: 本文展示了使用模块化可重构机器人在月球栖息地充气模块的部署与维护中的辅助任务，包括检查、对齐、锁定和三维建图，并在实验室和月球模拟场地验证。
summary_zh: 长期的人类月球居住与原位开发开启了太空利用的新纪元。在此背景下，机器人在未来人类前哨站的建设中扮演着关键技术角色。为实现月球表面人类居住模块的部署与建立，我们提出了一种由充气模块与模块化、可重构机器人系统组成的联合方案。本文通过实际硬件——即模块化可重构机器人MoonBot与充气模块HIDAS——展示了多种机器人辅助任务执行的结果，以提高其部署与维护的可靠性。所展示的任务包括：充气过程中的机器人检查、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定以及部署后维护所需的三维测绘。所有演示均在实验室环境或月球模拟测试场地完成。最后，总结了实践经验教训，为未来月球居住中的机器人应用提供了重要参考。

title: Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments
summary: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces DeCoST, a two-stage optimization approach for the Orienteering Problem with time windows and variable profits in human-robot shared workspaces, ensuring collision-free trajectories while maintaining task quality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DeCoST，一种两阶段优化方法，用于人机共享空间中的带时间窗和可变利润的定向越野问题，在保证任务质量的同时确保无碰撞轨迹。
summary_zh: 定向运动问题（OP）在实际应用中具有广泛价值，并在人机协作领域展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法在共享工作空间中，难以同时保证轨迹的安全性与可行性，并实现高质量的任务执行。为此，本研究探讨了带时间窗和可变收益的定向运动问题（OPTWVP），提出了一种两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法，结合服务时间引导轨迹规划（DeCoST），以有效解决共享空间中的OPTWVP。同时，引入节点安全感知时间窗和离散化工作空间，以确保末端执行器与人类之间的无碰撞轨迹。初步结果验证了DeCoST在生成无碰撞轨迹规划的同时，保持定向任务质量的有效性。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D point tracker that combines frozen optical flow and monocular depth networks with a Mamba state space model to refine depth, achieving high metric accuracy on a single GPU for applications like robot navigation and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种3D点跟踪器，结合冻结的光流和单目深度网络与Mamba状态空间模型来细化深度，在单GPU上实现高度量精度，适用于机器人导航和自动驾驶。
summary_zh: 摘要：在度量三维空间（以绝对米为单位，而非未知尺度）中跟踪动态场景的任意点，是三维与四维重建、机器人导航及自动驾驶的基础，这些应用中的决策基于米而非像素。我们的目标是实现一种三维点跟踪器，在绝对度量意义上具有高精度，并且能够在单块商用GPU上、无姿态信息、单目预算条件下运行。我们的方法基于一个观察：一旦点的二维图像轨迹确定，决定其度量精度的量便是沿其像素射线的深度。因此，我们并非端到端地学习跟踪，而是组合两个冻结的前端——用于二维对应的稠密光流和用于第三维的单目度量深度网络——仅学习它们无法提供的残差：即由紧凑状态空间模型（Mamba-3）以外观特征（DINOv3）为条件进行精化的深度。采用状态空间模型而非最强三维跟踪器所用的Transformer，正是使单GPU预算成为可能的关键：状态空间模型以固定大小的循环状态概括轨迹，其内存成本不随帧数变化，而注意力机制则需要随帧数线性增长的键值缓存。在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，我们最优配置在相同条件下评估的方法中取得了最高的绝对度量精度（平均度量Jaccard指数为0.256），超越了强大的前馈跟踪器；同时，一项配套分析（使用各竞争方法自身的评估器复现）解释了为何若干已发表的跟踪器在此预算下会损失大部分精度。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.
tldr: DeltaSeek formalizes how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains observations for active perception in evolving construction environments, demonstrating with a Husky+UR5e that a wrist-mounted camera can observe changes that are impossible from the chassis.
tldr_zh: DeltaSeek 形式化了机器人的感知具身如何约束在动态建筑环境中的观测，并通过 Husky+UR5e 实验证明腕装相机能观测到底盘相机无法观测的变化。
summary_zh: 建筑环境不断演变，导致大幅几何变化，进而降低静态地图构建与配准的性能。这要求机器人具备主动感知能力，即有意识地选择传感配置以解析环境的当前状态。我们提出了DeltaSeek，一个面向演变建筑环境中主动感知的初步框架。尽管我们的长远目标是构建一个能够推理在何处、如何以及何时进行观察的系统，本文聚焦于一个关键前提：机器人的传感具身如何约束其可获取的观测。我们将具身的可行观测集合形式化，并在基于IFC的基准上，以搭载UR5e的Husky A300平台，在底盘安装与腕部安装两种RGB-D配置下进行评估，分别以几何可见性评分观测，以可行驶距离评估代价。在一个包含八项受控变化、涵盖四种可观测条件的房间尺度场景中，对240个可行基座位姿及五种手臂姿态的穷举评估显示，其中两项变化在任何底盘视角下均不可观测，而腕部相机则可同时解决这两项问题。对于两种具身均能观测的变化，腕部相机的中位基座行程为$6.0$米，而底盘相机为$15.2$米。这些结果将传感限制与获取成本区分开来，厘清了观测究竟是本质上不可能，抑或仅需更多行程即可实现。

title: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
summary: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld
tldr: EditWorld is a video world model that enables precise world editing and flexible referencing during autoregressive generation, using gated causal attention, sparse context, and a dedicated training pipeline to outperform existing methods on streaming world editing benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EditWorld 是一个视频世界模型，通过在自回归生成过程中引入门控因果注意力和稀疏上下文机制，实现了对交互世界内容的精确编辑与灵活引用，并在相关基准上取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出了EditWorld，一种用于可交互世界中精确编辑和灵活引用的视频世界模型。现有视频世界模型主要聚焦于导航，使用户能够探索生成的世界，但对现有世界内容如何被修改的控制能力有限。EditWorld通过自回归生成过程中流式输入编辑指令和参考图像，将世界建模从探索扩展至精确修改。为支持这些能力，EditWorld引入了门控因果注意力机制，以处理随时间变化的编辑条件和参考图像，并采用稀疏上下文机制来维持有界的历史上下文，从而实现长时程推理。我们进一步采用了联合自回归与双向训练，结合退火自重采样策略，并构建了专门的数据合成与标注流程，为世界编辑提供监督。我们还提出了WBench-Editing，以系统评估流式世界编辑能力。EditWorld在WBench-Editing上取得了总体最优性能，综合得分为73.8，编辑得分为80.0，在编辑相关指标上大幅超越现有方法。https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

title: Do World Models Learn Global Understanding?
summary: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences. We construct learning tasks on monoid worlds, sets of states connected by action transitions, where observed training transitions and an unseen constraint jointly determine held-out transitions. Measuring generalization tests whether models can learn global constraints from local transitions and propagate their consequences. We consider inverse, commutativity, composition, and periodicity constraints relevant to spatial and semantic structure. Across attention, recurrent, and state-space architectures, next-state training fits the data but fails to propagate non-trivial constraints. Compositional training, which uses identical paths but hides intermediate states from the input, achieves 96% accuracy on inverse, commutativity, and composition constraints across architectures, yields corresponding improvements in geometric generalization of world models trained on embodied environments and relational generalization in Wikidata-finetuned LLMs. How far do models propagate constraints when inferring an unseen fact may depend on first inferring others? We define proof depth d of a held-out transition, measuring the minimum number of inference rounds to infer the transition, and find that model generalization decreases sharply with proof depth. Increasing compositional path length T improves generalization. These results provide a formal way to investigate global understanding in language and world models and demonstrate that compositional training promotes information propagation and integration.
tldr: The paper formally studies whether world models learn global understanding by learning constraints from local transitions, finding that compositional training significantly improves generalization and constraint propagation across architectures, with implications for embodied environments and LLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文通过构造幺半群世界任务，形式化研究了世界模型是否学习全局理解，发现组合训练能显著改善约束传播和泛化，对具身环境和语言模型有启示。
summary_zh: 摘要：人工智能系统往往显得脆弱且碎片化。一个大型语言模型可能正确解释某个概念，却无法应用它，或者在某些情境下遵循安全指令而在另一些情境下则不然。这种行为表明，模型在将局部信息提升为全局理解方面存在普遍不足。为了获得根本性洞察，我们将“理解”定义为学习约束并传播其后果。我们在幺半群世界（由动作转换连接的状态集合）上构建学习任务，其中观察到的训练转换与一个未见的约束共同决定保留的转换。通过测量泛化能力，我们检验模型能否从局部转换中学习全局约束并传播其后果。我们考虑了与空间和语义结构相关的逆、交换、合成及周期性约束。在注意力、循环和状态空间架构中，下一状态训练虽能拟合数据，却无法传播非平凡约束。组合训练采用相同路径但隐藏输入中的中间状态，在各类架构上对逆、交换和合成约束实现了96%的准确率，并在具身环境训练的世界模型几何泛化及维基数据微调的LLM关系泛化中带来相应提升。当推断一个未见事实可能依赖于先推断其他事实时，模型能在多大程度上传播约束？我们定义了保留转换的证明深度d，衡量推断该转换所需的最小推理轮数，并发现模型泛化能力随证明深度增加而急剧下降。增加组合路径长度T可改善泛化效果。这些结果为研究语言和世界模型中的全局理解提供了形式化方法，并表明组合训练促进了信息传播与整合。

title: DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time
summary: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/
tldr: DynaTokens introduces a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to camera-controlled video world models at test time, enabling better simultaneous control of camera motion and object dynamics in dynamic scenes.
tldr_zh: DynaTokens 引入了一组轻量级的、场景特定的可学习令牌，在测试时向相机控制的视频世界模型传授动态信息，从而在动态场景中更好地同时控制相机运动和物体动态。
summary_zh: 视频生成必须考虑两种运动来源：一种是观察者相机路径引起的运动，另一种是场景动态导致的运动。理想的相机控制视频模型应同时兼顾这两种运动：在场景动态演变的同时，允许用户移动相机。尽管当前模型在静态场景中能较好地处理相机引起的运动，但在动态场景中仍面临挑战：物体要么保持静止、要么运动不正确，要么生成质量下降。我们提出了DynaTokens，这是一组轻量级、可学习的场景特定令牌，用于向现有的相机控制世界模型教授动态信息。我们的方法源于两种运动来源之间一个简单的非对称性：相机运动全局性地影响生成视图，而物体动态则是空间局部化的。通过交叉注意力机制，DynaTokens在保持基础模型冻结的情况下，仅从场景的少量示例轨迹中训练可学习令牌，并能在新的查询相机路径下实现动态生成。在VBench2和WorldScore评估中，DynaTokens在动态与相机控制的同步权衡上优于LoRA、块微调和专用可训练层基线方法。对令牌注意力、消融实验和运动时间性的分析表明，将可训练接口与学习目标的结构相匹配对于有效适配至关重要。项目网站：https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

title: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
summary: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.
tldr: Proxy2World proposes a controllable world model that learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation from posed RGBD videos, enabling proxy-camera hybrid denoising for structure-adherent, natural-looking video generation from lightweight scene proxies without paired training data.
tldr_zh: Proxy2World 提出了一种可控世界模型，从带位姿的 RGBD 视频中联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成和联合 RGBD 生成，通过代理-相机混合去噪在推理时生成既符合结构又自然美观的视频，无需成对训练数据。
